faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

MANIT Bhopal extends a range of courses across the Engineering, Architecture, Mathematics, Data Science, and various other streams but its flagship programmes are:
The popularity of these programmes is attributed to their curriculum, which has been developed and upgraded to enhance the knowledge of students in various branches of Engineering and Technology. NIT Bhopal aims at the holistic development of students and helps them to develop technical competencies as well as various soft skills required to target core-industry roles. The industry-institute relations established by NIT Bhopal provide students with the opportunity to undergo various training programmes organised by industry partners.
NIT Bhopal also offers placement assistance to students and helps them get placed in top companies. The notable NIT Bhopal recruiters include Zomato, Amazon, Microsoft, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and Google, among others.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Satisfied with my faculty, facilities, and etc.

review_content.Placements: Percentage of placement is about 80 to 85 percent. The highest package is 20 to 25 LPA, the lowest is 4 to 6 LPA, and the average is 10 LPA. Tata, Maruti Suzuki, Bajaj, and others hire students. Nearly 5 members are placed at present in 3rd-year students. Mechanical designer, product engineer, design engineer, graduate engineer trainee, etc., are top roles.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good and old, but it is getting excellent day by day. Faculty are well qualified and experienced. They have good teaching skills. Hostel maintenance is good, and hostel infrastructure is good. The food is nice. Sports and games have wonderful infrastructure to play, and there are good number of opportunities.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology, Bhopal: A reality check.

review_content.Placements: Last year, the ECE branch student placed about 75 to 78 percent. The placements are going very well so there are good chances to have a placement of more than 90 percent this year. The highest package is 56 LPA and the lowest is 8 LPA. The average package is around 15 LPA to 16 LPA. Recruiting companies include Qualcomm, Micron, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Qubit. The percentage of students who got an internship was a bit low but about 25 to 30 percent.
review_content.Infrastructure: We lack a dedicated building or department building for the ECE but a quite good place is arranged for it which is in the main building. Classrooms are average. The library is available along with Wi-Fi. Labs are good. The hostel is also good but that is not enough. It lacks some sort of facilities. Mess quality is good.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Mathematics and Data Science - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Good infrastructure and placements in 2025.

review_content.Placements: Out of 30 around 24 to 26 members were placed. The highest package this year was 64lpa and the lowest is 7.5 LPA till now and average would around 15 to 20lpa. Top companies are Microsoft, amazon, Uber etc. This year I think 3 had got the internship that too from Amazon. Many roles are related to Software development and some are data analyst .
review_content.Infrastructure: There is Wi-Fi everywhere in the department labs, library, and classroom. In the hostel, we have a LAN for every room. We have washing machines on the ground floor. Food is not bad, not good, it is average. As I am from the state of Telangana, the food is not that good for me. We have a canteen. Medical facilities are available. There is we play sports and games in the sports complex.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Good surroundings with greenary good facilities, events and good faculty.

review_content.Placements: Almost 95 percent of the students got placements in computer Science and engineering. The highest package in Mani is 82 LPA. The average package is 22 LPA. The median package is 15 to 18 LPA and the lowest package is 7 to 8 LPA. Some of the top recruiting companies are Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Oracle, and Intel. Almost 30 percent got internships at Google and Microsoft. The top roles offered in my course are Software Engineer, Data Analyst, Full Stack Engineer, and Machine Learning.
review_content.Infrastructure: The Wi-Fi network in the college is good but it is slow. Using a LAN able on our own increases the speed of the internet. In our department, we have only computer labs and computers are working well but some of them have to be replaced as they are old. The classrooms are excellent and can accommodate almost 110 to 120 students, can be filled freely and the board is visible from the last bench also. Hostel rooms have decent facilities with a study chair and a balcony in their rooms but the bathrooms are not good. Their cleaning should be improved. The food quality is average.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Choose this NIT if you get a good branch.

review_content.Placements: Above 90% of students in my branch get placed. You can also join various clubs related to your branch, which definitely help with placements. I even heard from my seniors that in a CSE club, the placement percentage was 100% last year, with an average package of 35 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is decent but not at the level of IITs. Some new buildings have good facilities, but most of the campus is older since the institute was established in 1960. Overall, the institute is worth it.
review_content.Faculty: Some faculty members are very good, while others are not. At last, you need to study on your own to get good marks.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Chemical Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: It provided good placements in 2024, good infrastructure, and amazing senior-junior interaction.

review_content.Placements: Placements in chemical engineering were decent. Students got placed in core, product management, consulting, and even IT fields. Last year, the placement percentage was around 85 percent. The average package offered was 8 LPA. The highest package ranges from 10-12 LPA. Major companies that hire students are Amazon, ZS Associate, Piramal Finance, JSW Group, Reliance, Park+, and Tata Power. ZS Associate recruited 4 students with a package of 22.5 LPA in the domain of analytics. Amazon hires 2 students in the domain of management with a package of 30.5 LPA. In terms of internships, the condition was not very good. Very few students get internships.

content.Placements: Percentage of placement is about 80 to 85 percent. The highest package is 20 to 25 LPA, the lowest is 4 to 6 LPA, and the average is 10 LPA. Tata, Maruti Suzuki, Bajaj, and others hire students. Nearly 5 members are placed at present in 3rd-year students. Mechanical designer, product engineer, design engineer, graduate engineer trainee, etc., are top roles.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is good and old, but it is getting excellent day by day. Faculty are well qualified and experienced. They have good teaching skills. Hostel maintenance is good, and hostel infrastructure is good. The food is nice. Sports and games have wonderful infrastructure to play, and there are good number of opportunities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology, Bhopal: A reality check.

content.Placements: Last year, the ECE branch student placed about 75 to 78 percent. The placements are going very well so there are good chances to have a placement of more than 90 percent this year. The highest package is 56 LPA and the lowest is 8 LPA. The average package is around 15 LPA to 16 LPA. Recruiting companies include Qualcomm, Micron, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Qubit. The percentage of students who got an internship was a bit low but about 25 to 30 percent.
content.Infrastructure: We lack a dedicated building or department building for the ECE but a quite good place is arranged for it which is in the main building. Classrooms are average. The library is available along with Wi-Fi. Labs are good. The hostel is also good but that is not enough. It lacks some sort of facilities. Mess quality is good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. + M.Tech. in Mathematics and Data Science - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure and placements in 2025.

content.Placements: Out of 30 around 24 to 26 members were placed. The highest package this year was 64lpa and the lowest is 7.5 LPA till now and average would around 15 to 20lpa. Top companies are Microsoft, amazon, Uber etc. This year I think 3 had got the internship that too from Amazon. Many roles are related to Software development and some are data analyst .
content.Infrastructure: There is Wi-Fi everywhere in the department labs, library, and classroom. In the hostel, we have a LAN for every room. We have washing machines on the ground floor. Food is not bad, not good, it is average. As I am from the state of Telangana, the food is not that good for me. We have a canteen. Medical facilities are available. There is we play sports and games in the sports complex.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Good surroundings with greenary good facilities, events and good faculty.

content.Placements: Almost 95 percent of the students got placements in computer Science and engineering. The highest package in Mani is 82 LPA. The average package is 22 LPA. The median package is 15 to 18 LPA and the lowest package is 7 to 8 LPA. Some of the top recruiting companies are Google, Amazon, Microsoft, Oracle, and Intel. Almost 30 percent got internships at Google and Microsoft. The top roles offered in my course are Software Engineer, Data Analyst, Full Stack Engineer, and Machine Learning.
content.Infrastructure: The Wi-Fi network in the college is good but it is slow. Using a LAN able on our own increases the speed of the internet. In our department, we have only computer labs and computers are working well but some of them have to be replaced as they are old. The classrooms are excellent and can accommodate almost 110 to 120 students, can be filled freely and the board is visible from the last bench also. Hostel rooms have decent facilities with a study chair and a balcony in their rooms but the bathrooms are not good. Their cleaning should be improved. The food quality is average.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Choose this NIT if you get a good branch.

content.Placements: Above 90% of students in my branch get placed. You can also join various clubs related to your branch, which definitely help with placements. I even heard from my seniors that in a CSE club, the placement percentage was 100% last year, with an average package of 35 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is decent but not at the level of IITs. Some new buildings have good facilities, but most of the campus is older since the institute was established in 1960. Overall, the institute is worth it.
content.Faculty: Some faculty members are very good, while others are not. At last, you need to study on your own to get good marks.

paragraphs: NIT Bhopal is entrance-based. Here is a step-wise guide for NIT Bhopal admission.
1 - NIT Bhopal Application Process

Prospective students who want to join NIT Bhopal are required to fill out the application form for entrance exams specific to their course of interest. After taking entrance exams respective to their courses of interest, they will be required to apply for counseling processes to get a final seat. However, candidates who are interested in taking admission in MBA and PhD programs will be required to submit their applications through the institute's official website.
2 - Selection Rounds

NIT Bhopal admits students with a valid JEE Main score for its flagship BTech programme. The allotment of seats is done through JoSAA Counselling. To get admission in MTech, one needs to appear for GATE, followed by CCMT Counselling.Similarly, for MSc admission, IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling are required. NIT Bhopal MBA admissions are done through CAT score. Shortlisted candidates have to appear for the PI round.
3 - Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

The cut-off for admission to BTech, MTech, and MSc courses is released by the respective counselling bodies. In contrast, for MBA admission, the institute directly releases merit lists after declaring the final results of all rounds. The selected candidates are then required to pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

faqs.question: Which specialisations are available for BTech programme in MANIT Bhopal?
faqs.answer: NIT Bhopal BTech admission is offered in seven specialisations. These are Civil engineering, Electrical engineering, Computer Science engineering, Mechanical engineering, Electronics and Communication engineering, Chemical engineering, and Material Science and Metallurgical engineering.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility criteria for BTech at NIT Bhopal?
faqs.answer: For admission to BTech at NIT Bhopal, students must pass Class 12 with 75% aggregate with Physics and Mathematics as compulsory subjects with any one of the Chemistry/ Biotechnology/ Biology/ Technical Vocational subject (for SC/ST, 65% aggregate is required).

faqs.question: What is the selection criteria for BTech at NIT Bhopal?
faqs.answer: Admission to BTech at NIT Bhopal is strictly based on the candidates' performance in JEE Main followed by participation in JoSAA Counselling. National-level entrance exam for engineering in India is JEE Main. The merit of the candidate determines their eligibility to get admission to NITs. JoSAA Counselling is centralised admission where seats to eligible students are allocated according to their preference for NITs and courses as based on the JEE Main scores.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with my faculty, facilities, and etc.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good and old, but it is getting excellent day by day. Faculty are well qualified and experienced. They have good teaching skills. Hostel maintenance is good, and hostel infrastructure is good. The food is nice. Sports and games have wonderful infrastructure to play, and there are good number of opportunities.

reviews.review_heading: Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology, Bhopal: A reality check.
reviews.review_text: We lack a dedicated building or department building for the ECE but a quite good place is arranged for it which is in the main building. Classrooms are average. The library is available along with Wi-Fi. Labs are good. The hostel is also good but that is not enough. It lacks some sort of facilities. Mess quality is good.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and placements in 2025.
reviews.review_text: There is Wi-Fi everywhere in the department labs, library, and classroom. In the hostel, we have a LAN for every room. We have washing machines on the ground floor. Food is not bad, not good, it is average. As I am from the state of Telangana, the food is not that good for me. We have a canteen. Medical facilities are available. There is we play sports and games in the sports complex.

reviews.review_heading: Good surroundings with greenary good facilities, events and good faculty.
reviews.review_text: The Wi-Fi network in the college is good but it is slow. Using a LAN able on our own increases the speed of the internet. In our department, we have only computer labs and computers are working well but some of them have to be replaced as they are old. The classrooms are excellent and can accommodate almost 110 to 120 students, can be filled freely and the board is visible from the last bench also. Hostel rooms have decent facilities with a study chair and a balcony in their rooms but the bathro...

reviews.review_heading: Choose this NIT if you get a good branch.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is decent but not at the level of IITs. Some new buildings have good facilities, but most of the campus is older since the institute was established in 1960. Overall, the institute is worth it.

reviews.review_heading: It provided good placements in 2024, good infrastructure, and amazing senior-junior interaction.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is pretty decent. The infrastructure of the sports complex is very good. There are proper facilities for most of the sports like badminton, lawn tennis, table tennis, volleyball, cricket, football, and basketball. There are a few restaurants inside the campus. There is a dispensary for first aid. Ambulance is available 24x7. Food quality is satisfactory. A proper LAN facility is available in every room. The library is old but quite huge. Classrooms for the new b...

reviews.review_heading: Life at MANIT Bhopal is really fun and enthusiastic. It is a good place to learn many things.
reviews.review_text: In classrooms and the main building, the infrastructure is too good, especially the environment in the college is very pure. MANIT has a green, luscious, and peaceful campus. Plants and greenery are just amazing. Classrooms, labs, and a central library are also very well designed and convenient. There is a very good sports complex for all types of sports. There is a dispensary for medical purposes. There are 12 hostels, which are well-designed and beautifully represented, with each one having a ...

reviews.review_heading: Placements are quite decent. Placements can be better for core branches.
reviews.review_text: All labs related to mechanical engineering are available in MANIT. The Wi-Fi is super fast in both the campus and the hostel. The library has all related and relevant books, including the digital ones. Classrooms are decent with whiteboards and projectors in every class. They also have a microphone and speaker facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Best college for placements and knowledge.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is the best in Bhopal, and Wi-Fi is also the best with high speed. Classrooms are the best, and a library is provided. Different labs are available in my courses. Hostel facilities are moderate, and food quality is the best. Hostel and mess fees are also moderate. Medical facilities are very good. Sports are also provided here. There is a sports complex, and different schemes are being held here.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied due to the placement percentage last year, which was very low.
reviews.review_text: Almost all hostels are in good condition, with all facilities like a common room, Wi-Fi, sports facilities, and other things. The sports complex is very good with all the required facilities. Cricket, football, badminton, volleyball, basketball, handball, table tennis, yoga, and kabaddi are available. Labs are well-equipped, and classrooms are good with a projector and all.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements but not the infrastructure as we expected.
reviews.review_text: Every alternate room has a balcony for better air and an open environment. Every room has Wi-Fi and LAN connection. Every hostel has a common hall consisting of a television. The infrastructure is vast but not as expected. Food is good for those who are from Bhopal, and it is generally satisfactory.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good placements but not the infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Every alternate room has a balcony and very clean bathrooms. Every room has Wi-Fi and LAN connection. There is a common hall for every hostel. The library has 30,000 books and is very peaceful. The food in the mess is tasty and hygienic. The infrastructure is very vast and good.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, but bad for ECE.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for the ECE course is not so good as the department doesn't have its own building. We use shared labs, and Wi-Fi is often slow. In contrast, the hostel facilities are quite good. The mess food is okay-okay, but the canteen is decent. The campus has excellent sports facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Not up to expectations, but still the best available.
reviews.review_text: The MCA department does not have dedicated classrooms. Classes are conducted wherever an empty room is available. Sometimes one lecture happens in one building, and the next is scheduled in a completely different building. We end up wasting a lot of time just moving from one building to another. The hostels are excellent, honestly the best part of the college. Rooms are well maintained, and the mess food is really good considering the price we pay.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements in 2024 to 2025.
reviews.review_text: There is a Central library on the campus which has about 1.5 Lacs books,1627 thesis/dissertations. There are digital resources about 7000 books and 5000 journals. Hostel has good facilities, and there is a LAN facility for the internet. There is no Wi-Fi in hostels. Sports facilities are decent, there is a sports complex with equipment for most sports. There is no AC in most of the classrooms except for a few.

data.description: NIT Bhopal has well-read faculty who are Post Doc, PhD and higher degree holders. The faculty are experienced with several years of teaching experience. NIT Bhopal also invites faculty for guest lectures and offers opportunity to students to interact with some of the best personalities and therefore learn from them.

overview_faqs.question: How is the MTech programme at NIT Jamshedpur?
overview_faqs.answer: It is good to pursue MTech course at NIT Jamshedpur. National Institute of Technology, Jamshedpur, provides a two-year full-time MTech programme. For admission, candidates must visit the official website of the institute to submit an online application. Candidates are selected on the basis of GATE exam scores. Aspirants must fulfil the eligibility criteria, i.e., a candidate must have passed and secured at least a 6.5 CGPA or 60% aggregate in graduation. As per placement, there were more than 250 companies that visited during NIT Jamshedpur placements 2023. The overall placement rate stood at 98.87%. The top recruiters were Axis Bank, Deloitte, DE Shaw and Co., Flipkart, ICICI Bank, Genpact, Oracle, etc.

overview_faqs.question: What is campus life like at NIT Jamshedpur?
overview_faqs.answer: The campus is located on the outskirts of Jamshedpur in an area of 340 acres (approx.). The campus has various facilities to offer students a great environment, some of them are:Hostel: NIT Jamshedpur has 9 boys hostel and 4 girls hostel. All the hostel has amenities like mess, wi-fi internet facility, guest room and common room with television.Library: NIT Jamshedpur Library subscribes to a sizeable number of technical, scientific & general periodicals journals & newspapers. The central library has also procured JGATE of NIT Library Consortium resources specifically for research purpose.NIT Jamshedpur campus also includes Gym facilities, Sports, IT Infrastructure, Cafeteria, Auditorium, Wi-Fi, Convenience Store, Banks, ATM, Laboratories, Guest Room, Waiting Room and Transport Facility. The infrastructure is well maintained and is fully enabled with Wi-Fi and has a lush green campus.

overview_faqs.question: What is the fee for BTech at NIT Jamshedpur?
overview_faqs.answer: NIT Jamshedpur BTech total tuition fee is INR 5 lakh. Apart from the tuition fee, candidates are also required to pay the hostel fee (if opted) of INR 1.28 lakh. The meal plan is also included in the hostel fee. For a detailed NIT Jamshedpur BTech fee structure, candidates are advised to contact the admission department of the institute.The given fee is taken from the official website/sanctioning body. It is still subject to changes. Hence, is indicative.

review_summary.college_name: NIT Jamshedpur Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Engineering and Computational Mechanics - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good college, average infrastructure, and nice placements.

content.Placements: Majorly SDE roles in non-core, other than that nearly 100 percent placement as companies simply take masses because the college is present in an industrial area. The highest package is approximately 1.2 CPA and the lowest is around 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Tata, Jindal, students here approach companies.
content.Infrastructure: Not great infrastructure, but two new hostels, one for boys and one for girls, are excellent. Otherwise, other hostels are not that good. Also, we don't have our own auditorium, but we do have an open-air theatre where nearly all events and fests take place.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Engineering and Computational Mechanics - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: It has average college life, good professors, a mixed type of seniors, and average infrastructure.

content.Placements: It's amazing that here the placement statistics are nearly 100 percent. One of the reasons is that here in Jamshedpur, there are so many factories, so companies simply come and hire nearly all students. The internship situation is not satisfactory, as very few get on-campus internships in the core field.
content.Infrastructure: Except for hostel L for boys (which is the new hostel provided for first years this year) and a new hostel for girls, all other hostels are a total mess. Students face huge discomfort as the range of Wi-Fi is not so great. In hostels, there is irregularity in the water supply.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. (Hons.) in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: NIT Jamshedpur has very good placement, but you have to study.

content.Placements: Here, every branch has very good placement, including production engineering, mechanical engineering, civil engineering, electrical engineering, electronics and communication engineering, and computer science engineering. Here, the highest package last year was 1.43 crores.
content.Infrastructure: All the 1st hostels in this college are better than any other NITs, but for the 2nd year, 3rd year, and 4th year, don't expect more from this college. The mess food is not at all good. You have canteens in your 1st year hostel at night time which open at 6 pm.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Engineering and Computational Mechanics - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Completely satisfied with the college and the branch.

content.Placements: Currently, like 14 out of 30 students are placed till now, with the highest package around 44 LPA, and our average package is around 19 LPA, which I think is good. This is the first batch from ECM that is on placement. I think with time, placement will be better than the current scenario. I would like to inform you that all of them are placed in non-core, so this branch is completely on the tech side. With time, the branch demand will increase in the market.
content.Infrastructure: For 1st year student hostel L is allocated, which is new and modern with a good wifi and LAN facility. So overall, there is no issue with the internet. A smart, well-equipped classroom with modern infrastructure. Food quality is fine, better than other hostels where I lived, and they maintain proper hygiene also.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Metallurgical and Materials Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: This place is good if you want placements.

content.Placements: Placement is very great for circuit branches, comparable to the top 5 NITs, also core branches also have good placement percentage. Recent placements show high packages (up to 82 LPA) and strong CSE average (around 20 LPA) with major recruiters like Google and Tata Motors, while academic calendars run July-Jan (Autumn) and Jan-June (Spring). For the NIT Jamshedpur Metallurgy branch, major recruiters are core steel/metals companies like Tata Steel, Vedanta Group, JSW, and JS.
content.Infrastructure: Hostels are top-notch, the new Birsa Munda hostel is on par. I have attached an image of the hostel. The library and labs are not that well-equipped. We have a dispensary which has all basic medicines, and an ambulance service is available 24 hours around the campus.

paragraphs: NIT Jamshedpur admission cyclebegins with the opening of applications. As admission to most of the courses is entrance-based, candidates are required to apply through the entrance exam.
1: NIT Jamshedpur Application Process

Aspirants seeking admission at NIT Jamshedpur need to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. After appearing for the respective entrance exams, candidates have to apply for the counselling process for the final seat allotment. However, candidates seeking admission to PhD courses need to apply on the institute's official website.
2: Selection Rounds

For its flagship BTech programme, NIT Jamshedpur selects students based on a valid JEE Main score. Candidates are allotted seats through JoSAA Counselling. Admission to MTech is through GATE, followed by CCMT Counselling. Similarly, for MSc admission, IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling are required. However, NIT Jamshedpur MCA admissions are done through NIMCET score.
3: Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

The respective counselling bodies releaseNIT Jamshedpur cutofffor all courses. Whereas, for PhD and MCA admission, the institute releases merit lists after declaring the final results of all rounds. The selected candidates are then required to pay theNIT Jamshedpur feeto confirm their seats.

NIT Jamshedpur fee is a sum of multiple components such as tuition fee, caution deposit, library deposit, etc. Candidates have to pay a caution deposit once at the time of admission. courses_data.description: NIT Jamshedpur offers three-year MCA course at the PG level. Admission to the course is based on performance in NIMCET, followed by a central counselling process. Candidates who have completed a bachelor's degree can apply for the MCA course.

faqs.question: What is the eligibility for admission to MCA at NIT Jamshedpur?
faqs.answer: Candidates need to pass BSc or BCA from a recognised university with Mathematics or Statistics as one of the papers with at least 60% aggregate or 6.5 CGPA (55% aggregate or 6.0 CGPA for SC/ ST/ PwD candidates). Aspirants must hold the documents proving their eligibility for verification at the time of admission. Besides, aspirants also need to pass NIMCET for MCA admission.

faqs.question: Is MCA available at NIT Jamshedpur?
faqs.answer: Yes, MCA programme at NIT Jamshedpur is a three-year (six-semester) full-time programme. National Institute of Technology Master of Computer Applications Common Entrance Test (NIMCET), which is followed by central counselling is conducted for admission to MCA course. Aspirants who have passed graduation can apply for NIT Jamshedpur MCA programme.

faqs.question: Is NIMCET required for MCA at NIT Jamshedpur?
faqs.answer: Yes, admission to NIT Jamshedpur MCA programme is based on NIMCET score jointly conducted by NITs and through centralised common counseling. NIMCET is conducted once in a year in computer-based mode. It is a two hour test comprising 120 questions. Candidates are alloted seats based on their NIMCET rank through counselling.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission at NIT Jamshedpur?
faqs.answer: NIT Jamshedpur does not offers direct admission. Candidates are shortlisted for BTech based on JEE Main score. BTech is the flagship programme of NIT Jamshedpur. Selected candidates are further allocated seat via JoSAA Counselling. Besides, admission to M.Tech and MSc courses is based on GATE and IIT JAM, respectively. Aspirants applying for MCA need to pass NIMCET for admission.

faqs.question: What is the required score in JEE Mains to get admission in NIT Jamshedpur for CSE course?
faqs.answer: In 2024, CSE was the most competitive specialisation. The rank for BTech CSE in Round 5 was 7944. Analysing the NIT Jamshedpur CSE cutoff 2024 with the last two years, BTech in CSE has shown a fluctuating trend in its Round 5 closing ranks.  Looking at the past three-year trend, the rank is ranging between 7944 and 9277. Aspirants securing rank between 7000 and 9000 have a chance of getting admission in the CSE course.

faqs.question: What is the admission process for NIT Jamshedpur BTech after JEE Main?
faqs.answer: After appearing for JEE Main exam conducted by NTA in online mode, wait for NIT Jamshedpur to release the cutoff list. If you meet the cutoff marks, you can participate in JoSAA counselling for seat allotment. Once you receive a seat, report to the institute and pay the admission fee to confirm your seat in the NIT Jamshedpur BTech program.

faqs.question: How to apply for admission at NIT Jamshedpur?
faqs.answer: To take admission to the courses offered at NIT Jamshedpur, candidates need to visit the official website of the respective national-level entrance exam conducting bodies and fill out the application form in online mode.For BTech: Aspirants must fill out the application form for JEE Main/ JEE Main Paper-II through the official website of the National Testing Agency (NTA).For MTech: The institute offers MTech in three specialisations. NIT Jamshedpur MTech admissions are based on GATE scores, followed by CCMT.For MSc:Candidates need to apply to IIT JAM through the official website of the respective conducting body.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, average infrastructure, and nice placements.
reviews.review_text: Not great infrastructure, but two new hostels, one for boys and one for girls, are excellent. Otherwise, other hostels are not that good. Also, we don't have our own auditorium, but we do have an open-air theatre where nearly all events and fests take place.

reviews.review_heading: It has average college life, good professors, a mixed type of seniors, and average infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Except for hostel L for boys (which is the new hostel provided for first years this year) and a new hostel for girls, all other hostels are a total mess. Students face huge discomfort as the range of Wi-Fi is not so great. In hostels, there is irregularity in the water supply.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Jamshedpur has very good placement, but you have to study.
reviews.review_text: All the 1st hostels in this college are better than any other NITs, but for the 2nd year, 3rd year, and 4th year, don't expect more from this college. The mess food is not at all good. You have canteens in your 1st year hostel at night time which open at 6 pm.

reviews.review_heading: Completely satisfied with the college and the branch.
reviews.review_text: For 1st year student hostel L is allocated, which is new and modern with a good wifi and LAN facility. So overall, there is no issue with the internet. A smart, well-equipped classroom with modern infrastructure. Food quality is fine, better than other hostels where I lived, and they maintain proper hygiene also.

reviews.review_heading: This place is good if you want placements.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are top-notch, the new Birsa Munda hostel is on par. I have attached an image of the hostel. The library and labs are not that well-equipped. We have a dispensary which has all basic medicines, and an ambulance service is available 24 hours around the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Real review from NITian.
reviews.review_text: Hostel, I would rate 5 above and more especially, the hostel is at the level of IITs and above any NITs hostel. Cleanliness in the hostel is also top-level, sweeping machines are used. Mess food, I would rate 4.5. Non-Veg is very good. Veg students have to suffer a little bit. Medical, I would rate 5. There is always an ambulance available 24/7, and there are doctors for stress and anxiety. Also, one of my classmates has anxiety problems, so the college authority takes it seriously. Sports, Iwou...

reviews.review_heading: Reasons why not to leave the admission here, NIT Jamshedpur.
reviews.review_text: Speaking of academic facilities and infrastructure, lectures are taken in a new lecture hall, which has all facilities, Wi-Fi, LAN, a projector, and a library is near the lecture hall, so you can study after attending lectures. Labs of all subjects are in the old academic building, the labs' infrastructure is a bit old, fans are there, but in peak summers, they're of no use. The equipment and machinery of some labs are new, but some are of the old kind, but good if you're in robotics, electronic...

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, strong academics, and a vibrant campus life.
reviews.review_text: The Mechanical Engineering department has good infrastructure, including well-equipped labs and smart classrooms with projectors. The high-speed Wi-Fi is available across the campus. The central library is large, air-conditioned, and has enough books and journals. Hostels are very good but less maintained, with issues like water problems and Wi-Fi issues. The food quality is average, but you can eat. The grounds for sports are very good, and the sports infrastructure is good.

reviews.review_heading: Placements are great. Infrastructure is decent. Mess food is average. Fests are below average.
reviews.review_text: The first-year hostel is great. It is newly built. It is a 2-seater hostel. The hostels for other years might feel old and in poor condition, but they are the same as other hostels in India, and they are single-seater. The lecture hall is great. The mess food is bad. For girls, they have built a new hostel, which we do not know if they will allot to first years or not.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely good placements.
reviews.review_text: In our college, there is only one gym, which is very small in size. The gym in our college just opened this year in August. Also, there is one cafeteria in our college, and the price is reasonable for the food. The library in our college is the only one. The library opens at 10:00 AM and closes at 9:00 PM. The hostel timing for boys is approximately 11:00 PM, and for girls is 9:00 PM. Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated.

reviews.review_heading: Very good college, infrastructure, and placements.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are allotted to each student in the college. For the first year, a single room is shared with 2 students, while in the second year onward, a single room is allotted to single students. The mess food quality is not so good. The library is full of books and books. You'll get newspapers and magazines too, and there is a Hindi sahitya section in the library which is full of golden Hindi literature books. The classroom is very high-tech and air-conditioned. They have whiteboards and a green b...

reviews.review_heading: NIT Jamshedpur College review.
reviews.review_text: Our department has very good facilities. There is Wi-Fi, the lab equipment is in great condition, and classrooms are clean, spacious, and have projectors. The library is huge with over 2 lakh books. The medical and sports facilities are excellent. The hostels may be a bit old and not ideal for second-year students, but they are fine for others. The only drawback is the food in the mess, which I would rate 2 out of 5.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Jamshedpur College review.
reviews.review_text: Even though the overall infrastructure is just average, the campus Wi-Fi, well-maintained labs, comfortable classrooms, and large library make a big difference. Since the library has so many books, students don’t need to spend much on outside materials. There are transport facilities and on-campus housing too. The mess is clean, and the food is decent, but it could use a few more favourites.

reviews.review_heading: National Institute of Technology, Civil Engineering
reviews.review_text: The lecture hall is good, and each classroom is equipped with air conditioning. Other buildings are not that great, but the boys' hostel for 1st year is the best, newly built, and can be considered as one of the best hostels among NITs.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Jamshedpur College.
reviews.review_text: College had some pretty solid infrastructure and decent amenities. The campus housing it's actually quite comfy and pretty well-managed. A lot of students prefer living there. As for the food service, it's alright, it gets the job done, nothing too fancy.

review_summary.college_name: NIT Meghalaya Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Chemistry - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Wonderful campus life, hardworking teachers but reluctant placement cell about masters students.

content.Placements: About 70% of students are placed, mostly engineering students in various industries like IT sector, electronics, and some PSU sectors. The average salary is 5 LPA. Top companies like BPCL and L&T take part in the placement drive, but it lacks opportunities for M.Sc students.
content.Infrastructure: Library is good with books covering all the courses but less number of books which leads to less holding time for books. The library is good and Wi-Fi facility in college is good. Sometimes creates trouble in the hostel. The mess food is not upto the mark but we can't expect more from a hostel.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: I am extremely happy after getting admission to this prestigious and esteemed university.

content.Placements: Approximately 80% of students get placed in my college. The highest package offered is 32 LPA, and the average package is 12 LPA. The lowest package is 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies like Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Wipro, TCS, and Deloitte visit the college for placements. 95% of students got internships from my course.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is super clean and hygienic. Rooms in my hostel are fully furnished and super clean. The food quality is good. There is no repetition of food. The mess and canteen area is also clean. There are several sports facilities in my college including indoor and outdoor games.

individual_reviews.course: M.Sc. in Physics - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Between the mountains with supportive faculty members.

content.Placements: The seats for M.Sc has increased to 20 students. We have supporting faculty members who encourage us in every aspect from career guidance to NET GATE. Edtech companies like Physics Wallah, Allen, etc., are engaged in hiring M.Sc students
content.Infrastructure: The whole campus and hostel have Wi-Fi facilities available 24/7 which provides high internet speed. There is a library and also an e-library with Wi-Fi and you can access the computers and do your work. Hostel rooms are better than expected. The mess food is above average.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Average placements, new campus, average mess food, overall a very average college.

content.Placements: The placements at NIT Meghalaya have been very average, or even below average, for the last two to three years. This year's placements were rather dull, and no big IT companies participated in the on-campus hiring session. Most of the students who got good packages either got them off-campus or had PPOs from their internships.
content.Infrastructure: The college is moving to a new campus in February 2025. The new campus is in Sohra, Cherapunji, and is in a beautiful setting. The campus is newly built and has new furniture and amenities. The mess food is average, but I expect it to improve once the new campus opens.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: New campus life starts, but we'll enjoy yourself.

content.Placements: Placements at NIT Meghalaya are not so good these days, but they are better than last year. Most of the good placements were recorded in the mechanical section, which were on campus. The good placements in the IT sector were grabbed off campus. So, our placements depend on our performance.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel has good facilities, but the three-seater rooms require some adjustment. The vegetarian food is average, but the non-veg food is better. There are a few canteens, but they are expanding. For medical care, we depend on the Ramkrishna School and a medical emergency building on campus. There are also two ambulances always on campus. Sports facilities are growing, and we have some indoor sports tables, a badminton court, and a cricket ground for now.

paragraphs: Theadmission process for NIT Meghalaya 2025is entirely based on the candidate's performance in the entrance exam, PI, written test, etc. Candidates are required to first qualify for the eligibility criteria of the courses they are interested in and apply online for the programme. TheJEE Advanced 2025official website has launched with the new eligibility criteria. As per the official website, candidates can now attempt theJEE Advanced 2025 exama maximum of three times in three consecutive years. Find below theNIT Meghalaya admission process 2025:
Step 1: NIT Meghalaya Application Process

Candidates seeking admission in BTech, MTech, and MSc at NIT Meghalaya are required to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. After appearing for the respective entrance exams, candidates have to apply for the counselling process for the final seat allotment. For the PhD and also MTech candidates must apply via NIT Meghalaya's official website and appear for the institution-based written test and personal interview.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

For its flagship BTech course, NIT Meghalaya selects students with a valid JEE Main score. Candidates are allotted seats through JoSAA Counselling. Selection for MTech is made through GATE, followed by CCMT Counselling. Similarly, for MSc admission, IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling are required. However, for PhD, both full-time and part-time selection is made through the institution-based written test and personal interview.
Step 3: Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

The cutoff for BTech, MTech, and MSc courses is released by the respective counselling bodies. The shortlisted candidates are then required to pay the admission fee to confirm their seats. The institute releases the selected candidates' list on its official website. Selected candidates have to pay the fee and confirm their seats.

NIT Meghalaya feesfor the academic courses vary fromINR 69,000 to INR to INR 5 lakh. Candidates must pay the admission fee at the time of final admission to finalise the seat at the institution. Along with the admission fee, candidates might have to make a one-time payment, including a student welfare fund, alumni fee, library fee, etc. Adding to that an institute caution deposit ofINR 5,000is required to be paid. faqs.question: Can I get direct admission in NIT Meghalaya?
faqs.answer: NIT Meghalaya doesn't have any direct admissionn option. To apply in the PG courses at NIT Meghalaya candiates must have valid national level entrance scores and participate in the counselling process.  However, for the PhD and sponsored courses, candidates can apply via the NIT Meghalaya's official website and appear for the PI/written test.

faqs.question: Can I get into NIT Meghalaya BTech without JEE?
faqs.answer: Admission to NIT Meghalaya BTech programme is entirely based on JEE Main exam. Based on the JEE Main exams score candidates are provided admission to BTech programme in NIT Meghalaya. Also candidates have to eligible for the BTech course  with twelve years of school education with PCM/ PBM with minimum of 75 % aggregate and ofcourse a valid score in JEE Main exam.

reviews.review_heading: Wonderful campus life, hardworking teachers but reluctant placement cell about masters students.
reviews.review_text: Library is good with books covering all the courses but less number of books which leads to less holding time for books. The library is good and Wi-Fi facility in college is good. Sometimes creates trouble in the hostel. The mess food is not upto the mark but we can't expect more from a hostel.

reviews.review_heading: I am extremely happy after getting admission to this prestigious and esteemed university.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is super clean and hygienic. Rooms in my hostel are fully furnished and super clean. The food quality is good. There is no repetition of food. The mess and canteen area is also clean. There are several sports facilities in my college including indoor and outdoor games.

reviews.review_heading: Between the mountains with supportive faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The whole campus and hostel have Wi-Fi facilities available 24/7 which provides high internet speed. There is a library and also an e-library with Wi-Fi and you can access the computers and do your work. Hostel rooms are better than expected. The mess food is above average.

reviews.review_heading: Average placements, new campus, average mess food, overall a very average college.
reviews.review_text: The college is moving to a new campus in February 2025. The new campus is in Sohra, Cherapunji, and is in a beautiful setting. The campus is newly built and has new furniture and amenities. The mess food is average, but I expect it to improve once the new campus opens.

reviews.review_heading: New campus life starts, but we'll enjoy yourself.
reviews.review_text: The hostel has good facilities, but the three-seater rooms require some adjustment. The vegetarian food is average, but the non-veg food is better. There are a few canteens, but they are expanding. For medical care, we depend on the Ramkrishna School and a medical emergency building on campus. There are also two ambulances always on campus. Sports facilities are growing, and we have some indoor sports tables, a badminton court, and a cricket ground for now.

reviews.review_heading: We are shifting to our permanent campus.
reviews.review_text: There are computer labs with Mac operation systems. It is well-equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi connections and dehumidifiers for projecting the systems from moisture. There is a building with a big library consisting of all the important books for every course.

reviews.review_heading: An average college with natural beauty.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the labs, classrooms, and lecture halls is good. This is also true of the hostels, but if you are looking for food, it is not good if you are from the north or west of India. There is mostly non-vegetarian food. No nearby restaurants are available; in fact, there are no shops.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied by the food in the mess & transportation facilities, placements are not up to the mark.
reviews.review_text: Campus shifting will take place this December as it’s confirmed officially now. Wi-Fi is good, labs and classrooms are so nice in the permanent campus. Hostel rooms in our new campus are nice. The library is too small but enough for the students count here. Food is bad, and sports and games are fine.

reviews.review_heading: Any way NIT is a NIT.
reviews.review_text: Currently, our campus is working in a temporary campus, so it doesn't have advanced facilities. Labs are equipped with all the necessary equipment that is needed, but slowly the labs are being shifted to the permanent campus, which has all the advanced machines and laboratories. Hostels are quite good.

reviews.review_heading: Good faculty, infrastructure, and facilities as well as a good senior junior bonding.
reviews.review_text: For Civil Engineering department, there are separate labs for different courses, e.g., structural engineering, geotechnical engineering, Transportation Engineering, Hydrology and Water Resources Engineering, Engineering Drawing lab, etc. Library facilities are also available for students. As NIT Meghalaya is being operated from its temporary campus, some apartments have been rented as hostels. In hostels, Wi-Fi and mess gym facilities are available and for transportation from hostel to college a...

reviews.review_heading: Review of Bachelors of technology in Computer Science from the NIT Meghalaya.
reviews.review_text: NIT Meghalaya has a very good infrastructure for computer science courses. The campus of the college is pretty big and beautiful. The campus of the college is lush with greenery. College management offers facilities such as computer labs, libraries, canteens, Wi-Fi, sports, etc. that are properly maintained. The quality of these facilities is also good. A hostel facility is also available for college students. The food in the mess and canteen is also good to eat.

reviews.review_heading: A good college environment.
reviews.review_text: The campus was well-developed with Wi-Fi connectivity, spacious rooms, washrooms, a stocked library, an auditorium, and a hospital facility in case of need. A hostel facility is also available and the mess and canteen both have good, hygiene-quality food. We do have football, cricket, basketball, volleyball and badminton courts available.

reviews.review_heading: Good college because of the study level. As compared to IIITs and GFTIs, this NIT is very good.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are not so good, but professors are very good. We have Wi-Fi, labs, a library, and separate classrooms. The quality of food is not good in hostels, but in college it is good. Medical facilities are very good; colleges have a separate department for them.

reviews.review_heading: I would recommend students to join this college.
reviews.review_text: Currently, we are operating from Shillong, and it is a temporary campus. Our campus is average so the college life is not that good. Hostels are far from college and are average. All the hostels are at different places and are not good. Even the quality of food served is the worst. You can't enjoy hostel life but from batch'23 we are shifting to permanent campus, so then it will be good.

reviews.review_heading: Best of returns, good placement records, and a good coding environment.
reviews.review_text: The best hostel compared to other NITs has all-time free Wi-Fi and good mess food. Gym equipment in the hostel, a 24*7 medical facility in the eye-distance hospital, and indoor as well as outdoor game facilities. They also provide all types of game equipment. The playground is so near to the hostel.

college_info.intro:
Jain University Bangalore Jayanagar has several schools including the Centre for Management Studies, School of Law and the School of Engineering & Technology. At the UG level, Jain University offers BTech, BBA, BSc, BCom and other courses to students. At the PG level, SP Jain Bangalore offers MBA, MTech, MSc, MCA, MCom, and other courses to students. Jain University Bangalore offers PhD, Vocational Studies, online programmes and various other courses.
Jain Deemed to be University Bangalore is famous for its popular programmes such as MBA and BTech. The MBA programme offered at the university is a full-time, two-year programme offered in single as well as dual specialisations. Some of the popular Jain MBA Bangalore specialisations include Marketing, Finance, Human Resource Management, Business Analytics, and Digital Marketing, among others. The MBA curriculum offered at the university also includes live projects and project-centric assignments. Below mentioned are some of the courses offered by Jain Deemed to be University Bangalore and their respective eligibility and fees:

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2026
reviews_list.review_title: It has good faculty members and placements.

review_content.Placements: 90 percent of students get placed. The highest package offered is 58 LPA and the lowest package offered is 3.5 LPA. Top recruiting companies like IBM, Accenture, and Nvidia hire students. 50 percent of students got internships in companies like EY and HCL. Placements are good. reviews_list.review_title: Overall, college is good.

review_content.Placements: The placement rates are good. 80-90% placement rate is there. The average package is 5 LPA - 7 LPA. reviews_list.review_title: The college is very good in the end.

admission_overview.description: Jain Deemed to be University admission 2026 is primarily entrance-based. The admission process begins with the registration of the candidates online on the official website. Candidates must qualify for the JET exam for admission. JET or Jain Entrance Test is a university-level exam conducted in online mode for admission to UG, PG and MBA courses. The final selection of candidates is done on the basis of Essay Writing, Presentation, and Personal Interview, along with the entrance exam scores.

faqs.answer: Yes, Jain (Deemed-to-be-University) offers direct (lateral) admission to Engineering courses. The university's direct admission is based on the marks secured by the candidate in the qualifying examination. Admission to Lateral Entry is done entirely merit-based. There is no entrance exam required for the selection of candidates. Admissions are done based on the merit of candidates in the previous qualifying exam. In BTech Lateral Entry course, admission is given on the valid percentage of candidates acquired in a Diploma course. Once candidates fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria and qualify the selection process, they are called for a counselling process.

reviews.review_heading: Great college with great placements.

These scholarships are offered by the Jain University Scholarship Committee (JUSC) and are classified in various areas ranging from academic to extra-curricular categories. Apart from its regular students, the University also provides opportunities to candidates who are differently abled. overview_faqs.question: What is campus life like at NIT Kurukshetra?
overview_faqs.answer: NIT Kurukshetra campus spreads over 300 acres. It has been divided into three functional sectors: the instructional sector, the residential sector for the employees, and the residential sector for the students (hostels). Students can find lodging in hostels because they are residential institutions. The MTech students are accommodated in PG hostels. NIT Kurukshetra has a very spacious library with a good collection of documents, including text and reference books, video cassettes, CD-ROMs, and many print and online journals and books. The infrastructure facilities include eight blocks and a workshop. Each block has offices for the staff, lecture halls, tutorial rooms, and various laboratories.

paragraphs: NIT Kurukshetra admission process includes the application process, selection round, cutoff, merit list, and counselling. Find below the complete process for NIT Kurukshetra admission 2025:
Step 1: NIT Kurukshetra Application Process

Interested individuals looking to apply for admission, to NIT Kurukshetra should start by filling out the application form found on the website of the institute. The application process varies based on the programme being applied for; For courses such as BTech applicants are required to take the JEE Main exam and submit their applications through JoSSA Counselling; for postgraduate programs like MTech and MSc candidates must apply via the relevant entrance exams such as GATE, for MTech and IIT JAM for MSc.; while those seeking PhD admissions need to apply through the institute's website.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Admission to BTech programmes at NIT Kurukshetra depends on the candidates' performance in JEE Main; however, eligible candidates are allocated seats via JoSAA Counselling. For MTech programmes, candidates must possess a valid GATE score and participate in CCMT Counselling.

The cutoff lists for the courses are published by NIT Kurukshetra upon completing the selection rounds. The corresponding counselling bodies make these lists available to candidates. faqs.answer: NIT Kurukshetra BTech admission is based on the entrance exam. Candidates who want admission must first meet the basic criteria for eligibility and then take the entrance exam. NIT Kurukshetra BTech admissions are based on JEE Main scores, followed by JoSAA counselling. Candidates must secure a 90% or above percentile to get admission to BTech courses offered by NIT Kurukshetra. reviews.review_heading: NIT Kurukshetra College Review.
reviews.review_text: The department provides Wi-Fi, and the labs are well-maintained. The classrooms are spacious, and the library has an excellent collection. The hostels are generally good and kept clean, but the food in the mess and food street is just average. There are basic medical facilities and plenty of sports and recreation options too, so you won't really feel bored.

reviews.review_heading: NIT KURUKSHETRA - My 4 years of journey.
reviews.review_text: Hostel rooms are good if you are adjustable until you are living in the H6 hostel. Washing Machines are available. Laundry man is available, but he is costly. Bring your iron also. Table tennis, chess, volleyball, badminton, cricket. TV screens are available in each hostel. In the seniors' hostel, a gym is also available. Talking about messy food, it is like okay. H3 mess food is good (best). The rest of us have to survive like you. No Wi-Fi only Lawns connection.

reviews.review_heading: College review of NIT Kurukshetra.
reviews.review_text: All classrooms have digital boards for a better learning experience. As for hostels, the occupancy is decent for accommodating all students. Mess food is fine. Technical fests are pretty interesting, and the ambience of that is good too. All necessary facilities like hospital, etc., are accessible 24X7.

reviews.review_heading: It's a good college. It has all the facilities, but weather makes it difficult, though manageable.
reviews.review_text: The availability of network services is not fulfilling even mobile network of some SIMs do not work. The hostels do not have Wi-Fi. They have LAN service which does not allow WhatsApp to run as well. The quality of food is not that great. The rotis are made from machines and are mostly raw and incredible though. The medical facilities are top-notch. Sports facilities are also maintained well. Due to the extreme heat, sometimes the ACs feel worthless.

reviews.review_heading: The honest review of NIT Kurukshetra.
reviews.review_text: All the classes are air-conditioned but some of the ACs don't work properly in our class. Our institute has a big central library which has a lot of books but as a student we don't have enough time to read those books. All the apparatus is in good condition, and performing the experiments by yourself is very enjoyable. But when the lecture is given about how to proceed and what the theory is about experiments are very boring. Hostel facilities are also decent. Sometimes mess food may not be too ...

paragraphs: NIT Kurukshetra offers various scholarships to its students. NIT Kurukshetra students can avail of Merit-cum-Means Scholarships, the Central Sector Scholarship Scheme for SC students, and Alumni Association Scholarships.

There are various scholarships under Merit-cum-Means Scholarships, such as the OP Jindal Engineering and Management Scholarship, which is given to the first three toppers (Engineering) and the first ten (Management) on the basis of performance during the whole course.

The Central Sector Scholarship Scheme for SC students offers 26 merit scholarships and 52 merit-cum-means scholarships are awarded by the institute for each year of BTech degree courses. In addition to these, National Scholarships, Post-metric Scholarship, and many other stipends are awarded by various Government institutions and other agencies.

NITK also offers Alumni Association awards. There are 5 scholarships (one each in the disciplines of Civil, Computer, Electronics Electrical, and Mechanical Engineering) of the value of INR 2400 per annum that are open to all regular BTech students of the institute.

content.Placements: In my Chemical Engineering Batch at NIT (National Institute of Technology) Raipur, there are 80 students in one batch. Our placement percentage is 90+. The highest salary offered was about 18-20 LPA, while the average was about 8-9 LPA. Some companies that visit us include Reliance Petroleum, BPCL, and HP.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has good infrastructure, with good Wi-Fi speed, labs, and a central library for self-studies and book issues. paragraphs: NIT Raipur admission processincludes application process, release of merit list, counselling and final seat allotment.Check below the stepwise explanation for NIT Raipur admission process 2025:

1. Candidates seeking admission to the institute must fill the application form for the entrance exam of preferred course.After appearing for the selected entrance exam and shortlisting, candidates are required to appear for the counselling process for the final seat allotment.However, candidates seeking admission to PhD courses can visit the official website of NIT Raipur and apply for the programme directly.

2. NIT Raipur shortlists candidates on the basis of the score obtained by them in the entrance exam that they appeared for.The college admits students based on their JEE Main score for BTech.Admission to MTech is through GATE scores, followed by CCMT Counselling.Similarly for MSc admission, IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling are required.However, NIT Raipur MBA admissions are done through CAT score, where the shortlisted candidates have to appear for the PI round.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good faculty members with high knowledge.
reviews.review_text: Our college has good infrastructure, with good Wi-Fi speed, labs, and a central library for self-studies and book issues. I will give it 3 stars because the classroom is okay, but the hostel facilities are below average. We also don't have a cricket ground on our campus to play cricket.

reviews.review_heading: The college has very good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Our academic building is good and has a classical shape. It was started in the year 1956 by the President of that time, Dr Rajendra Prasad. The facilities are good. We have many water coolers in our college. We have a lift in it for going to other floors. There is a central library in our course. The hostel food is okay, which means you can have it without any vomiting.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure with a strong network.
reviews.review_text: I like the infrastructure of our college, but many people do not like it because of less campus area of our college. My college is just 100 acres, which looks very small for a top government college. There is a library where a lot of books are present, and students can do self-studies if they want. The hostel facilities are good. The food quality is also good, the mess timing is 1 pm to 3 pm for lunch and 7 pm to 9 pm for dinner.

reviews.review_heading: Nice infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good for me. There is a sports complex in our college where students can play whatever they want. There is a library and Wi-Fi available for students to use if they want. The hostel facilities are up to the mark, and the mess food is also hygienic. One star is cut because of hostel shortage.

reviews.review_heading: The college is not that good for lower branches.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of my college is not the best. As compared to Tier 1 NITs, it comes under Tier 2 NITs. Most of the students are from Chhattisgarh, as NITs have home state quota. There is a library where Wi-Fi is available and smart boards in the classroom. The hostel food quality is good, but it has a shortage of hostel space.

reviews.review_heading: A short summary of NIT Raipur's teaching.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is quite old, but it is still very much new and still one of the best. Almost all classes, rooms, and hostels have Wi-Fi. Even classrooms have a smart board. There are many sports clubs to join, and even NCC is there. So many sports events happen here.

reviews.review_heading: Review of a South Indian At NIT Raipur.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good in our college. It provides limited resources in sports, but that is sufficient for us. I belong to the South region of India, Andhra Pradesh. I have some issues with Hindi, so I do not get connected to our college students.

reviews.review_heading: A comprehensive review of NIT Raipur. It is a must-read for aspirants.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is almost everywhere on my campus. Even in classrooms, there are smart boards to teach. Food is very tasty every day of the week, and there is something different to eat. It is very healthy too.

reviews.review_heading: My simple life at NIT Raipur.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is not as good as that of other tier 1 and NITs, but better than that of other tier 3 government or private colleges. We have a smart board in our classrooms. There is Wi-Fi in our college, and we can use it. There is a library with many books.

reviews.review_heading: Overall a great journey at NIT Raipur with amazing campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for the Mining department is quite old but very well maintained. We have specialized labs for geology and mineral processing with all the necessary equipment. The campus has Wi-Fi, but the speed is sometimes slow in the hostels. The library is huge and has all the books needed for our course. Talking about the hostel, rooms are shared by 2 to 3 students. The food quality in the mess is just okay, mostly North Indian menu. We have a dispensary for medical needs and very good sp...

reviews.review_heading: Studies at NIT Raipur Biotechnology.
reviews.review_text: Our college has good infrastructure. There is a library with 2 Wi-Fi connections, students can use it if they want to. Hostels are nice, and the food is okay. There is a dispensary so that students can buy medicine.

reviews.review_heading: My college life at NIT Raipur.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is also good. It has Wi-Fi in the college, and every student can connect if they want to connect to Wi-Fi. It has a library and a sports complex. Hostels are good, and our hostel is also nice. It has a mess so that we can eat, and it also has a gym so that students can do whatever they want.

reviews.review_heading: Good enough if we don't have other option.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure are good. But the only problem is that it has only few seats in the hostel. Rest have to find PG (paying guest) or flat for them which is available around the college within a 1 km range. It has 2 canteens, and they are actually good.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with placements, but needs more improvement in infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The course department is good. Good classrooms and Wi-Fi are available. There is a fully functional and furnished library. There is one problem in the hostel that not everyone is allotted a hostel in the 1st, 2nd or 3rd year it's allotted on merit (rank), gender and category. Wi-Fi is present in the hostel premises.

reviews.review_heading: Good at placement for the core branch.
reviews.review_text: Truly talking about the hostel. There are less hostel rooms than required by the students. Major problem with my college is that main college and campus area is only 100 acres. Hostels that are available are also not that good to stay.

review_content.Placements: Our college is a great place to get your research skills upto the mark as it supports research-based studies more, and it encourages research more than the studies going on statistically in the classes. If you want to join my college, then come here if you have an interest in doing research.
review_content.Infrastructure: Hostel Wi-Fi is provided, and necessities like water and electricity are provided 24/7, but the food isn't that good. The hostel and campus are ragging-free, so there's no stress about it, as the hostel management is strict about it. There is a lot of free space to roam around in the campus and the hostels.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: A decent college with good opportunities. If you put in effort.

review_content.Placements: The placement scenario for this CSE department is that around 62-75 percent of the students from our batch got through campus placements. The highest package offered is around 12 LPA to 15 LPA, mainly for the product-based international rows. The lowest package is about 3 LPA. While the average package ranges between 4 LPA and 5 LPA. The top recruiting companies include Infosys, HCL, Tech Mahindra, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Veltech has good infrastructure for the CSE department. Classrooms are fully equipped, and labs are well-maintained with decent systems and internet connectivity. The library is large and has a good collection of technical books, journals, and digital resources, which are helpful for academics and projects. Hostel facilities are average to good, and rooms are clean and regularly maintained. The best food is manageable, with both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: A good college with supportive faculty, decent placements, and campus life.

review_content.Placements: Placements in our college are average to good, depending on the student's skills and academic performance. Around 60–70% of students from my batch get placed through campus placements. The placement cell is active and provides training in aptitude, technical skills, resume preparation, and mock interviews. The highest package offered is around 6–8 LPA, the lowest package is about 2–3 LPA, and the average package is nearly 3.5–4 LPA. Most students receive packages in the average range.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of our college is good and well-maintained. Classrooms are spacious, properly ventilated. They are equipped with projectors and boards. Laboratories are well equipped with the required systems and instruments for practical learning. Wi-Fi is available across the campus. Though the speed may vary at times. Library has a good collection of textbooks, reference books, journals, and digital resources. It helps with academics and exam preparation. Hostel facilities are satisfactory with clean rooms. Along with regular water supply, and basic facilities. The quality of food in the mess is average, hygienic. Menu is changed regularly.
