individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Design - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with my college faculty.

content.Placements: In my course, which was B.Teach in Computer Science and Design, 75 percent of students were placed. In my course, the highest package was 9 LPA, the lowest package was 3 LPA, and the average package is 5 to 6 LPA. Amazon, Accenture, Infosys, etc., recruited. 55 Percent of students got internships in Accenture, Infosys, Genpact, etc. Top roles offered in my course was web Designer, Graphic Designer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure that were available in our department were extremely good. It consisted of digital labs, wi-fi, digital classrooms, and a library for different departments. The quality of facilities in the hostel was excellent. It consisted of AC and non-AC rooms, and there were 6 hostels, four hostels for boys and 2 hostels for girls, and these hostels had 24/7 monitoring systems for security. The food quality was excellent, they kept non-veg 6 days a week, along with veg and for every block there was a medical facility which was 24/7.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: The college provides good placements, training, infrastructure and facilities.

content.Placements: The college was excellent, and coming to the placements, the college has excellent placements and training. Seventy per cent of students have been placed this year. Top recruiting companies are TCS, Accenture, Infosys, Cognizant. Roles offered are software engineer, data engineer.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure are very good. They provide projectors in teaching classes and provide Wi-Fi and smart classrooms, as well as extraordinary lab facilities. The library has a smart library, and extra facilities are available all over the college. The hostel is good, and the food is good. They provide Wi-Fi and a good atmosphere in the rooms, along with medical facilities. Sports and games are very good, and they conduct games for all hostellers to make them happy.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Data Science) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely trash faculty here.

content.Placements: Our college is a great place to get your research skills upto the mark as it supports research-based studies more, and it encourages research more than the studies going on statistically in the classes. If you want to join my college, then come here if you have an interest in doing research.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel Wi-Fi is provided, and necessities like water and electricity are provided 24/7, but the food isn't that good. The hostel and campus are ragging-free, so there's no stress about it, as the hostel management is strict about it. There is a lot of free space to roam around in the campus and the hostels.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: A decent college with good opportunities. If you put in effort.

content.Placements: The placement scenario for this CSE department is that around 62-75 percent of the students from our batch got through campus placements. The highest package offered is around 12 LPA to 15 LPA, mainly for the product-based international rows. The lowest package is about 3 LPA. While the average package ranges between 4 LPA and 5 LPA. The top recruiting companies include Infosys, HCL, Tech Mahindra, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Veltech has good infrastructure for the CSE department. Classrooms are fully equipped, and labs are well-maintained with decent systems and internet connectivity. The library is large and has a good collection of technical books, journals, and digital resources, which are helpful for academics and projects. Hostel facilities are average to good, and rooms are clean and regularly maintained. The best food is manageable, with both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: A good college with supportive faculty, decent placements, and campus life.

content.Placements: Placements in our college are average to good, depending on the student's skills and academic performance. Around 60–70% of students from my batch get placed through campus placements. The placement cell is active and provides training in aptitude, technical skills, resume preparation, and mock interviews. The highest package offered is around 6–8 LPA, the lowest package is about 2–3 LPA, and the average package is nearly 3.5–4 LPA. Most students receive packages in the average range.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure of our college is good and well-maintained. Classrooms are spacious, properly ventilated. They are equipped with projectors and boards. Laboratories are well equipped with the required systems and instruments for practical learning. Wi-Fi is available across the campus. Though the speed may vary at times. Library has a good collection of textbooks, reference books, journals, and digital resources. It helps with academics and exam preparation. Hostel facilities are satisfactory with clean rooms. Along with regular water supply, and basic facilities. The quality of food in the mess is average, hygienic. Menu is changed regularly.

admission_overview.college_name: Vel Tech Course Admissions 2025: Fees, Eligibility, Dates & Selection Process

paragraphs: Vel Tech Rangarajan Dr Sagunthala R and D Institute of Science and Technology or Vel Tech Universityadmissions 2025 are openfor various courses. The university offers courses at UG, PG and PhD levels across the streams of Engineering, Technology, Science, Management, Law and Commerce. Vel Tech admissions are bothmerit and entrance-based.Vel Techaccepts either its in-house entrance exam, i.e.,VTUEEEand national-level entrance exams such asCLAT and LSAT. For Vel Tech admission, the applications are accepted in online mode only.

Candidates are admitted toVel Tech UG & PG coursesbased on merit and entrance exam scores. Candidates must fulfil the minimum eligibility requirements before applying for the courses at the university. Check below the course-wise eligibility and selection criteria related to Vel Tech University course admission 2025:
Class 12 with 60% aggregate
Class 12 with respective subjects
Class 12 with minimum 50% aggregate
Graduation with 50% aggregate

Vel Tech admission process consists of multiple steps, including fulfilling the basic eligibility criteria, qualifying for the selection criteria and filling an application form. Check below the detailed process for Vel Tech admission 2025:
Step 1: Application Process

Vel Tech application process is conducted in online mode. Candidates can fill an online application form on the university's official website for their desired programme. During the application process, candidates must also upload the relevant supporting documents of their past academics. Along with that, they must also pay an application fee before submitting the form.
Step 2: Selection Rounds

Vel Tech University admissions are both merit entrance-based for selective courses. For admission to courses such as BTech, BCom LLB and BA LLB, candidates are admitted based on scores of entrance exams such as VTUEEE, CLAT, LSAT, etc., respectively. However, admission to courses such as MTech, BBA, MSc, etc., is entirely merit-based.
Step 3: Final Admission
Once all the selection rounds are completed, the qualified candidates are offered seats in their respective courses. The selected candidates must pay a certain amount of fee to confirm their seats.

reviews.review_heading: Andhra University College is a very good college.
reviews.review_text: Andhra University College infrastructure is far better than that of any other college in the city. Hostels are average. Hostel food is very nice and the college has its seperate play ground. The students are very well mannered in the college.

reviews.review_heading: The best college with good infrastructure and a place for students to be guided for their future.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good, and the Vice Chancellor even takes strict action on discipline and various aspects. Students also perform with good excitement and skills, and college is good for everything in every aspect and every role with various skills.

reviews.review_heading: Andhra University is the best college.
reviews.review_text: Andhra University College facilities and infrastructure available for the course/department are very good and friendly. Classrooms and the library are very good in the college. The college hostels are also good for students. Food quality is also good.

reviews.review_heading: College is good with good infrastructure and facilities. Hostel is not good, especially the food.
reviews.review_text: There are no good facilities, and they are average. The hostel is too bad. The food is not good. There is no good maintenance of the hostel. I think sports and games are not good at Andhra University. The canteen is okay. The library is also good. There are libraries in Andhra University.

reviews.review_heading: Explore as much as you can.
reviews.review_text: Still lags in the ways of management with little to no improvement in recent years. Infrastructure is poor. We do not have classroom with good ventilation. They are not cleaned properly. Outsiders or animals like dogs cats often coming to class at times. Labs are the best part .

reviews.review_heading: Totally, I would rate my college review as between average and above average for all facilities.
reviews.review_text: In my college (B.Tech instrumentation course), the facilities and infrastructure are good, but the library is not open. If we want to read a book, we have to ask the HOD to open the library. This is not good for me. The mess (food) is below average, medical facilities are okay, and in the canteen, some snacks are at a high cost, but overall, the canteen is at a reasonable price. The major drawback is that there is heavy support for students who are interested in sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: I feel better for this course.
reviews.review_text: We get free Wi-Fi, good network. Infrastructure is good. The classrooms and buildings constructed very strong, clean classrooms. Good food is available in canteen, good medical facilities. The sports and games are good. Every day we have games. The ground is very large.

reviews.review_heading: Good academics and campus.
reviews.review_text: Well equipped labs, smart classrooms, and campus wide Wi-Fi are available. The central library is a large and resource rich. Hostels are average and the mess food is decent. Medical care is available, and there are good sports and games facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, qualified faculty, solid infrastructure, lively campus.
reviews.review_text: The department has Wi-Fi-enabled classrooms, well-equipped labs with modern PCs, and a digital library with vast resources. Hostel rooms are spacious with basic amenities. The mess food quality varies, a medical room is available for emergencies, and sports grounds for cricket and football.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with the faculty, infrastructure of the college and placements.
reviews.review_text: Andhra University provides separate hostel facilities for boys and girls on campus with amenities like furnished rooms, mess, Wi-Fi, and recreational space. The infrastructure for the electrical and electronic engineering branch includes specialized e-classrooms and access to the university's large library.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good faculty, placements, and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The campus has Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a rich library. Hostels are clean with good facilities. The mess food is decent. Along with canteen options available. Medical support is provided 24/7. Sports grounds and indoor games are well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good faculty, placements, and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The campus has Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, well-equipped labs, and a rich library. Hostels are clean with good rooms. The mess food is decent with variety. Medical care is available 24/7. The campus has playgrounds, indoor games, and sports facilities in good condition.

reviews.review_heading: The college offers good academics, placements, and very good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The IT department offers modern computer labs, reliable campus Wi-Fi, smart classrooms, and access to library with updated books and e-resources. Hostels are decent. Along with clean rooms and regular maintenance. Mess food is average but hygienic. The canteen offers tastier options. Medical facilities include a campus health center and emergency support. Sports infrastructure, including a playground, indoor games, and a gym, helps students stay active and engaged.

reviews.review_heading: The college offers good academics, supportive faculty, strong placements, and an active campus.
reviews.review_text: Andhra University offers Wi-Fi, well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, and a central library. Hostels are basic but decent. The food is average. A medical center is available. There are good sports facilities, including grounds and courts. Overall, the infrastructure is functional and satisfactory.

reviews.review_heading: A supportive campus with good faculty and steady placement.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for our course is quite good, with well-maintained classrooms, good Wi-Fi, and regular labs that are updated for practical work. The library is decent and helps a lot during exam time. Hostel facilities are comfortable, and the mess food is manageable, with some days better than others. Sports facilities, like the ground and indoor games, are available, and basic medical help is provided on campus. Overall, the environment is supportive for both academics and daily living.

1- Application Process 2025

Candidates must apply and appear for entrance exams accepted by the university for admission. Further, candidates must fill out the application form online and offline by visiting the campus physically.
2- Selection Round

Chitkara University, Chandigarhselects candidates for all courses based on various entrance exams such as JEE Main, SLAT, PTE and others. The college also conducts PI and GD rounds for admission to some UG and PG courses including MBA, BCA, BBA and others.
3- Allocation of Seats

The seats in the various programmes will be allotted based on merit- ranking of the student in the specified entrance test subject to fulfilling the minimum eligibility criteria for the programme and the preferences indicated in the counselling form at the time of counselling (as per availability of seats).
4- Payment and confirmation of seats

Those who are offered admission are required to pay the fees. Any kind of cheque shall NOT be accepted. All enrolled students have to pay their fees twice a year in the months notified by the university. Delayed payment of fees will attract a fine as per the rules and regulations of the University.

faqs.question: What is the reality of Chitkara University placements?
faqs.answer: Chitkara University offers a decent placement rate, with students from almost all the courses getting placement assistance. During Chitkara University placements 2023, over 1,150 BTech students were placed during Chitkara University placements. The institute attracted more than 670 industry giants who offered a variety of job roles to the Engineering students across sectors, such as Assurance, IT, Education, Operations, Sales and Marketing, etc. Further, the highest and average package offered during Chitkara University MBA placements in 2023 was INR 44 LPA and INR 9 LPA, respectively. The key highlights of Chitkara University placements for the BTech and MBA Class of 2023 are tabulated below: Particulars BTech Placement Statistics (2023) MBA Placement Statistics (2023) Highest package INR 111 LPA INR 44 LPA Average Package NA INR 9 LPA Median package NA INR 10.5 LPA Total students 1,800 NA Total students placed 1,150+ NA Total recruiters 670+ 275+ Dream offers 570+ 140+ Super Dream offers 310+ NA PPOs NA 175+ International offers NA 35+

faqs.question: Does Chitkara University offer placements abroad?
faqs.answer: Yes, Chitkara University offers placements both internationally and nationally. The top companies who visit the campus are Amazon, Adobe, Deloitte, EY, KPMG, etc. Students get an opportunity to work in areas of IT, Education, Consulting, E-Commerce, etc. In 2023 placement drive, the highest package given among BTech students was INR 1.11 Crore per annum. For the MBA students, the highest package was INR 44 LPA and INR 9 LPA was the average package.

faqs.question: What is the total tuition fee for MBA/PGDM at Chitkara Business School Chandigarh?
faqs.answer: The total tuition fee for the MBA course at Chitkara Business School ranges from INR 6.60 Lacs to INR 10.20 lakh . The 2 year full-time MBA course is offered in 9 specialisations, namely Marketing, Finance, Logistics & Supply Chain, Business Analytics, Human Resource Management, HealthCare, Retail Management, Pharmaceutical Management, and Banking, Financial Services and Insurance. Candidates need to take a national level entrance exam, such as CAT, XAT, MAT, CMAT or NMAT to take admission.

faqs: What is the cutoff of Chitkara University?
description: Chitkara University cutoff 2025 is available on this page for admission to the B.Sc in Hospitality Administration course. The universi accepts the NCHMCT JEE entrance exam for selecting students. Candidates seeking admission can scroll down to check the year and round-wise cutoff trends. A few more updates are below:

Chitkara University NCHMCT JEE cutoff 2025 for admission to the BSc in Hospitality Management course was 4062 in the last round, for the students belonging to the General AI quota. The first round closing rank for the same course was 6366. Check out the table below:

Chitkara University cutoff 2025 has been released for NCHMCT JEE across different rounds and categories. For the General AI category, the last round cutoff rank for the B.Sc. in Hospitality Administration course was 4062. In 2024, the cutoff rank for the same course was 987, while in 2023, it was 9338. So, comparing the cutoff data for admission to the BSc course, Chitkara University saw a fluctuating trend over three years.

Candidates planning to appear for next year's exam must go through the NCHMCT JEE cutoff marks of the latest and previous years to get an idea of admission chances at Chitkara University. Students can view or download the round and year-wise cutoff PDF lists to understand the past years' cutoff trends for B.Sc in Hospitality Administration admission.

nirf.description:
As per the overall score, Chitkara University has been placed at a good position by the NIRF under the 'Overall' category, reflecting its exceptional performance in areas like Teaching, Research, Graduation Outcomes, and creating an inclusive, quality learning environment. It is observable that in the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have shown stability in trend when evaluated against the ranking of the past year. In 2025, Chitkara University's rank is #101, the same as last year's rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking.
One can observe that within the category of 'University', the institute's ranking has scaled up when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, Chitkara University climbed 12 ranks to #78 rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking. This is the second consecutive year that the institute has ascended in the rankings.
The institute has displayed a fluctuating trend in the 'Engineering' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, Chitkara University climbed 5 ranks to #89 rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking.
The institute's ranks in the 'Management' category; have shown a fluctuation when evaluated against previous year's ranking. In 2025, Chitkara University fell 24 ranks to #78 rank in the 'Management' category by the NIRF ranking.

reviews.review_heading: Chitkara University: The Place to Explore Your Potential.
reviews.review_text: Perfect facilities and infrastructure; everything is up to date and all classes have Wi-Fi. Classrooms are air-conditioned, the library is great and has a separate Wi-Fi, sports, games, and every facility is fantastic. Lovely atmosphere, love this college.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2028Offered by Chitkara University Institute of Engineering and Technology, Chitkara University, ChandigarhReviewed on 11 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Decent in every field, do check it out.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure here at the university is well-equipped, and the campus is Wi-Fi enabled, but you have to authenticate it with the credentials provided by the university to connect to the Wi-Fi. The university has a central library as well, where students can do self-study. The hostel provides decent facilities, and food at the mess is average to good. The medical facility of the dispensary is also provided here.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Chitkara Business School, Chitkara University, ChandigarhReviewed on 9 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Best infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Luxury rooms were available; 1, 2, 3, and 4-seater rooms with CCTV footage. Wi-Fi was also provided with speeds up to 40 Mbps. Mess food is disappointing. Sports activities and a gym are also provided. Medical facilities are available 24/7, and there is a hospital at the main gate.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Chitkara Business School, Chitkara University, ChandigarhReviewed on 9 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the hostel, campus and faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of the whole university is fabulous. Hostel food is also good they provide and maintain cleanliness. It is also widely appreciated for its modern and well planned infrastructure. SMART classrooms, well stocked libraries, advanced laboratories and innovation and research centres that help student work in competitions. It actually offers a well rounded environment.

reviews.review_heading: Really good facilities for the students in the classrooms as well in the hostels.
reviews.review_text: Every facility for the students is well provided and well maintained in hostels as well as classrooms, a decent quality of food is available in the hostel mess, and a good food court is also available. There are 2 libraries one for the whole college and one specifically for the global students.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Chitkara University Institute of Engineering and Technology, Chitkara University, ChandigarhReviewed on 7 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Chitkara University has a good environment overall.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is really good. The buildings and the park are well maintained. Hygiene is maintained overall on the campus. Regular maintenance and cleaning happen. Even the hostels are looked after if students face any issues regarding light or electronics.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Chitkara University Institute of Engineering and Technology, Chitkara University, ChandigarhReviewed on 7 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: I am fully satisfied with my college option.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is of very good quality. All the stuff is in very good condition, and the staff is also very cooperative. The labs are properly furnished and kept neat and clean. The food quality is nice, and it is regularly checked for safety measures for the future.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Chitkara University Institute of Engineering and Technology, Chitkara University, ChandigarhReviewed on 6 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Offers practical, industry-focused learning with good faculty and strong placements.
reviews.review_text: Both CSE buildings are well maintained, with air-conditioned lecture halls and good seating. Wi-Fi works well. There is also a decent-sized library. Almost every sport is available, with proper equipment and gear. The gym is good overall.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Chitkara University Institute of Engineering and Technology, Chitkara University, ChandigarhReviewed on 6 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Great exposure and opportunities, but be ready for the discipline.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the overall campus is really good and provides you with the best services that you pay for. The mess food is still better than a lot, and mostly good. The water is clean, and the hostel has vending machines for your service, even the academic buildings are well built and maintained. They are a bit strict in matters of applying for a gate pass to even step outside the campus, and the hostel rules are made a bit stricter.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Chitkara College of Sales and Marketing, Chitkara University, ChandigarhReviewed on 6 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Know about my Chitkara University.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is good. Labs are well-maintained, and all facilities are available. From Wi-Fi to food quality is good. Mess is in a good location inside the campus. The library is separate for every building. In the hostel, good furniture and other requirements are provided as needed.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2029Offered by Chitkara University Institute of Engineering and Technology, Chitkara University, ChandigarhReviewed on 5 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Discover your potential at Chitkara University. Opportunities await you.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, brilliant classrooms, big libraries with every book on each and every topic taught available. No idea about the hostel, though, as I'm a day scholar, but the sports facilities are to the students' benefit. Overall, the institute offers you the best facilities.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Chitkara College of Sales and Marketing, Chitkara University, ChandigarhReviewed on 2 Dec 2025)
reviews.review_heading: MBA mean Chitkara University.
reviews.review_text: They have very well-maintained infrastructure with separate classrooms and a separate library for every department. They have world 5G Wi-Fi on every floor. They have indoor games on campus along with a big swimming pool available on a rental basis.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Chitkara College of Sales and Marketing, Chitkara University, ChandigarhReviewed on 25 Nov 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Chitkara University MBA marketing.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are in a good location and have all the facilities required by the students. They have their own rule, like they close the gate at 9:30 and open it at 5:00, for the better performance of students and to maintain the integrity of the college. They have a full hygienic canteen mess and have medical facilities for every student.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Chitkara College of Sales and Marketing, Chitkara University, ChandigarhReviewed on 25 Nov 2025)
reviews.review_heading: My college has an MBA in marketing course.
reviews.review_text: Good library and good area. It has its own mass canteen cafeteria and many more inside the boundary and on the main campus. Getting all the facilities, from drinking water to washrooms. The hostel's infrastructure is very luxurious, with both AC and non-AC rooms.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2027Offered by Chitkara College of Sales and Marketing, Chitkara University, ChandigarhReviewed on 20 Nov 2025)
reviews.review_heading: Review of Chitkara College of Sales and Marketing, Chitkara University, Chandigarh.

reviews.review_heading: COEP Technological University review.
reviews.review_text: Some faculty members are quite helpful and knowledgeable, who help students for getting industry ready and gain good technical skills and soft skills. The boys' hostel is quite old, not so good, food quality is above average. Other facilities like sports, infra and all are good. COEP is the only college in Pune to have its own boat club, which is active.

reviews.review_heading: COEP is the regional underdog.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good, but the number of students in the location is really low. Mess food is okay. The gym is crowded. Ground is good. Wi-Fi is provided in the entire campus, but sometimes it doesn't work. Located in the city center, so many fun activities around. The overall infrastructure is decent.

reviews.review_heading: I love the college and its life here.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is a bit weak. Classrooms are clean, and the library is well-equipped. The hostel infrastructure really needs to be improved, and the mess food is fine. The sports facilities are good, and our college has its own teams that frequently participate in tournaments. College Sport events also take place.

reviews.review_heading: It is a great college for opportunities with a good crowd.
reviews.review_text: Labs are not fully up to date, but classrooms are good. For the CSE course, a new building is constructed and is still under development. But it is well-designed and maintained. Sports facilities are good. The college grounds are located just outside the hostel, so students do not face any difficulty. There are also indoor sports facilities, like a badminton court, within the college campus.

reviews.review_heading: Good learning environment with friendly campus vibe .
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for our course is quite good. Classrooms are clean, labs have the basic equipment we need, and the Wi-Fi works fine most of the time. The department has a decent library space, and faculty are supportive and knowledgeable. Hostel facilities are okay. Rooms are simple but livable. The average quality is fine, but it changes daily. Canteen food is better, and we also have basic medical help available on campus.

reviews.review_heading: My experience in college.
reviews.review_text: It has good facilities it has some decent food quality issues but the rest is all good. The locality of the hostel is in a good area of the city with great infrastructure. I am a local so I do not know much about this but all I have heard is good.

reviews.review_heading: College is living up to its reputation with great faculty and an amazing student crowd.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is based on the old architecture of the college, but the labs and classrooms are newly developed and are well-equipped. Wi-Fi speed fluctuates, but is decent. The library may seem a bit old. The mess is average, and sometimes, on special occasions, a different menu is opted for. Overall, extracurricular activities are taken care of.

reviews.review_heading: Decent and nice campus life, enjoy life in college.
reviews.review_text: The facilities in the department are good, like the labs are well-maintained, the classrooms are decent, and the Wi-Fi quality is good in specific areas only. The hostel is not that good, and the capacity is not for everyone. Mess is decent, and the cafeteria is a good option.

reviews.review_heading: COEP: The dream college of every student.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is a bit of an issue here. Often, there are connectivity problems. The infrastructure is good in the college. There are well-equipped libraries in the college with thousands of quality, useful books, which is good. Mess food is also okay, but in comparison with other colleges, it is very good. Sports facilities are also very good as the college is represented in every sports competition.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied overall because of good college infrastructure, placements, understanding seniors, etc.
reviews.review_text: Recently new meta building is built. So its more spacious now. Library, classrooms, and labs are of course on top notch. The labs and lab assistant teachers are also good. Real issue is with Wi-Fi. In most of campus area, there are a lot of network as well as Wi-Fi issues. About hostel, its not less than home. Mess food is a little messed up. But its better than other colleges' mess. There are two canteens in the college. The meta canteen is good. But both canteens are a bit suffocating.

reviews.review_heading: Helpful faculty, updated syllabus, and easy-to-clear exams make COEP a great engineering college.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi network is good on the hostel campus but poor in college campus, especially in labs. There is no Wi-Fi and also no network. Food quality is very good in mess and the canteen of the hostel is poor. Sports facilities are very good. Big ground is there for COEP. Students and doctors are available in hostel. Gym facilities are also for both boys and girls.

reviews.review_heading: College is really good. No worries about passing the exams.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available 24X7. Labs are fully equipped. Classrooms and library are excellent. Cafeterias and canteens are there on both college and hostel campus. Many fests are organized throughout the year. Students here are very exceptional. If you end up here, you will make a really good friend circle.

reviews.review_heading: Value for money and placement is 100%.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and facilities are top-notch. The classrooms are too good and a very good environment to study. We also have a sports club near the academic complex where classes happen. There is a well-furnished library with Wi-Fi all over in college with range. There are many facilities here.

reviews.review_heading: Review of College of Engineering, Pune.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are large. Classrooms have all digital services. It has 24-hour Wi-Fi, libraries, computer labs, etc. The quality of facilities is average. There are so many games in COE. Zest Fest is the largest sports event conducted in Maharashtra after IIT Bombay, so sports facilities are above average in our college.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has very good placements in 2024 and infrastructure is also good.
reviews.review_text: In our college, labs, classrooms, and library have good structure. The seating arrangement is also very good. We have good internet access Wi-Fi is available 24 hours. College hostels are out of campus but hostel facilities are very nice. Their mess has good quality food.

college_info.intro:
Punjab University offers various Certificate, Diploma, Undergraduate, Postgraduate, and PhD programmes in multiple streams such as Business and Management Studies, Accounting and Commerce, Arts (Fine/ Visual/ Performing), Design, Engineering, Humanities and Social Sciences, Law, Medicine, and Health Sciences, and Science, and so on. Punjab University offers these courses in full-time mode for the duration of 2 to 5 years. PUCHD fee structure includes tuition fees ranging from INR 480 to INR 6.19 Lakh. The highest and average packages offered to the Engineering batch 2025 was INR 24 LPA and INR 8.51 LPA , respectively. More than 100 companies took part in the placement drive. There were 356 job offers made during the Punjab University UIET placements 2025. The students of the MBA batch 2025 secured the highest package of INR 24 LPA and the average pacage of INR 12.43 LPA in 2025.

Earlier, as per the media reports, the highest and average package offered during Panjab University MBA placements 2023 was INR 58.48 LPA and INR 13.7 LPA , respectively. The MBA placement rate recorded during Panjab University placements 2023 was 91.3%.

faqs.question: How many offers are made during Panjab University UIET placements?
faqs.answer: More than 100 companies took part in the Punjab University UIET placements 2025 and offered 356 job offers to the students. Some of the top recruiters include Samsung, Infosys, KPMG, Deloitte, Adobe, etc.

faqs.question: How are Panjab University MBA placements?
faqs.answer: Punjab University offers decent placements annually to its MBA graduates. In 2025, the highest and average packages offered to the MBA batch 2025 was INR 24 LPA and INR 12.43 LPA, respectively. The median package offered was INR 12 LPA.

faqs.question: What is the MBA application fee of PUCHD?
faqs.answer: The application fee for MBA at Panjab University Chandigarh is INR 2,710 for General category candidates. Panjab University offers two-year MBA programmes across four specialisations via the University Business School and across seven specialisations via the University Institute of Applied Management Sciences . Other than these, Dr. S. Bhatnagar University Institute of Chemical Engineering and Technology offers an Integrated BE (Chemical) - MBA to the students. For the application fee of UIAMS and Dr. SS Bhatnagar, candidates can refer to their official websites.

faqs.question: How expensive is MBA at Panjab University?
faqs.answer: The total fee for MBA ranges between INR 42,700 and INR 6.20 lakh. This information is sourced from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change. For more details and fee break-up for MBA at PU, candidates are advised to reach out to the admission office of Panjab University or the MBA-affiliated college of PU. Other than the course fee, students are required to pay the registration fee for CAT or PU MET exam depending on their admission process The application fee is INR 3,250 at UBS and INR 2,175 (PU MET) for General category candidates.

faqs.question: What was the average package offered during Panjab University MBA placements?
faqs.answer: The overall average package offered during Panjab University MBA placements 2023 is not released. However, the average package offered during PU UBS Chandigarh placements 2023 stood at INR 13.7 LPA. Earlier, the average package offered during PU UBS Chandigarh placements 2022 and 2021 stood at INR 10.13 LPA and INR 8.10 LPA, respectively.

faqs.answer: More than 100 companies took part in the placement drive of Punjab University BTech placements 2025. The top recruiters include Amazon, Deloitte, Samsung, Adobe, Adani Group, Tech Mahindra, KPMG, Bain & Company, Optum, etc.

faqs.question: What is the total fee for Panjab University BA course?
faqs.answer: Panjab University BA fees include various components such as tuition fees, security deposit, hostel fees, etc. Candidates who get admission to the BA/ BA (Hons) programme across any specialisation are required to pay the following fees: Fee Components Amount (Three-Year/ Four-Year) Tuition Fee INR 480 - INR 2 lakh Hostel Fee INR 1,980 - INR 57,540 One-Time Fee INR 1,230 Note: This information is sourced from official website/ sanctioning body and is subject to change.

faqs.question: How much is the course fee for Panjab University Chandigarh BTech?
faqs.answer: Panjab University Chandigarh BTech is a UG level programme, offered in full-time mode. The University offers BTech in various specialisations such as Chemical Engineering, CSE, Food Technology, Mechanical Engineering, EEE and many others. Admission to any of the specialisations is offered based on merit and entrance. Therefore, candidates must qualify Class 12 with a minimum aggregate of 50% and secure valid scores in accepted entrance exams such as JEE Main, JAC Chandigarh, PSEB 12 etc.. The fee structure of BTech contains tuition fees ranging from INR 92.5 K to INR 6.2 Lakh . For the total course fees, candidates must enquire about the hostel fees, one-time payment and various other components.

Panjab University is one of the most popular institutes of the country. Most of the ranking bodies, both national & international, have recognised this institute as one of the popular choices among students. nirf.description:
Based on the rankings from NIRF, Panjab University outperformed numerous other institutes, securing a higher position, indicating that the institute is considered to be doing better in various factors evaluated by the NIRF ranking system. In the 'Overall' category, the institute's ranks have displayed instability in comparison with last year's ranking. In 2025, Panjab University climbed 3 ranks to #57 rank in the 'Overall' category by the NIRF ranking.
It has been observed that the institute has displayed a fluctuating trend in the 'University' category as compared to the ranking of preceding years. In 2025, Panjab University climbed 3 ranks to #35 rank in the 'University' category by the NIRF ranking.
In the 'Engineering' category, the institute's ranks have shown a fluctuation when compared with the previous year's ranking. In 2025, Panjab University climbed 8 ranks to #93 rank in the 'Engineering' category by the NIRF ranking.
The institute's ranks in the 'Management' category; have shown a fluctuation when evaluated against previous year's ranking. In 2025, Panjab University's rank is #92, the same as last year's rank in the 'Management' category by the NIRF ranking.

It can be seen that the Panjab University's rankings in 'Top Global Universities' category have displayed a fluctuating trend as per the ranks of the previous years. reviews.review_heading: Please don't consider this.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are just natural saunas. Just walk 5 minutes you’ll complete the campus tour. The labs and library are decent. Sports facilities are barely accessible. Never saw a medical facility here, so don’t know. Hostels are really small but decent. Don’t get food from that canteen.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by University Institute of Engineering and Technology, Panjab UniversityReviewed on 17 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: The college is top-notch choice if you want a balance of everything in life.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are well maintained, with a few having AC. Hostels are top-notch with all facilities and no restrictions. Hostel staff is also very good. The hostels are well maintained. There are too many hostels, and students have the choice to choose according to their needs.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2024Offered by Post Graduate Government CollegeReviewed on 16 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: A practical and student-friendly college.
reviews.review_text: The college has very good infrastructure and is one of the bigger colleges under Panjab University. The classrooms are big and have blackboards as well as smartboards for good audio-visual aids. There is also a library that has a wide range of books available. Hostel facilities are available for both boys and girls with decent facilities. Medical facilities are also available.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2025Offered by Post Graduate Government CollegeReviewed on 5 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: The college and students are too good. The environment of the college is positive.
reviews.review_text: There are 3 computer labs in the college. It provides a good network connection. The mess in the hostel is okay. The canteen provides food at an affordable price. It has Nescafé, Verka, and juice corners in the college for students and teachers. There are sports rooms with different games.

reviews.batch: Batch of 2026Offered by Govt Arts and Science CollegeReviewed on 2 Jan 2026)
reviews.review_heading: My college feels average to me.
reviews.review_text: As I am studying B.Sc. Chemistry, we need labs, which are only about 50% okay, with limited equipment. Wi-Fi is available only on the ground floor. The classrooms are spacious, but the library is poor, as it is usually closed even though it is a single room. Food availability is good. Currently, there is no hostel facility, and medical facilities are poor. Sports and games are also not very engaged in our college.

The hostel also has every facility, like stocked shops. University campuses have a separate gym for women and a swimming pool as well.

reviews.review_heading: Not a great college, but decent.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure, but it lacks placement.
reviews.review_text: No doubt, the infrastructure is very good, they have invested a lot in the infrastructure. The labs and classrooms are all up to the mark. They have a smart screen for each class. But the only bad thing is the hostel's mess food, which is of the worst quality. The hostel rooms are fine.

reviews.review_heading: It's an average college, but you can still consider it.
reviews.review_text: Circular infrastructure is pretty good, with proper air-conditioned classrooms, comfortable seats, proper workbenches, equipment, and machinery available for a good hands-on experience. All the computers that are provided in the laboratories are high-end for simulations and AIML. There are many clubs that can help in gaining experience. Hostel facilities are below average, although some new hostels have been constructed. The condition of the old one is the worst, and the mess is a nightmare. The...

reviews.review_heading: You can take admission in this college.
reviews.review_text: The campus is very good, neat and clean, and the campus is fully Wi-Fi enabled. The classrooms are also very good, in fact, many of the classrooms are fully air-conditioned. The library is also very good, you can borrow books from the library. The food is called average. The medical facility is also very good here, with 24*7 ambulance service of the university.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with faculty. Placements are average. If you study hard, you can get placed.
reviews.review_text: Many hostels are good. Many are not that good, so they can be called average. The course is nice, and Wi-Fi and library are good. Medical facilities and an ambulance are always available. The canteen is not good at all. In sports, not all sports are good because of the players, but the volleyball team is at the state level. Everything is good, but there is no good food in or outside the campus unless you cook by yourself.

reviews.review_heading: Can't say that it's a bad college, just needs improvement in its environment.
reviews.review_text: The hostel facility is quite good with different categories, single bed, 2 bed, 3 bed, 4 bed and more, with the hostel fees according. The Wi-Fi is available in the hostel. The food in the hostel mess is manageable, like not very good, but also will not make you sick, it's like tasteless food without salt. The non-veg served in the mess is quite good and is prepared well. The classroom and labs are very good with the latest equipment and top-notch facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied the faculty and facilities good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good. Classes and labs are the only things that are worth it in college. Mostly the EE lab is worthwhile because it has lots of good and quality machines. Mess food is not so good for protein its only for being alive. One good thing is that it has 1 cricket and 1 football ground. There are opportunities for indoor games also which are organised by their own clubs.

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied with teaching faculty, very much worried about placement, and infrastructure is good.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available everywhere on campus. It has a digital classroom. Library is good but non-AC. Labs are not good enough. Food quality is average. Hostel rooms are very congested. The bad thing is that there are no medical facilities on the campus. Sports and games are good.

reviews.review_heading: My experience with CGU is great and enriching.
reviews.review_text: Facilities here are very satisfactory and of high quality. It has a CAD lab, which is very useful for students interested in 3D and 2D design. There are many computer labs for CSE students to do programming. There is a BEE lab to learn about electrical and electronics courses. Wi-Fi is available on the campus. The food at the canteen is good, but there are not many varieties. There is also a food court. A dispenser provides free basic primary treatment, and there is a free ambulance facility.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent decision for any individual thinking about joining this college.
reviews.review_text: It has excellent infrastructure with Wi-Fi, AC, study table, individual desks for study, and individual godrej for keeping things. There are digital classrooms with high-quality benches and AC classrooms. Wi-Fi is enabled.

reviews.review_heading: Above average, if you do not get any GFTI or any other good private college then you can opt for it.
reviews.review_text: Classes are good. Wi-Fi is available across all campus, but runs smoothly in hotels. AC is available in labs. Classroom have smart and white boards both. Hotels are as per your requirement. If you give more money then you will get good faculty members. Mess food is average.

reviews.review_heading: In short, the college is a good choice for you for your UG course for the next 4 years.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are maintained well and ventilated, most CS labs are air conditioned, and Wi-Fi conditions are good, but they need to be improved. The mess food is good, but it also needs to be improved. Moreover, the hostel rooms are also well maintained and in line with modern architecture.

reviews.review_heading: For B.Tech, it’s a good college, not the best, but good.
reviews.review_text: In my opinion, hostel and mess food is good. I’ve seen on social media that some say the college food is the worst, but I think it’s good. They need to add some variety, like milk, tea, extra snacks, or a better morning breakfast, sometimes they give only one dosa, which is very little in quantity, not taste.

reviews.review_heading: Well, my college is an average college with some good faculty.
reviews.review_text: Well, our classrooms are fully air-conditioned, and we have many labs in our ECE department, we have an average-sized library with a moderate Wi-Fi connection, the hostels are good, fully air-conditioned, and even have a badminton court inside. The food is okay, but not good enough.

reviews.review_heading: Incredibly satisfied with college infrastructure, its academic, its placement in 2025, really good.
reviews.review_text: I tell you, all across Odisha, the best infrastructure for classes or hostel is holding C V Raman College. The girls hostel has already a lot of facilities like shopping complex, stationery shops, and all shops within it. Boys hostel has same again things, parallel consisting of gaming areas, sports complex inside hostel. Now, talking about the college premises and infrastructure that holds academic, it's excellent. You will have all AC classes, fully digital, new methods, really good.Now talkin...

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities, but still something needs to be improved, like mess food.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are more than enough. Bus facilities are available for students belonging to CTK and BBSR. Library is present, and anyone can borrow books. AC classrooms are there. AC labs are there. Mess food is below average. Washrooms are clean and don't smell bad.

faqs.question: How to take admission for M.Tech at IIITM Gwalior?
faqs.answer: IIITM Gwalior offers a two-year M.Tech course at the postgraduate level. IIITM Gwalior admission to the MTech  course usually starts in the month of March-April after the GATE exam result declaration. The final selection is based on the GATE scores followed byCCMT counselling. The centralised CCMT counselling process for offering admission to M.Tech is done through online mode. Selected candidates have to further report at the institute to complete formalities for admission confirmation.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, strong academics, and decent placements at IIIT, Gwalior.
reviews.review_text: The department has well-equipped labs, smart classrooms, a library, and campus-wide Wi-Fi. Hostels are decent with basic facilities, food quality is average, medical care is available, and sports facilities support indoor and outdoor games and others.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the facilities provided, and the placement is really good and improving every year.
reviews.review_text: The hostels for first-year students are more recently built, hence are better than any college compared. The hostels that are allotted for the later-year students are old. There are lots of things which don't meet the expectations, like the old fan connections and all. The mess is pretty decent for all hostels. Wi-Fi and LAN connections sometimes have a few little fluctuations, like any other college, but overall, they are nice.

reviews.review_heading: First established the IIIT under the MOE.
reviews.review_text: We have a library with AC equipped in it, and we also have a Wi-Fi-enabled campus reaching 50 Mbps in the worst areas. Labs are very well-equipped, and the computer lab is the best of all, having the best configuration of systems and almost more than 200 PCs of that configuration that are very easily accessible.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure and placements.
reviews.review_text: Library is very good. All kinds of books are available there, and you can also issue books for yourself. Wi-Fi routers are provided, and internet speed is also quite good. Classrooms are air-conditioned. Labs are also maintained properly. Food is not as good as it should be, and in mess after sometimes quality degrades. There are 3 canteens where you can eat. Medical facilities are available. There is a doctor present at his time, and you can consult him in case of small injuries.

reviews.review_heading: Large campus area, top-notch placements, hostels and mess food can be improved.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good, but the boys hostels are not so good because the hostels require renovation as they get older. All the necessary facilities are available for living in hostels, like Wi-Fi (sometimes there may be some problem but mostly good with upto 80-90 Mbps speed), classrooms are fully air-conditioned with proper sitting arrangements, and library is also there, which is also fully air-conditioned. Mess food is okay. Medical facilities are available, whenever required. All the sports ...

reviews.review_heading: Fantastic placements in 2025, but I am dissatisfied with the hostel.
reviews.review_text: We have a huge library and labs for each professor and their research. We also have Wi-Fi in hostels and in the academic block, where all the departments and lecture halls are present. We have various types of classrooms of differing capacities, ranging from 60 to 200, some of which have plug points at each seat. Each classroom is enabled by Wi-Fi. The first-year hostel is very good, and the hostels from the 2nd year onwards are average. The mess quality keeps varying, but it is mostly good. The...

reviews.review_heading: Strong academics and good placements, but infrastructure and campus life need improvement.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not very good, but as this is the oldest IIIT, it has the infrastructure of 1997, so it’s pretty old. New hostels are definitely good and well-equipped, while the old ones are okay. There are also some hostels in progress, which seem pretty good. The library is very good, and the classrooms have AC installed.

reviews.review_heading: IIIT Gwalior - A perfect college.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good; a new hostel is also under construction and is expected to be completed by 2026. A new hospital is also being built. We have a huge college divided into two parts: Pockets A and Pockets B, connected with an underpass. The infrastructure is very cool. In the hostel, we get 24/7 internet, also wireless, so you are always connected to the internet. Coolers are allowed, and we have fully air-conditioned lecture halls, classrooms, and a library.

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied, as it provides good campus life, lovely fests, active clubs, excellent placements, etc.
reviews.review_text: I would say the infrastructure is old. The obvious reason is this is the oldest IT, so the buildings are pretty old. But the interior of the academic buildings is good. Also, the library is very nice here. With its infrastructure and vast variety of books, this library has everything you need. Hostels are a little on the low side. For first-year students, hostels are pretty good, but after the first year, you get either single or double sharing rooms. The rooms are okay, not so good I would say,...

reviews.review_heading: Average plus a good college.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available are Wi-Fi, labs, air-conditioned classrooms, and a big library named LRC. Mess food is average. There is a big sports complex, a cricket ground, a swimming pool, and many clubs.

reviews.review_heading: Don't expect much; you will be disappointed and good in terms of placement.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms and library are good. Many useful books are available in the library. Labs are okay, average. Hostel is not much good but adjustable. No Wi-Fi is good here, and the mess food is bad; it's below average. The sports club is good, and it's okay for playing sports. Canteens are available to eat your favourite food. Canteens are also not the best but average.

reviews.review_heading: Really happy to take the course. Also happy to see the placements of this year.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is well maintained. All the rooms and labs are air conditioned. We have WiFi at our hostels and classes. We have full access to them. Sometimes the internet is not stable. Overall, it works fine. The food quality totally depends upon the mess committee. Sometimes responses are taken late. There are also cases of food poisoning as well.

reviews.review_heading: Good college but sometimes regret choosing this college because of a few circumstances.
reviews.review_text: The buildings are a bit old. Well, there are a total of 5 hostels for boys and one hostel for girls. Among the five hostels there are two for the first years of B.Tech and the remaining three are for the second, fourth, and fifth years and M.Tech and Ph.D. students.

reviews.review_heading: The institute has a peaceful vibe and is quite big compared to other IIITs.
reviews.review_text: First-year students got a separate hostel called SATPURA, which is situated just outside the main campus. It's a 3-seater hostel. Wi-Fi, particularly in hostels, is very poor; we get very low internet speed. The library building is quite big but has books only related to the courses available, as it has much space to accommodate more books. Classrooms and labs are quite good.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty members and placements. Average in mess and Wi-Fi.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is not so good. It lags too much, labs are well-equipped and have all the things that are required for doing any experiments. Classrooms are too good, they have comfy seats, a central AC system, projectors, and good sound system. Mess food is average but canteen food is way better than it. Colleges have several canteens that provide both vegetarian and non-vegetarian food to students at a minimal cost. Medical facilities are good, they have all types of medicines. If they do not have a sol...

individual_reviews.title: Absolutely the best placements in 2023.

content.Placements: Students become eligible from 7th semester. Companies like Amazon DeShaw Salesforce Deloitte etc visit here. They respectively take a good number of students. The highest package offered is 80LPA by DeShaw and average package is around 13 to 15LPA. 93 percent of students are placed. I am also planning to sit in the placements and go into the development field.
content.Infrastructure: In hostel we get a basic room with 3 to 4 people sharing with basic facilities. There are no AC rooms and there are common washrooms. Meal quality is good and it serves cuisines from pan india. Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. Labs are good all apparatus used in industry is available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Good location, nice atmosphere.

content.Placements: Students become eligible from the 7th semester. Companies like Amazon, DeShaw, Salesforce, Deloitte, etc., visit here, and they respectively take a good number of students. The highest package was 80 LPA by DeShaw, and the average package is around 13 to 15 LPA. 93% students are placed. I am also planning to sit in the placements and go into the development field.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely good campus and culture of my college.

content.Placements: Placement record is 93%. The lowest package is around 8 LPA, average is 12 LPA, and the highest is 53 LPA. individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Highly recommended college.

content.Placements: Placements are excellent. Recent years show great placement sessions for CSE placement index is 92% for mechanical, and it was 99%. paragraphs: The admission process includes the application, selection round, cutoff, merit list, and counselling. Find below the complete process aroundNIT Hamirpur admission 2025:
1: NIT Hamirpur Application Process

Students wanting to take admission at NIT Hamirpur are required to complete the application form for the course-specific entrance exam. After appearing for the respective entrance exams, candidates have to apply for the counselling process for the final seat allotment. However, candidates seeking admission to PhD courses are through the official website.
2: Selection Rounds

For its flagship BTech course, NIT Hamirpur admits students with a valid JEE Main score. Candidates are allotted seats through JoSAA Counselling. Admission to MTech is through GATE, followed by CCMT Counselling. Similarly for MSc admission, IIT JAM and CCMN Counselling are required. However, NIT Hamirpur MBA admissions are done through exams such as CAT, MAT, CMAT, etc.
3: Release of Cutoff list, Counselling & Admission Confirmation

The cutoff for BTech, MTech and MSc courses is released by the respective counselling bodies. Whereas, for MBA admission, the institute releases direct merit lists after declaring the final results of all rounds. The shortlisted candidates are then required to pay the admission fee to confirm their seats.

facilities: Hostel: NIT Hamirpur is a residential campus with eight boys' hostels and four girls' hostels. These hostels are a combination of triple-seated or four-seated rooms, while some are double occupancy as well as single occupancy rooms.

Healthcare Centre: NIT Hamirpur has its own healthcare centre to meet the basic health needs of students or anyone who is part of the system. The emergency cases are sent to the zonal hospital in Hamirpur.

Sports Complex: NIT Hamirpur has a sports facility for different indoor and outdoor sports activities. The sports complex has a ground and a courtyard where students can play cricket, football, lawn tennis, volleyball, badminton and more.

Central Library: Spread over a floor area of 3200 sqm, NIT Hamirpur has a central library with more than 1 lakh books and a plethora of scientific journals, present in both print and electronic media. The central library also has a reading room with the capacity to house 600 students at a time.

Incubation Cell: In March 2017, NIT Hamirpur entered into an agreement with the Government of Himachal Pradesh to set up an incubation cell at the campus. Incubation cell is set up in the central block building with a designated area of 64.28 sqm.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely the best placements in 2023.
reviews.review_text: In hostel we get a basic room with 3 to 4 people sharing with basic facilities. There are no AC rooms and there are common washrooms. Meal quality is good and it serves cuisines from pan india. Wi-Fi all over the campus with CCTV security. Classrooms are spacious and digitally updated. Labs are good all apparatus used in industry is available.

reviews.review_heading: Good location, nice atmosphere.
reviews.review_text: There is a large variety of books in the library related to all fields. All the classes are equipped with smart boards. There are a lot of clubs and societies. Societies function throughout the whole year, and clubs in their respective semesters. In the hostel, we get a basic room with 3-4 people sharing with basic facilities, there are no AC rooms, and there are common washrooms. Meal quality is good, and it serves cuisines from pan-India.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely good campus and culture of my college.
reviews.review_text: Our college has good infrastructure. It has great scenery in college since it is in the mountains. Building of each department is too good with proper management and all. Hostels also have better space management and mess systems for hostelers, along with night canteen facilities. Separate hostels are available for both boys and girls of each year. Lecture halls are there with all facilities like AC rooms and smart board.

reviews.review_heading: Highly recommended college.
reviews.review_text: There are very good quality hostels present in our institute. There are a total of 13 hostels in the National Institute of Technology, Hamirpur. The quality of food in our hostel is very good and is hygienic. Mess workers are corporate, and night canteens are present in every hostel. A hospital is also present in our institute.

reviews.review_heading: The natural beauty of NIT Hamirpur is so awesome. You will love it.
reviews.review_text: If you are a fresher, then your hostel is KBH (Kailash Boys Hostel). Hostels are so awesome, but you will see some monkeys. Monkeys are not as harmful as you think. The one thing is that there are three to four LAN cables in each room. If your LAN is not working, then you can also use Wi-Fi, which is very fast and unlimited. The library is also open for you, but till 8:00 PM in the first year. When you become a senior, you will get HBH hostel and library up to 12:00 AM. All classrooms have a dig...

reviews.review_heading: Best weather, strict faculty, trips are absolutely heaven, and more than average placements.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available in the hostel, library, and lecture halls. The library is central, fully air-conditioned, and has blowers in winters. Departments are really nice except the MNC department, which has only classrooms and not exactly a separate department. Hostels are quite nice and get lenient as you move to higher years. Mess food is more than good except in HBH boys hostel. Ground and SAC are there for extracurricular activities, sports, and games, and the gym is also there, separate for girl...

reviews.review_heading: NIT Hamirpur College review.
reviews.review_text: The hostel and mess are good enough to manage. Wi-Fi is available in classrooms, and LAN is available in hostel rooms. We can get anything you want on campus only. Classrooms are well-ventilated, and every classroom has a projector. There is a big stadium for cricket and football, and an indoor stadium for badminton.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, NIT, Hamirpur is the best.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available in our college are so good, as there are furnished labs, a good library, classrooms with a projector that are air conditioned, a lecture hall, and a library. Due to the quality of food being average, I prefer to choose a hostel because in a hostel, the food is average in mess. You can even see it, but anyway, do choose a hostel over mess food.

reviews.review_heading: Perhaps the best college you can get at this rank.
reviews.review_text: Hostel facilities are decent, with some issues. The food is generally good with some exceptions. Major issues can be shortage of water during rainy season which causes a lot of problems. The issue is that there are mostly 4 seater rooms till third and single seater rooms available only for fourth-year students. The lab facilities are good, and there are more than enough opportunities for those who try to get them.

reviews.review_heading: Beautiful engineering college.
reviews.review_text: Beautiful and green campus location, and there is Wi-Fi all over the campus, you will stay connected near the department building, hostel, and library. Talking about the library, it is quite good, I'll say, and provides every facility that is necessary. Hostel food is, I'll say, average, not too good, and there are medical facilities 24/7 and a health centre within the campus.

reviews.review_heading: Good off-campus placement, decent overall.
reviews.review_text: Department infrastructure is great, but hostel infrastructure depends on blocks. Some blocks of hostel have good quality services, but others don't have proper cleaning, and some are even broken. There is a library, Wi-Fi is also available, however, it is pretty slow in some areas. Labs are good, and so are the classrooms (1st year lecture hall is a bit bad as it doesn't have AC, but later it gets good). Food in Kailash Boys Hostel (1st year hostel) is good except dinner (Only sweets are good in...

reviews.review_heading: NIT, Hamirpur college shiksha review by Abhivadan Chandel.
reviews.review_text: This college has the best infrastructure facilities available and uses high-quality products, and many things are the same as those in multiple colleges. In this college, canteen food is also good and hygienic. This college has available facilities like a classroom, a bathroom, labs, Wi-Fi, a lift, a campus, an auditorium, etc.

reviews.review_heading: NIT Hamirpur engineering course admission taken in 2025-26.
reviews.review_text: in this course, there are many facilities available for the student, like a classroom, a bathroom, a library, auditorium, CCTV, a canteen, hostel, etc. facilities are available. in this college, the canteen food is very tasty and hygienic, and many sports and games are organized every year.

reviews.review_heading: The college campus is really beautiful.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course are extremely good. A large library is present on the college campus with proper study arrangements. The quality of facilities available in the hostel is also very good. The campus is very beautiful.

reviews.review_heading: A very beautiful college campus.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Hamirpur is a clean and eco-friendly district. There are 4 separate hostels, each for boys and girls. A sports facility was present. Guest rooms, LED TVs, Water coolers, geysers, etc, were also available.

STEP 1: SOT PDEU Application Process 2025SOT PDEU admission process

Candidates who are applying for All India Quota seats for BTech and MTech need to register on the official website of the university. For Government seats, aspirants must apply on the official website of TheAdmission Committee for Professional Courses (ACPC)Gujarat. For all other courses, aspirants need to apply on the official website of SOT PDEU. Aspirants need to pay an application fee to register for a course.
STEP 2: Selection

SOT PDEU selects candidates for most of the programmes based on entrance exam scores. The school acceptsJEE Mainfor BTech andGATEfor MTech programmes. Non-GATE-qualified candidates are selected based on personal interview rounds. SOT conducts written tests for MSc and PhD programmes. For BSc, selection is based on merit in the last qualifying exam and performance of the candidates in the personal interview round.
STEP 3: Merit List and Admission Confirmation

The university releases a merit list based on the performance of the candidates in the selection rounds. The seats in BTech and MTech programmes are offered under All India Quota and ACPC Quota. Selected candidates need to pay theSOT PDEU feeto confirm their seats.

reviews.review_heading: Life at PDEU is comfy, and education is good.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are available. There are good classrooms, all classrooms are well ventilated, good seats, comfy environment, a projector, every student gets their personal charging point and Wi-Fi, there are two big libraries in PDEU with all the books you know.

reviews.review_heading: Greater infrastructure of the college.
reviews.review_text: We have clean and big classroom for study. The nature of the campus is very friendly and familiar. Hostel and mess also have great facilities, like our hostel has Wi-Fi, hot water, attached bathroom, etc. All these facilities are given to us at this college. They also have facilities like library, computer lab, physics and chemistry labs, which are really helpful for our studies.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with AC classrooms and a big campus with different clubs and activities.
reviews.review_text: Facilities are good and the best infrastructure among colleges in Gujarat. Library having AC, Wi-Fi, computer, book, etc., for study. Mess and canteen food is good, medical, and sports facilities are best. All types of indoor and outdoor sports are available for students.

reviews.review_heading: 50 shades of PDEU, which describe PDEU.
reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is very new and good for studying and living. There are many places to spend time relaxing with friends. There is also apple lab in our college which is very good. Mess and hostel are very good compared to any other college hostel. There are medical facilities, sports, games, and mess facility provided by the college.

reviews.review_heading: Great placements, awesome infrastructure, and supportive faculty. I'm loving my college experience.
reviews.review_text: The facilities at my university are amazing. We've got Wi-Fi all over campus, and the labs are super equipped with industrial-level machinery. The classrooms are comfortable and have smart boards. The library's huge, with tons of books and digital resources. The hostels are pretty cool too. It has AC, and the food is good. We've got a medical clinic on campus, and the sports complex is awesome, with courts for basketball, football, and more. The gym is well-equipped, and there are plenty of extr...

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college and has great placements.
reviews.review_text: PDEU has 2 hostels. UG for 1st and 2nd year students and High Rise for 3rd and 4th year students. All rooms have 3 sharing. All rooms are provided with high-speed Wi-Fi. High Rise has many grounds, a basketball court, and a badminton court. The mess food is average. It is not bad, but it is not super good either. PDEU has a huge campus and many labs equipped with the latest tech, a huge library with all the required books for the courses. All classrooms have AC, projectors, and good benches.

reviews.review_heading: Life at Pandit Deendayal Energy University.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms, Wi-Fi, library, open areas, washrooms, and labs are all very good in condition. Especially labs are fully working and well-equipped with instruments and required equipment. Talking about the mess food, it is good, healthy, and a little bit tasty.

reviews.review_heading: The college is great for studying and has a great campus and social life.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are great. Each hostel room has an AC and there is no electricity bill. It is filled with greenery and has a gym and a badminton court. It has a ton of places to hang out with friends. The infrastructure of the campus is great too. There is an entire separate sports complex for playing.

reviews.review_heading: The college provides the best facilities and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: In our college, there are facilities like free Wi-Fi, well equipments in labs, and all labs have advanced machinery. The computer lab has an i7 system, which we can use at any time. The classrooms are very neat and clean, and create a learning environment. PDPU has 3 libraries for different streams, like SOT, SLS, and SOM, with enough books available in physical and on the PDPU library website. All the facilities available in PDPU like a mess, hostel, and sports. There is 1 cricket ground, footb...

reviews.review_heading: All you need to know before taking admission in PDEU.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure at PDEU is top-notch with the latest equipment, labs, and amenities. Hostels in PDEU have modern infrastructure including air conditioning. The quality of the mess food in PDEU is above average, with a variety of food being served along with a grievance redressal system.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with the placements, faculty, campus life, and the excellent infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: The university has multiple computer labs equipped with the latest hardware and software, including an Apple lab for advanced projects and research. The library is well-stocked with a vast collection of books, journals, and digital resources to support students' academic needs.

reviews.review_heading: PDEU is one of the best colleges in Gujarat for CSE students, and its facilities are good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of PDEU is the best. They provide Wi-Fi across the entire campus area. The campus is clean, tobacco-free, and full of greenery. Each lab and classroom has AC and projectors. The library also has AC and a collection of books. Hostels, a canteen, and medical facilities are available on campus. There are sports grounds, including a volleyball court, football field, cricket ground, badminton court, and more.

reviews.review_heading: Really good college placement and the infrastructure is very good.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the University is also very good there is a library as well as on campus. Which helps students to provide a good environment for the study. There are also good facilities for the mess and also the canteen there is also a good sports complex in the university there are some sports events in the university.

reviews.review_heading: PDEU - A perfect balance of academic life and extracurricular opportunities.
reviews.review_text: PDEU infrastructure has high-speed internet everywhere on the campus. The campus is clean and green. The air here is very fresh. The flora and greenery on the campus are maintained on regular basis. There are many places where we can hangout with friends. Mess and canteen provide a good quality of food. I am a local light so I don't know about the hostel facilities. But I have heard from my friends that the hostels are affordable and provide good facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Inside life of PDEU, must join.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are very good, and the infrastructure of the college is also very nice. There is greenery everywhere, and NAAC also rated PDEU as A+ recently. The labs are good, and the whole campus has PDEU Wi-Fi. The hostel facilities are decent, and the mess and campus food is hygienic.
