individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: It has poor management and poor facilities.

content.Placements: I am from the 2021-2025 B.Tech Civil Engineering batch from NIT Puducherry. Our class strength is 25, out of which 10 students got placed in the 2025 campus recruitment. Companies like Sobha and L&T visit the college for recruitment. The highest package offered is 13 LPA this year (2025) in our batch.
content.Infrastructure: NIT Puducherry has 2 boys' hostels and 1 girls' hostel. There is a sharing problem as freshers need to adjust 4 boys per room and 3 girls per room. Senior students need to share with 3 or 2, depending on the availability of the room. There is no single room available in this college. There is poor management, and if anything gets damaged or a Wi-Fi problem occurs, it takes nearly a week to get solved. It has a poor quality mess and canteen. Limited items are available on campus. Mostly, students go out to eat, which is 10 KM away from campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: EEE Graduate from NITPY, it is still developing.

content.Placements: People were placed with an average salary of around 7 LPA in EEE. Companies like Hitachi, Nexturn, L&T, and QBit Labs came for recruitment. The placement season is not over yet. A few people got into ABB. The roles offered were Graduate Trainee, Data Analyst, and Software Developer.
content.Infrastructure: It's under construction; a lot of facilities are yet to be established. Currently, there are two boys' hostels and a girls' hostel. One of the boys' hostels is air-conditioned, and the second hostel has good facilities. Mess services are average, and the food-providing service maintains cleanliness and hygiene.

reviews.review_heading: It has poor management and poor facilities.
reviews.review_text: NIT Puducherry has 2 boys' hostels and 1 girls' hostel. There is a sharing problem as freshers need to adjust 4 boys per room and 3 girls per room. Senior students need to share with 3 or 2, depending on the availability of the room. There is no single room available in this college. There is poor management, and if anything gets damaged or a Wi-Fi problem occurs, it takes nearly a week to get solved. It has a poor quality mess and canteen. Limited items are available on campus. Mostly, students...

reviews.review_heading: EEE Graduate from NITPY, it is still developing.
reviews.review_text: It's under construction; a lot of facilities are yet to be established. Currently, there are two boys' hostels and a girls' hostel. One of the boys' hostels is air-conditioned, and the second hostel has good facilities. Mess services are average, and the food-providing service maintains cleanliness and hygiene.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Puducherry - National Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text:
We have three computer labs with all the software that is required for our practice and development of our knowledge and we have a library that consists of many books that are useful for students. 
Our hostel is a little bit messy, but when it comes to food, it is adjustable.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Puducherry- National Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The facilities in our college are average because it was constructed only 4 years ago. The Wi-Fi will be there strongly sometimes, and the Wi-Fi will be there very little sometimes, so it is difficult for us to use the internet. The food qualities will be bad.

reviews.review_heading: All about NIT Puducherry.
reviews.review_text: The facilities given in classrooms are good enough. There are 10 fans in every classroom with good ventilation. There is good Wi-Fi network everywhere in the Science block where classes are going on. The library contains every textbook included in our course. Hostel rooms are good.

reviews.review_heading: Don't judge a college by its tag.
reviews.review_text: In terms of infrastructure, this college is worse. Currently, it is in the developing phase. Wi-Fi is lower-band, classrooms are not AC-fitted, and the library is not enhanced enough to be called a central library. Only a handful of books are available there. For girls, there is AC in the hostels; it's called Moyar Hostel. For boys, we have two hostels, one in Bharali and another in Bhavani. In hostels, you will get yellow water that will help you attain your 30 quickly, because at the age of 20...

reviews.review_heading: This is a college under development.
reviews.review_text: It's currently under development. Pentagon will take 2 more years; similarly, multiple buildings are being constructed for residence. Wi-Fi is bad and classrooms are not AC-fitted. The library is primitive and the labs are not hi-tech. Very limited sports facilities are there. Here we have a single basketball court, a single badminton court, a single volleyball court and 2 volleyball courts. Foods in a mess are not up to par. They are neither nutritious nor tasty but still, they charge 23,000 pe...

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Labs and libraries are air-conditioned, and Wi-Fi facility is available throughout the campus. Classrooms are equipped with projectors. The hostel is good, with a cot, table, chair, and cupboard provided for each student. The food in the mess is okay, and medical facilities are provided 24/7.

reviews.review_heading: Highly qualified faculty and multiple placements opportunities offered to the students.
reviews.review_text: NIT Puducherry is having really good infrastructure for the computer Science course. Computer labs were available for the students programming. Library was there in the college campus with all kinds of books. Wi-Fi, hostel, canteen and other facilities were also given to the student. Multiple sports facilities were available for the students.

reviews.review_heading: Good but can be more better.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is not so bad. Since it's under construction, it is a bit difficult to walk and since our hostels are a bit far from college, it makes it difficult to walk so far. The Wi-Fi is not so good on the college campus and also in the hostel.

reviews.review_heading: Not satisfied with this college.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available here. We know but every 15 days there will be a Wi-Fi cut for 2 to 3 days. All blame goes to the hostel administration. No sports complex is there. Fairly speaking, there is no scope for sports. Canteen food is overpriced. The library is too small and does not qualify to be called a NIT library.

reviews.review_heading: Review of NIT Puducherry - National Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is under construction. No. A proper library or departmental building is there. Life here is like a boast trying to float in a desert full of cacti. Your expectation makes an angle of 180 degrees with reality. Mess. Food lacks all the essential nutrients; very soon you will face severe hairfall, a lack of vision and fatigue. Sports is a nightmare.

reviews.review_heading: A best place to have a quality education along with entertainment.
reviews.review_text: In terms of infrastructure, our college is still developing since it was established only in 2010. But infrastructure development is at its full wing. The classrooms are well facilitated and the laboratories are top class with good technician and scholars.

reviews.review_heading: I am regretting my choice.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi in college is very poor I mean very poor they are charging money of 300 per as Wi-Fi feels but the Wi-Fi speed is terrible same applies hostel but for hostel if your room is facing the Wi-Fi outer you will enjoy 4k vdo streaming without interruption otherwise oops 303 Error not found. If you are choosing this college get used to eat price without vegetables.

reviews.review_heading: My life became hell when I entered this college.
reviews.review_text:
Only moyar hostel has good facility. Bharali and bhavani hostel are like some third class government college hostel Additional there is money maniac. Money sole my friends 45 k earbuds 
Last month. So you have tocloseyour door and windows 24 hours.

paragraphs: SKCET Coimbatore admission process 2025isentrance-basedfor all the courses. Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology offersBE,BTechat the UG level, andME,MBA,MTech (Integrated)course at PG level. In addition to that, the institute also offersPhDprogramme in the streams of Engineering.

For BTech admission, candidates must have atleast 45% aggregate in Class 12 and appear forTNEA exam,while for MTech, admission is done on the basis ofGATE/ CEETA score. Interested can apply online on the official website ofSKCET Coimbatore.

SKCET Coimbatore offers a total of 21 courses across various programme levels such as UG, PG, and Doctoral.SKCET Coimbatore coursesare offered in the regular/full-time mode for the shortlisted candidates. The admission process for majority of the courses available at the talked about college is entrance-based. Learn more through the highlight table below:

Candidates seeking admission to Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology courses, must ensure that they are meeting the eligibility criteria set by the SKCET. Selection to all the courses are done on the basis of entrance exam score.
Check out the eligibility and selection criteria for Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology admission:
Eligibility
B.E. / BTech
Minimum 45 % aggregate in Class 12 with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry
Minimum 45 % aggregate in graduation
GATE, CEETA

Explore for moreSKCET courses

SKCET admission is open for admission 2025 now. Before applying, candidates must check they are meeting the eligibility criteria for their desired course. Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology admission process is conducted online.
Below are the step by step process forBTech admission at Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology:
Step 1: SKCET Application Process 2025
Candidates can find the online application form on the official website of the college. The application fee for general candidates is INR 500 and for reserved category candidates is INR 250.
Step 2: Document Verification

After completing the application process, candidates will be allotted a 10 digit random number which is required to report atTNEA facilitationcentres for document verification. Candidates must carry their original documents and photocopies during the document verification process.
Step 3: Merit-list

DOTE (conducting authority of TNEA) will prepare the merit list on the basis of the aggregate percentage secured in Physics, Chemistry and Mathematics. Candidates after appearing for the required entrance test must check the shortlist that is created by the college.
Step 4: Counselling/ Payment of Admission Fee
Candidates who are in the merit list, will be able to attend theTNEA Counsellingas per the merit. Candidates are also required to pay the fee ofINR5000(INR 1000 for SC/ST) for SKCET admission.
Step 5: SKCET Seat Allotment for BTech

DOTE will release the result of the first round - seat allotment after the choice filling round. The seats allotment will be done on the basis of the merit list prepared by DOTE, course choices, and candidates' categories.

reviews.review_heading: Faculty members are good, and there is good campus life. A lot of good people from different culture
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is too good and top-notch. The cleanliness is next level. Wi-Fi is available both in the college and the hostel. The library is one of the largest libraries in Tamil Nadu.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements, supportive environment, and excellent infrastructure for overall growth.
reviews.review_text: Campus offers excellent infrastructure with well-equipped labs, high-speed Wi-Fi, spacious classrooms, and a rich library. Hostel facilities are clean and comfortable, with 24/7 water and electricity. Mess serves decent and hygienic food with both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options.

reviews.review_heading: Life at Sri Krishna College of Engineering and Technology.
reviews.review_text: Usually, my college hostel is not worth it. The money costs around 2 lakhs which is not worth the money. Infrastructure of the course is good and good for computer science. The hostel food and rooms are not upto the standards where always a problem.

reviews.review_heading: Excellent facilities, good placements, good faculty, and an extraordinary library.
reviews.review_text: Extraordinary sports performance in zonal and inter-college events, free Wi-Fi provided in classes and hostels. Medical facilities also present in our college, and all labs with good machines, circuits, and computers. The college gives importance to players.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good choice for mechatronics with strong placements and infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Our department is well-equipped with modern labs for robotics, automation, electronics, and mechanical systems. Classrooms are spacious, air-conditioned, and Wi-Fi enabled. The central library has a good collection of technical books and journals. Hostels are well-maintained with decent rooms, 24x7 water and electricity supply. The mess food is hygienic and offers both veg and non-veg options, though it can be repetitive. Medical facilities are available on campus. There is a large ground for sp...

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: We have excellent infrastructure. For the first-year students, we provide a switch box facility to charge our laptops at our convenience, and the Wi-Fi is functioning well. Our library is the largest in any college in Asia. The hostel rooms are quite decent, and there are no issues with them. The only problem is the food.

reviews.review_heading: I love the college the most.
reviews.review_text: I love the infrastructure most. The college infrastructure is maintained properly and regularly. Classrooms are high-tech with smart boards and projectors. We have a big library which is maintained properly. I love the canteen most. I love the food I get in the canteen.

reviews.review_heading: SKCET review by Wilsonpaulraj.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure in SKCET is very good. They have modern labs and classrooms. Hostel facilities are also very good. Hostel food is edible and non-vegetarian food is not available. Sports are also focused in this college. There is a football ground, cricket nets, basketball court, tennis court, and more.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure at SKCET.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure was excellent. The classrooms were modern and had smart boards. The library was one of the largest and had a vast collection of books. This made it easy to find resources for project work or research. The canteen offered good food with decent options.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements till 2022 after that due to recession there is fall in placements.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms at this college are good and sufficient, and they are provided with all the necessary facilities. The mess and canteen facilities are very good, and they serve a good quality and variety of foods. The medical facility is average, and the boys hostel wardens are mostly friendly and supportive.

reviews.review_heading: Awesome placements, if you have skillsets then you can definitely get your dream offer.
reviews.review_text: The library at this college is the best I've ever seen. It has a wide variety of books from fiction to nonfiction. The library staff is friendly and helpful. If we can't find the book that we have been looking for the librarian will try to get it for us. The only downside is that the library rules are strict. If we don't return a book on time, we will have to pay a fine. The hostel is good.

reviews.review_heading: You have to pay extra fee for training but good placements.
reviews.review_text: The college infrastructure is good, but some things are not maintained. The hospital at the entrance to the college, called "Ramakrishna Hospital," has been closed since the day I started studying at this college. Also, there is no emergency medical facility, and the nearby hospital only accepts patients during certain hours.

reviews.review_heading: Good college for only placements
reviews.review_text: Very good infrastructure with good wifi and even laptops are being provided. The labs are good with ac and good ventilation. The mechanical and electrical labs are highly equipped and we have a big fiber ground, a tennis court and a basket ball court but sports is given 0 importance. There is no proper faculty for sports and also no support. Students who come through sports quota will have a great disappointment. The hostel is very strict with average food.

reviews.review_heading: Unfriendly faculty, regret joining skcet but good placements
reviews.review_text: College environment is good and is designed in good manner. College is full of plants, trees and flowers. Just awesome environment to study. But college hostel is not good, I hate it for being there for 2 years, absolute dissatisfaction. No emergency medical facility and warden is very strict.

reviews.review_heading: Modern campus and great placements
reviews.review_text: My college is known for the aesthetic environment and good infrastructure. Our college have great labs for industrial training. New labs were renovated in my first year which helps us to gain more knowledge. The library in our college is also large with even a digital library. The hostel in our college for boys is not so strict but for girls strict timing is followed and for going to our hometown we have get sign from hod, tutors and warden which is very complicated. The food is vegetarian only ...

college_info.intro:
Amity University Kolkata offers a variety of programmes. These courses are offreed at the graduate, postgraduate, and diploma levels. For example, the School of Engineering offers Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Computer Science & Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering.
Amity University Kolkata is famous for BTech and BSc. Mechanical Engineering students are taught construction testing, design, and operation of machines and automobiles, etc. Amity University Kolkata BSc students are taught to express and enhance the core analytical, technical, and conceptual skills that are appropriate for the hospitality industry.
Below mentioned are some of the courses offered by Amity University Kolkata and their respective eligibility, and Amity University Kolkata fee structure:

placements.overview:
Amity University Kolkata started functioning in the year 2014. It is private university, formed when the West Bengal Act of 2014 passed. The exact place of the university is Kadampukur, Kolkata, and Amity University Kolkata is the 10th university campus formed through the Amity Foundation, which is a non-profit organisation.The University has 70+ departments, and 150+ institutions and centers through which it offers 300+ programmes.

Amity University Kolkata courses are offered to students at the UG, PG, and PhD levels. The university offers various courses to students such as BTech, BSc, BBA, BCA, BCom, MTech, MPhil, MCom, MEd, MBA, etc. Kolkata Amity University has various research collaborations under its name, while it has sanctioned 30 funded projects and submitted 301+ funded projects so far.

Amity University Kolkata offers a variety of programmes. These courses are offreed at the graduate, postgraduate, and diploma levels. For example, the School of Engineering offers Electrical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Computer Science & Engineering, and Mechanical Engineering.

faqs.answer: A:    The institute offers BCA and BCA + MCA, but the tuition fees for both courses are different. faqs.answer: A:    Amity University Kolkata will offer a variety of courses in 2024 at varied tuition costs. The cost of tuition for an MBA or PGDM programme is INR 8 lakh. For students looking to pursue engineering and technology can enrol in the B.E./B.Tech programs, which have fees ranging from INR 4.3 lakh to INR 8.9 lakh. Furthermore, Amity University Kolkata offers a B.Sc. programme that ranges in tuition from INR 2.1 lakh to INR 3.9 lakh, making it an attractive option for individuals with a scientific bent. The university's dedication to providing high-quality instruction in a range of subject areas is reflected in its diverse fee structure.

reviews_list.batch_info: Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch.) - Batch of 2022
reviews_list.review_title: Professional teachers with good skills.

review_content.Placements: Some of the emerging companies like L&T, Tata Housing, Godrej, and Sobha Developers took part in the recruitment drive of our college nowadays. But during our time of recruitment, only 5 to 8 companies were involved in recruitment. Various professional architects participated in the webinars to provide some chances for doing internships with their network.
review_content.Infrastructure: College events like promotions, cultural, and technical fests are conducted twice or thrice a month. A specific set of penalties and punishments is assigned for all the wrong behavior of us. Hostel premises are liberal, but accurate records are maintained. The usage of mobile phones within specified hours is allowed.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: My experience at Amity University Kolkata is really positive.

review_content.Placements: Percentage of students getting placed is approximately 60 percent in B.Tech computer science. Generally, at Amity University Kolkata students get placed at TCS, Deloitte, EY, SAP, etc. Top role offered in my course is SDE. The highest package is 28 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA, and average is 5 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: Campus of the university is not that huge. It has spread over 15 acres of land. There are two academic blocks such as A and E blocks. The campus is located in the outer area of Kolkata. Classrooms are good. The campus is fully air-conditioned and Wi-Fi enabled. Campus has a library consists of more than 10,000 books. Different types of labs such as Matlab, seminar halls, etc., are available. There are two canteens present on the campus that serve good quality food to the students.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.A. LL.B (Hons.) - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: Amity Law School is one of the best private law schools in West Bengal.

review_content.Placements: As this is a law course, majority of students here are not first-generation lawyers and often practice with their parents. Amity provides placements in the corporate sector and is very helpful about it. I am not aware of the highest or lowest package offered. Internships are provided by the college, but there are criteria, and not everyone gets them.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is on point, and the best that money can buy. Library is huge, and an entire spare building is allotted for it. You will find all the books you can imagine. College also provides an online e-library that gives you a subscription to SCC online and manupatra.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2023
reviews_list.review_title: Infrastructure is good but academics are not good.

review_content.Placements: Around 60% of students were placed in our course. Other than this, some students were also recruited for irrelevant jobs. The average package was around 5 LPA. The highest package was about 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Accenture, Capgemini, etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Our college had world class infrastructure. It provided Wi-Fi campus, big classroom, very furnished labs, and library with lots of books. Quality of hostel was also good. Limited sports facility was available. It had basic medical facilities.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Mechanical and Automation Engineering - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely satisfied because of campus and academics, good placement for B.Tech.

review_content.Placements: More than 70% of students got placed with a median salary of Rs 50,000 monthly. The highest package was around 7 LPA last year. The lowest was 4 LPA. Average was around 6 LPA. Volvo, Manhindra & Mahindra, Reliance, and Honda were the top recruiters. 100% of students were offered internships by IT companies like TCS, Wipro, etc. Core companies like Reliance, Mahindra, and Tata. Retail, operations, and QC/QA are the top roles along with some R&D.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, functional labs, spacious classrooms, centralized library, and canteen are available. Other high-quality facilities include hostel, ATM, cafe coffee day, water coolers, elevator, centralized air conditioning, clinic, sports complex including gym and swimming pool, basketball court, cricket pitch, football field, etc.

reviews_list.batch_info: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: Great college life, average placement. Enjoyed 2 years of fests - Amity hosts the best in Kolkata.

review_content.Placements: 60-70% of students were placed in our MCA course. The highest package was 12 LPA offered by IBM, the average package was 5-6 LPA offered by some startup companies, and the lowest package ranged from 2.8 to 3.5 LPA. As far as I know, IBM was the top recruiting company. The college provides both paid and unpaid internships. For unpaid internships, you must pay the registration fees, and the same applies to paid internships. You may also receive performance-based offers or PPOs.
review_content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is easily accessible throughout the Amity campus. The labs and classrooms are very good, and I can say the library is the best I have seen compared to other colleges. The facilities in our hostel are of high quality. The food in the canteen is much better than that in other college canteens, and the prices are affordable for everyone.

review_summary.college_name: Amity University Kolkata Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Architecture (B.Arch.) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Professional teachers with good skills.

content.Placements: Some of the emerging companies like L&T, Tata Housing, Godrej, and Sobha Developers took part in the recruitment drive of our college nowadays. But during our time of recruitment, only 5 to 8 companies were involved in recruitment. Various professional architects participated in the webinars to provide some chances for doing internships with their network.
content.Infrastructure: College events like promotions, cultural, and technical fests are conducted twice or thrice a month. A specific set of penalties and punishments is assigned for all the wrong behavior of us. Hostel premises are liberal, but accurate records are maintained. The usage of mobile phones within specified hours is allowed.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: My experience at Amity University Kolkata is really positive.

content.Placements: Percentage of students getting placed is approximately 60 percent in B.Tech computer science. Generally, at Amity University Kolkata students get placed at TCS, Deloitte, EY, SAP, etc. Top role offered in my course is SDE. The highest package is 28 LPA, the lowest is 3 LPA, and average is 5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Campus of the university is not that huge. It has spread over 15 acres of land. There are two academic blocks such as A and E blocks. The campus is located in the outer area of Kolkata. Classrooms are good. The campus is fully air-conditioned and Wi-Fi enabled. Campus has a library consists of more than 10,000 books. Different types of labs such as Matlab, seminar halls, etc., are available. There are two canteens present on the campus that serve good quality food to the students.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. LL.B (Hons.) - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Amity Law School is one of the best private law schools in West Bengal.

content.Placements: As this is a law course, majority of students here are not first-generation lawyers and often practice with their parents. Amity provides placements in the corporate sector and is very helpful about it. I am not aware of the highest or lowest package offered. Internships are provided by the college, but there are criteria, and not everyone gets them.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is on point, and the best that money can buy. Library is huge, and an entire spare building is allotted for it. You will find all the books you can imagine. College also provides an online e-library that gives you a subscription to SCC online and manupatra.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Infrastructure is good but academics are not good.

content.Placements: Around 60% of students were placed in our course. Other than this, some students were also recruited for irrelevant jobs. The average package was around 5 LPA. The highest package was about 12 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Accenture, Capgemini, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Our college had world class infrastructure. It provided Wi-Fi campus, big classroom, very furnished labs, and library with lots of books. Quality of hostel was also good. Limited sports facility was available. It had basic medical facilities.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical and Automation Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied because of campus and academics, good placement for B.Tech.

content.Placements: More than 70% of students got placed with a median salary of Rs 50,000 monthly. The highest package was around 7 LPA last year. The lowest was 4 LPA. Average was around 6 LPA. Volvo, Manhindra & Mahindra, Reliance, and Honda were the top recruiters. 100% of students were offered internships by IT companies like TCS, Wipro, etc. Core companies like Reliance, Mahindra, and Tata. Retail, operations, and QC/QA are the top roles along with some R&D.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi, functional labs, spacious classrooms, centralized library, and canteen are available. Other high-quality facilities include hostel, ATM, cafe coffee day, water coolers, elevator, centralized air conditioning, clinic, sports complex including gym and swimming pool, basketball court, cricket pitch, football field, etc.

Amity University Kolkata Application

hostel_campus.college_name: Amity University Kolkata Infrastructure Details & Reviews

reviews.review_heading: Professional teachers with good skills.
reviews.review_text: College events like promotions, cultural, and technical fests are conducted twice or thrice a month. A specific set of penalties and punishments is assigned for all the wrong behavior of us. Hostel premises are liberal, but accurate records are maintained. The usage of mobile phones within specified hours is allowed.

reviews.review_heading: My experience at Amity University Kolkata is really positive.
reviews.review_text: Campus of the university is not that huge. It has spread over 15 acres of land. There are two academic blocks such as A and E blocks. The campus is located in the outer area of Kolkata. Classrooms are good. The campus is fully air-conditioned and Wi-Fi enabled. Campus has a library consists of more than 10,000 books. Different types of labs such as Matlab, seminar halls, etc., are available. There are two canteens present on the campus that serve good quality food to the students.

reviews.review_heading: Amity Law School is one of the best private law schools in West Bengal.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is on point, and the best that money can buy. Library is huge, and an entire spare building is allotted for it. You will find all the books you can imagine. College also provides an online e-library that gives you a subscription to SCC online and manupatra.

reviews.review_heading: Infrastructure is good but academics are not good.
reviews.review_text: Facilities and infrastructure available for our course were extremely good. Our college had world class infrastructure. It provided Wi-Fi campus, big classroom, very furnished labs, and library with lots of books. Quality of hostel was also good. Limited sports facility was available. It had basic medical facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied because of campus and academics, good placement for B.Tech.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, functional labs, spacious classrooms, centralized library, and canteen are available. Other high-quality facilities include hostel, ATM, cafe coffee day, water coolers, elevator, centralized air conditioning, clinic, sports complex including gym and swimming pool, basketball court, cricket pitch, football field, etc.

reviews.review_heading: Great college life, average placement. Enjoyed 2 years of fests - Amity hosts the best in Kolkata.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is easily accessible throughout the Amity campus. The labs and classrooms are very good, and I can say the library is the best I have seen compared to other colleges. The facilities in our hostel are of high quality. The food in the canteen is much better than that in other college canteens, and the prices are affordable for everyone.

reviews.review_heading: I did a master's from Amity University, Kolkata.
reviews.review_text: Amity University, Kolkata, has a huge campus and provides a lot of facilities. There are gallery classrooms, AC, Wi-Fi, a library, and labs. In total, there are 3 canteens on campus. There is also an infirmary on the campus with a nurse and a doctor present. Amity has a yearly sports fest called Sangathan.

reviews.review_heading: Really good infrastructure, and helpful faculties, but needs a bit of transparent placement process.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the hostel and college is absolutely amazing. It has top-notch facilities, with good Wi-Fi, air-conditioned classrooms, and a huge library with all kinds of books needed for courses. There are three canteens, all serving hygienic and vegetarian food. There are also many shops outside the college that serve non-vegetarian food, which can be brought into the college canteens to sit and eat.

reviews.review_heading: Everything about Amity Kolkata.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is very good, in fact, one of the best I've seen in Kolkata. Wi-Fi is provided, there are good labs and desktops, and a peaceful library, though it has fewer informative books. Medical facilities include AC rooms. The sports ground is very small, but it is encouraged through several programs such as Sangathan, which is a department-wise sports competition.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure were on point in every aspect or department like multiple A/C or Wi-Fi available, all kinds of labs and classrooms high-quality sports equipment, and facilities with skilled coaches. There was a theatre and also a cafeteria. The hostel was the best in the town with ample facilities and luxury. The food in the cafeteria was good and the most important the medical facilities were 24-hour and we got a separate infirmary.

reviews.review_heading: Eventful college life will make you fall in love with the university.
reviews.review_text: There are good facilities provided by the university. The lab, Wi-Fi, classroom, library, and canteen are top-anotch. There are 3-4 canteen and all have good food with reasonable price. The library is very well maintained. You have a quiet and personal space for each student.

reviews.review_heading: Amity University is home away from home.
reviews.review_text: There is full Wi-Fi connection on campus. The infrastructure of our college is beautiful. The college is full of greenery. Classrooms are spacious and air-conditioned. The whole college is equipped with air-conditioners. The food quality  is good and tasty and they maintain hygiene.

reviews.review_heading: Students can join this college without any hesitation.
reviews.review_text: Labs and classrooms are very well-maintained. The library is very big and peaceful. It has a sports complex and other activities. There is a basketball ground and a badminton court in the college. But we do not have any cricket ground but there we can play football in a small area.

reviews.review_heading: There are really good infrastructure and faculty members in the college.
reviews.review_text: Amity University has a library with comfortable and silent surroundings. This university has 5 blocks. The examination block is separate from other blocks and 4 blocks are for classes for different courses. The university has a sports complex with different games.

reviews.review_heading: An honest review of Amity University Kolkata.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is great starting from the Wi-Fi connection, all the items you need for labs. Classrooms are nice. The library is also well-maintained. You would get every book that you would need for your course. Hostel facilities are also awesome. The quality of the mess and canteen is also above average. There are proper medical facilities available and sports and games are given equal attention.

review_content.Placements: I am pursuing B.Tech in CSE from Amity University, Haryana. The highest package is around 15 LPA above, and the lowest package is around 3 LPA - 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies are Capgemini, TCS, Yamaha, and many startups. Role offered is software developer.
review_content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure at Amity is good with very calm environment. There are many active clubs and societies you and become part of those and explore yourself. paragraphs: Amity University Gurgaon admission is a multi-step process. Candidates seeking for getting admission to various courses of the university must apply at the official website. To admit the right candidates, the university selects students based on selection criteria, which include filling out the application form, qualifying for the selection rounds and paying for the Amity University Gurugram fees at the time of final admission.
Step 1: Amity University Gurgaon Application Process 2025

Students must fill out an application form on the official admission website of Amity University Gurugram (https://portal.amity.edu/NewOnlineForm/Candidate/SignUp). With candidates needing to fill out a separate form in case of multiple course by paying an application fee ofINR 1,100for each form. The new users are required to generate login credentials and fill out an online application form with all the relevant details and documents and submit the form on the admission portal of Amity University Gurgaon.
Step 2: Amity University Gurgaon Selection Process

Amity University Gurgaon admissions are both merit and entrance-based. For most of the UG & PG courses, candidates are selected based on merit of the last qualifying exam of previous education. Further, the shortlisted candidates have to appear for the Personal Interview round as per course requirements. The students are selected based on Amity PhD Entrance Test +Interview by Faculty Member or All India National Level Competitive Examination or NET (viz. UGC / CSIR -NET in Category 1,2 or 3, ICMR- JRF/SRF, ICAR-AICE-JRF/SRF (PhD),GATE, GPAT, DST – INSPIRE, DBT-JRF etc.
Step 3: Final Offer Letter

The final results are declared after the completion of all previous rounds. The information concerning selection will be communicated on the admission microsite as well as via Email and SMS. Selected candidates will get an admission letter along with important information such as semester fee, class commencement date, time, venue of the course, allotment of a hostel (If applied), scholarship (If any) and the list of documents required at the time of joining. Candidates also have to pay a certain amount as per theAmity University Gurugram feesstructure to secure their seats.

faqs.question: What is the fee for MBA at Amity University, Gurugram?
faqs.answer: INR 6.8 Lacs and INR 17.1 Lakh is the total fee range for the MBA programme at Amity University Gurugram. This fee amount contains a lot of factors, such as tuition fees, caution deposit, hostel and mess charges, etc. Some of these are paid once, and some are to be paid semester-wise. For eg., the caution deposit, which is paid only once and refunded later. Candidates must note that this fee is sourced from the official website of the institute/sanctioning body. It is subject to change and hence, is indicative.

faqs.question: What is the course fees of BA in Amity Gurugram?
faqs.answer: INR 1.7 Lacs to INR 10.9 Lacs is the total tuition fee for BA as per an unofficial source. Aspirants are required to pay the course fee after completion of all the selection rounds to confirm their seats. Admission to BA course is based on merit in the last qualifying exam. The university also accepts CUET UG score for providing admission to BA course. In case, a candidate is unable to pay the fee within the specified time, his or her admission will stand cancelled.

hostel_campus.college_name: Amity University Gurugram Infrastructure Details & Reviews

hostel.description:
Amity University provides air-conditioned apartment-style accommodation facility for 2100 students. The rooms are well-lit and well-ventilated, with geysers in every bathroom and TV set in the common room for entertainment.

The separate facilities for boys and girls, caring wardens and a tight security ensure a pleasant stay allowing students to focus on their academics. The air-conditioned residential apartment suites consist of 3 single rooms with an attached bathroom and sitting lounge equipped necessary furniture.

library.description:
Amity University library is an integrated knowledge resource centre that is stocked with approx 50,000 books, 20,000 journals and 2,500 publications. 

Amity students have access to Ebsco Host, UGC-Infonet, INDEST-AICTE, IS1 and Delnet. All Amity students are members of Amizone - Amity Intranet Zone which allows them easy access to these journals and papers.

These Libraries consist of Reference Sections, Circulation Sections, Audio-visual Sections, Periodical Sections and Digital Libraries.

reviews.review_heading: My review about this college.
reviews.review_text: Course curriculum is pretty appropriate, especially for students belonging to an IT background. First two semesters covered the basics of languages like C, C+. Later we learned about some advanced languages like Java, HTML, etc. There re a lot of guest lectures and workshops which are frequently organized for knowledge. Hostel facility is available and also PGs are available near the college. The room offering is good with single as well as double sharing, and the price of separate rooms is high...

reviews.review_heading: Review of Amity University, Gurugram.
reviews.review_text: The hostels are in very good condition. Very good facilities and infrastructure are available for your course and department; for example, Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a library are all very good. The quality of the facilities in hostels is very good. The quality of food is also very good.

reviews.review_heading: My review of this college.
reviews.review_text: It is great. The hostel is very comfortable with a friendly atmosphere everywhere. Students taking the AC hostel are given separate rooms with an almirah. For a non-AC hostel, the same things are given, but instead of separate rooms for students. They are given 3 sharing and 2 sharing rooms. The food quality is really good in the mess. The campus has many food outlets, which leaves no doubt in getting good food for hostellers and day scholars as well.

reviews.review_heading: Amity University Gurgaon B.Tech CSE review.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure at Amity is good with very calm environment. There are many active clubs and societies you and become part of those and explore yourself. You can also make a good connection here. There are only few places where you can get Wi-Fi. Library is one of them and college classrooms are air-conditioned. Hostel is overall good with good facilities for hostel mess. There are 2 messes at Amity and many other outlets for food. Amity has a very big sports complex timing is 1:00 PM - 2:00 PM o...

reviews.review_heading: Amity University is considered as a good university for studies.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, and all are available. Infrastructure is very good. Facilities in hostel and course are good including food of the best quality. Medical facilities are available with doctors and nurses. We have good sports ground and different games.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing procedures and life-size equipments to get a thorough knowledge of nursing.
reviews.review_text: We have atleast 4-5 different labs catering to each department and having human size models, dummies, and equipments. All the procedures and equipments to perform and practice for the future. Our hostel is a very safe and secure place having sets of 2 beds in each room, 6 students in each suite. For food, we have at least 7 different places with amazing food and a way to connect to people. Medical facilities are available 24X7. Sports events and cultural fests happen twice a year.

reviews.review_heading: College infrastructure is good and canteen food is good.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is available, classroom is ventilated, and AC is available. Number of options and variety are available. Classrooms and corridors are always clean. Washrooms are clean and hygienic. Air-conditioned classrooms are available. It provides proper uniforms for clinicals. It also provides laboratory facilities and training.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with faculty members. There are 99% placements and really good infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure of college and hostel is amazing. It has availability of Wi-Fi. Hostel provides clean and quiet environment. Hostel also has medical facilities. We also have labs, library, and classroom. Quality of food is like home and great mess is there.

reviews.review_heading: Studying here always feels like learning something new every day.
reviews.review_text: The environment of the college is very well. They provide good care to the students. Faculty members are very helpful to the students. The canteens are good and only veg and hygiene food is served. Library is also good and all new books are available.

reviews.review_heading: I feel proud as a student of Amity University Haryana.
reviews.review_text: Amity University Haryana has one of the best infrastructure, which is well-maintained in terms of lab classes, library facilities, and the list goes on. AC, non-AC rooms, water cooler, lift, study table, medical facilities, sports complex, playground, and mess food. These are some facilities which are provided to hostellers.

reviews.review_heading: Amity University provided what students needed the most.
reviews.review_text: The facility and the infrastructure are amazing. Classrooms, water facility, library, labs, and Wi-Fi facility are amazing and have all the equipment and books that are needed in the course, and every necessary thing required for the course. Hostel, if we talk about hostel, food is the first thing we have in our mind, and here the food is amazing, including other facilities too, good food quality, and medical facilities, everything is good here.

reviews.review_heading: "Great infrastructure and facilities with diverse student amenities."
reviews.review_text: The ASH department offers excellent infrastructure, including Wi-Fi-enabled campuses and modern classrooms. Hostels are comfortable, but sometimes the food isn't good, while sports facilities enhance the overall student experience, and the medical facilities are also not good in the university.

reviews.review_heading: I would recommend others take admission here, especially if they are looking for hotel management.
reviews.review_text: Students who are interested in sports will find a decent sports complex at this university, and tournaments are held at specific times of the year. Hostels are also decent, with food quality being good and offering variations. Hostels also have recreational rooms.

reviews.review_heading: A balanced college with good opportunities and campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is actually better than many universities. We have a front office lab, restaurant, kitchen, bakery lab, Wi-Fi, and a library everything. There are approximately 5-6 canteens, and they are very clean. The food is also very good and hygienic.

reviews.review_heading: The best private university in Haryana.
reviews.review_text: Clean and tidy classrooms with state-of-the-art infrastructure provide a smooth learning experience. The library is a very comfortable place to study. There are multiple cafeterias on the campus to chose from, offering a variety of meal options. A big sports complex includes sports such as tennis, basketball, badminton, football, volleyball, etc. A medical room is available in the hostel.

review_content.Infrastructure: Labs are equipped with the latest generation PCs that support almost all the latest technologies. individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Very good college, not as much as IITs or NITs.

content.Placements: 35-40% students passed this year. The highest package is 20 LPA this year, the average is 4.5 LPA, and the recruiting companies are Accenture, LNT, Tech Mahindra, TCS ninja etc. The roles are pursued as a fresher, and some students get the best post.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is very good in this college compared to other colleges. Wi-Fi is also available. Also, they provide a canteen which is very good, but it is expensive and has a limited quantity. Hostels are also provided up to 1 lac fees per year with AC and without AC. The canteen food is good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: It’s a choice to be tested out once.

content.Placements: To be precise, the number of students placed is between 25 and 30 currently, but may vary. The highest known is 19.5 LPA approximately, and the lowest is 3 LPA for non-technical roles. We have many recruitment like LTI Mindtree, Capgemini, Accenture, Salesforce, etc. The internship rate is about 35-40%. Roles vary depending on the performance represented, like data analyst, front-end developer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Good facilities for knowledge. The hostel, to be frank, can be rated between 7 and 9 out of 10. The college tries to provide the student with good facilities, to ensure it doesn't affect the student's health, maintaining good and healthy environment for the students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering (Data Science) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The real and honest review of Anurag University.

content.Placements: More than 50% of all my batch mates are placed in various companies on and off campus. The average package is 6 LPA - 8 LPA, the lowest is 3.6 LPA, and the highest is 12 LPA. Most students get internships and are working on some great projects too. The roles mostly offered to us are software developer, data analyst, and testing roles.
content.Infrastructure: Labs are equipped with the latest generation PCs that support almost all the latest technologies. All kinds of programs like AI, DL, etc., can be executed without hassle on the systems. Hostels are very good. We have all kinds of amenities, food, and other extracurricular activities are good on the campus like volleyball, football, cricket, and others.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It has good infrastructure, facilities and faculty.

content.Placements: The roles offered in the field of mechanical engineering are mostly designing and core jobs in companies like JSW and Mahindra. The highest package is 9 LPA, which is offered in JSW. I'm still in my 2nd year of college. Academics are good, and I'm yet to learn things, and I lack skills.
content.Infrastructure: Although I'm a day scholar, I heard from my hostel friends that the infrastructure is great with multiple facilities, Wi-Fi integrated rooms, libraries and the university infrastructure is good. All the classrooms are equipped with projectors and speakers. Labs and libraries are so good with a good availability of books.

college_info.college_name: Anurag University Hyderabad Faculty: Top Courses and the Faculty Behind Them

data.description: Anurag University strives to become a leading university that provides transformative education and research to create leaders and innovators of tomorrow and to expand frontiers of knowledge for the betterment of society. To fulfil this mission, a team of experts works towards achieving this goal. Faculty members at Anurag University have a unique teaching approach that is a blend of theoretical depth and practical problem-solving, designed to equip students with not just knowledge but the ability to innovate and lead in the tech-driven world.

qualifications: Qualification: He received an integrated M.S.Engg in CSE from the USSR and his Ph.D. in Computer Science from JNTUH.

Experience: He served as Associate Professor and Professor at SIT, Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University, Hyderabad (JNTUH) for 13 years. He is nominated as Executive Council Member for Dr. B.R. Ambedkar University, Srikakulam, Andhra Pradesh by the Govt of Andhra Pradesh. He served as Director of Admissions, Professor, and Chairman BOS for more than one year at RayalaSeema University. He guided 42 research scholars for Ph.D in Computer Science and Engineering, and published more than 130 research articles in international journals.
Qualification: Dr.P.Narayan Reddy did his PhD from Jawaharlal Nehru Agricultural University, Jabalpur, specialising in plant pathology

Experience: Worked for 32 years as a Professor at Jayashankar Telangana State Agriculture University in various capacities in teaching and research fields, and worked for 3 years in IIIT Hyderabad in the e-sagu project. Also received training on Pest Risk Analysis at the USDA under the US AKI project. He has published more than 100 research publications, textbook chapters and plant protection bulletins. Guided several PhD students. Acted as a member for reviewing research programmes of several Agricultural universities and ICAR institutions.

Experience: He was CEO, Vice-Chairman and co-founder of KRIA Healthcare Pvt. Ltd., before he was founder-CEO of PiramalSwasthya (formerly HMRI) and president (Corporate Sustainability) at Piramal Healthcare Ltd. He was involved in designing 108 emergency services and 104 health services. He was the founding CEO of HMRI, which launched India’s first dial-a-doctor service at scale. Other services such as remote healthcare using Telemedicine and mobile itinerary health services. He is Chairman of the Centre of Environmental Concerns, an NGO in the service of dry-land farmers offering water-conserving products and labour-reducing tools for agriculture.

Experience: Dr. B. Vasudha is presently working as Dean, School of Pharmacy, Anurag University. She obtained her Bachelor's from Kolhapur University and Master's from Manipal University with specialisation in Pharmaceutical Sciences. She completed her Doctor of Philosophy in Pharmaceutical Sciences in 2009 from SDNT University, Mumbai. She is an awardee of a senior research fellowship under the DBT program sponsored by the Government of India. Her research work mainly focuses on diabetes, inflammation, behavioural studies, Polycystic ovary syndrome, Self-Emulsifying drug delivery System and Nanoparticles.

Experience: Dr. B. Lakshmi Prasanna is an esteemed medical professional with a wealth of experience and expertise in the field of medicine and medical education. As the Dean of Neelima Institute of Medical Sciences, she brings a profound commitment to excellence in education, patient care, and research.

Experience: Professor Rafath Razia is presently serving as the Dean of the School of Nursing at Anurag University. Professor Razia brings with her 47 years of rich experience in different profiles, having successfully carried out classroom and clinical teaching

Experience: Dr. V. Srinivasa Rao is a Mathematician with over 20 years of teaching and research experience. He did his Master's from NIT Warangal in the year 2003, and he received a doctorate from Osmania University, Hyderabad in the year 2011. He is a life member of the Indian Science Congress, APTSMS, and ISTE. He completed a minor research project funded by UGC, New Delhi during the year 2014-16 worth Rs. 3,75,000. Under his supervision, two research scholars are pursuing Ph. D. and one scholar was awarded a Ph.D. from JNTU Hyderabad.
Designation: Professor and Dean, Faculty of Naturopathy and Yogic Sciences at SGT University
Department: He graduated and post-graduated in CSE and did his Ph.D in CSE from JNTU, Hyderabad

Experience: He has more than 20 years of experience in academia and has published around 80 publications in International journals and conferences. He received the Inspiring Faculty Award by Infosys and, Significant Contribution Award by CSI.
Qualification: He obtained his B. Tech from Kakatiya University, M. Tech and Ph.D from JNTUH University.

Experience: He has 23 years of teaching and 13 years of research experience. He has organised and attended various workshops and conferences at the National and International levels. He has published more than 65 papers in various National & International journals & conferences and guided 6 Ph.D scholars.
Qualification: He finished his Ph.D in Civil Engineering from the International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad (IIITH), India.
Experience: Dr. Bodige Narender is an Associate Professor at Anurag University and joined in the year 2016.

Before joining Anurag University (formerly Anurag Group of Institutions), he was an Assistant Professor at Vasavi College of Engineering (VCE) and Lecturer in JB Institute of Engineering and Technology (JBIET), Hyderabad. Dr B. Narender worked as a research fellow at IIITH and was involved in National and International Projects in year 2011 to 2013, such as DISANET (JICA-JST) for a set of building vibration sensors in Chandigarh city and Vulnerability Assessment of Nanded City and Himachal Pradesh. He was also involved in consultancy work for the Ramappa temple to study the effect of Near Site Tunnel Blasts of Devadula Project in the year 2011 and Third-Party Quality Control of GHMC (2018 to 2021). He published thirty-three papers in various National and International conferences and journals.

reviews_list.review_title: It has a good curriculum and helps in learning tech which industry refers more.

reviews_list.review_title: It has an awesome campus and good placements.

faqs.question: What to do after JEE Main session 2 result?
faqs.answer: After JEE session 2 is completed, only those candidates who are aiming for IITs need to start preparing for JEE Advanced after clearing JEE Main. Those who are above the 98th percentile should start preparing for JEE Advanced as soon as possible. Those below this, between the 95th and 98th percentile, should focus on attempting more mock tests and previous year question papers so that they have a better chance of clearing JEE Advanced

faqs.question: What entrance exam scores are accepted by VIIT Pune for admission to M.Tech?
faqs.answer: VIIT Pune considers GATE (Graduate Aptitude Test in Engineering) scores for admissions to their M.Tech programs. This is a national level entrance exam conducted by the Indian Institute of Science (IISc) and seven Indian Institutes of Technology (IITs) on a rotational basisThere is no mention of VIIT Pune accepting any other entrance exam scores for M.Tech admissions.

faqs.question: What entrance exams are accepted by VIIT Pune for admission to B.Tech?
faqs.answer: VIIT Pune offers admission to its B.Tech programme viaMHT CET and JEE Mains exams. If you're from the Maharashtra state, you get admission by taking the MHT-CET exam, which fills 85% of the seats. But if you're from anywhere else in India, you have to take the JEE Mains exam, which fills the remaining 15% of the seats.

reviews.review_heading: College has good placements, good campus life, and good facilities.
reviews.review_text: There are more than 30 facilities in each department, and more than 5 come to each department. Wi-Fi connections are moderate. There are more than 15 wardens in the hostel. Hostel food is average, a Medical room is available, a PT room is available, and competitions will be conducted.

reviews.review_heading: I'm satisfied with placement, CoE availability and good campus life.
reviews.review_text: All sources mentioned are available in good quality. The hostel is available in good infrastructure with laundry facilities, and Wi-Fi is available. The food quality at the mess is good. The quality of the canteen, sports and games and medical facilities is nice too. The competitions will be conducted both technically and non-technically.

reviews.review_heading: Good college offering great placement opportunities and a vibrant ecosystem.
reviews.review_text: The campus is good comprising numerous classrooms and labs with good Wi-Fi connectivity. Our department has labs with smart boards and updated software for my course. Bus routes are available for day scholars with the majority of the buses being air conditioned.

reviews.review_heading: My college and my course review.
reviews.review_text: Non-AC classrooms are available for my department, the mess food is good, and the medical facilities are available. Good quality of food available in this college with time restrictions. The college management conducts a sports program once a month, and many students participated in the outside tournament.

reviews.review_heading: Find the best experience with CIT - From classroom to career.
reviews.review_text: The classrooms are spacious, and the campus offers free Wi-Fi. The labs are extraordinary, and the COEs are very excellent. They have kept the central library accessible to students at any time. The hostel facilities are quite good; the Wi-Fi is enabled even when the power is off, and the laundry services are very great and useful for the hostel students.

reviews.review_heading: Good academics and excellent facilities.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are equipped with smart boards that help us to learn and explore new things, and also provide uninterrupted internet access. The department also includes regular lab usage for improving practical knowledge. The hostel provides a safe, comfortable living environment with hygienic food, water, electricity, a gym, sports, and medical support.

reviews.review_heading: Student life at CIT Chennai.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure at CIT Chennai is quite good. It has well equipped labs, smart classrooms, and campus-wide Wi-Fi. Hostel facilities are comfortable. It has decent rooms and regular maintenance. The food in the mess is decent. Though it could have more variety. The college has modern infrastructure suitable for both academics and student life.

reviews.review_heading: Nice exposure towards the international healthcare and medical field.
reviews.review_text: Our biomedical engineering department offers advanced labs, smart classrooms, Wi-Fi, and a vast library. The hostel of Chennai Institute of Technology provides clean food, nutritious food, and 24/7 medical aid during emergencies. The quality of food in the mess and canteen is very hygienic and has many varieties according to students' interests.

reviews.review_heading: Placement guaranteed! Best college for biomedical engineering!
reviews.review_text: I am a hosteller, staying within the campus. Our campus is completely safe, with proper CCTV installed at various places. Caring wardens, health centre, friendly seniors make my college life very memorable, free Wi-Fi around the campus 24/7. CoE can be accessed even in the late evening for our research. All the classrooms have smart boards, enough fans/light and well-aerated rooms.

reviews.review_heading: Great learning environment.
reviews.review_text: Chennai Institute of Technology offers the best infrastructure with advanced labs, innovation centers, and incubation lab. As a hosteller, we can access to COE and labs even after college hours, enhancing practical learning and a place for collaborative learning.

reviews.review_heading: Creating engineers with a vision.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms are fitted with smart boards. The campus is fitted with Wi-Fi all over. Spacious and ventilated classrooms. LCD projectors are fitted in all classrooms too. Separate classrooms for each department. Clean environment. Top-class facilities in labs and research centres.

reviews.review_heading: Best and safe campus, good placement & enjoyable student life.
reviews.review_text: I am studying Biomedical Engineering, III year. The biomedical knowledge I gained from my course helped me to study various medical reports with clarity. We have good spacious classrooms and laboratories. I stay in the boys' hostel. At the beginning, I struggled to manage, but as days moved on, I felt more comfortable with the hostel campus and my roommates. Weekly, 4 days the mess provides non-veg meals.

reviews.review_heading: The best institution for engineering.
reviews.review_text:
All our classrooms are integrated with smart boards. The entire campus is equipped with WiFi connectivity. Our centre for biomedical research makes us participate actively in numerous competitions and hackathons. The department includes well-equipped laboratories. My course provides a wider knowledge of recent advancements in biomedical engineering.
I stay in a hostel and it gives me a good ambience to study. I go around the laboratories for research (projects/hackathons) work till 8 pm, and it ...

reviews.review_heading: Good college with great placement
reviews.review_text: Our college has digital classrooms with smart boards and Wi-Fi connectivity. The labs are well-equipped and updated for practical learning. The library has useful books and online resources. The campus also provides clean canteens and sports facilities.

faqs.answer: A:    Candidates must have passed Class 12 in Physics, Chemistry & Mathematics, or equivalent with a minimum of 45% aggregate. In addition to this, students need to appear for TNEA counselling or the Single Window Admissions System. Single Window Admissions System is used in Anna University for TNEA (Tamil Nadu Engineering Admission). It is popularly known as Anna University Counselling and is part of the process via which students completing Class 12 apply and secure admission to Engineering colleges within Tamil Nadu. The important strategy is that the counselling is conducted based on rank list, if a student is present for counselling then without allocating a college and course for that student, next rank cannot be allocated with a seat.

content.Infrastructure: There are specific labs for each and every department. We also have a computer engineering lab with full-fledged. There is a Wi-Fi support in almost every computer. The hostel is neatly maintained by the hostel students and the appointed staff. The hostel is vast and sufficient.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: College is very good in terms of placements.

content.Placements: The top recruiters are Bosch, Deshaw, Toshiba, L&T, Hyundai, and many more. The highest package in the college is 52 LPA by Deshaw. The lowest package is 4 LPA. The average package is around 5-6 LPA. Many other software companies also recruit from this college.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure is decent and not very fancy. Labs are good, and the systems are all functioning. The library functions from 9 AM to 7 PM except for Sunday. Canteens and chaat shops are available. The sports and athletics club is present. Sports like cricket, football, badminton, chess, and many more are available.

admission_overview.title: Coimbatore Institute of Technology Admission Overview 2025
admission_overview.description: Coimbatore Institute of Technology admission 2025 is entrance-based. The institute, also known as CIT Coimbatore, accepts students on an entrance basis. Students can pursue various undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral courses across thirteen departments, such as Civil Engineering, Electronics & Communication Engineering, and more. CIT also offers an integrated MSc course that is five years long. Candidates can apply for admission to the course of their choice via online mode. Aspirants can read the following article to know the in-depth process for admission at Coimbatore Institute of Technology.

faqs.answer: Candidates must have passed Class 12 in Physics, Chemistry & Mathematics, or equivalent with a minimum of 45% aggregate. In addition to this, students need to appear for TNEA counselling or the Single Window Admissions System. Single Window Admissions System is used in Anna University for TNEA (Tamil Nadu Engineering Admission). It is popularly known as Anna University Counselling and is part of the process via which students completing Class 12 apply and secure admission to Engineering colleges within Tamil Nadu. The important strategy is that the counselling is conducted based on rank list, if a student is present for counselling then without allocating a college and course for that student, next rank cannot be allocated with a seat.

To promote physical well-being, the institute has a gymnasium with modern fitness machines, a yoga room, and wellness activities. The institute also organises sports meets and inter-college tournaments.

reviews.review_heading: Coimbatore Institute of Technology in M.E Construction Management course information
reviews.review_text: Campus has clean classrooms, good Wi-Fi, and labs for planning. There are a lot of books on engineering management in the library. The rooms in the hostel are clean, but the food is always the same. There is a sports field and medical help, but the service can be slow.

reviews.review_heading: The placements were good at my college.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure for my course are very good. Wi-fi is available throughout the campus, and the labs are so good, all equipment is available in Physics and Chemistry labs. For separate departments, they have labs. Especially in my course, labs are large and have more facilities.

reviews.review_heading: Good college if you are ready to learn by yourself.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good. There is no Wi-Fi in computing block for students access. Labs are clean. Library is easily accessible and good. Hostel and mess are good. Hostel mess is okay when you can adjust to the normal, minimal food that is not too tasty. Hostel rooms are good.

reviews.review_heading: A peaceful life at Coimbatore Institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: There are specific labs for each and every department. We also have a computer engineering lab with full-fledged. There is a Wi-Fi support in almost every computer. The hostel is neatly maintained by the hostel students and the appointed staff. The hostel is vast and sufficient.

reviews.review_heading: College is very good in terms of placements.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is decent and not very fancy. Labs are good, and the systems are all functioning. The library functions from 9 AM to 7 PM except for Sunday. Canteens and chaat shops are available. The sports and athletics club is present. Sports like cricket, football, badminton, chess, and many more are available.

reviews.review_heading: Learning phase of the life.
reviews.review_text: 4-5 specific labs are available for every department, which is provided with every piece of equipment that is needed for potential engineers but the infrastructure is old and outdated as the college was built in 1950s. The college recently started the renovating process, which is going on.

reviews.review_heading: A good place to gain knowledge and placements but has bad infrastructure.
reviews.review_text:
4-5 specific labs are available for every department, which is provided with every lab equipment that is needed for a potential engineering but the infrastructure is old and the college has started the reconstruction of new buildings.
The hostel and the food provided are below average.

reviews.review_heading: Events .The college events conducted by the various clubs
reviews.review_text: The hostel infrastructure is good.Rooms are allocated with 2 persons per room . It's fair spacious.considering campus life interacting with seniors makes it more interesting via club events and some department events.Sports are pretty good in out college.Our college contains various club so that every student can participate in any of the club activities .social service clubs like nss ,yrc,rsp etc are also here which taught students about the responsibilities.

reviews.review_heading: Good hostel, classrooms, and placements record.
reviews.review_text:
We got a new block recently, especially for MSC integrated courses. Classrooms are good. The institute provides well-maintained facilities for sports like football, cricket, basketball, and tennis.
A modern gym equipped with cardio and weight-training equipment is accessible to students.

reviews.review_heading: Student driven clubs and the activities that gives students a boost up to their personality.
reviews.review_text: Our lab is completely a teach-ready lab, which is an important thing in every college. When it comes to sports, each sport has its own clubs, and the students and members actively participate in intercollegiate and all levels of sports and come out in shining colors.

reviews.review_heading: College is likely good and the infrastructure is peaceful.
reviews.review_text: Club involvement in the college is very good. They made a drama club for the students, a dance club for the students, a singing club for the students, and many more clubs. The martial arts club especially focuses on the girls safety. Every morning, 2 hours for the martial arts club and athletes in the sports clubs.

reviews.review_heading: I like the infrastructure and the campus very much.
reviews.review_text: There will be 28+ clubs in CIT, such as Rotaract, Nature Club, Literary Club, EBSB, KKC, MAC, and so on. The extracurricular activities are amazing, and there will be daily sports practice for football, volleyball, cricket, and so on. There will be good facilities in the classrooms for the students to enhance their knowledge. There will be huge benefits for the students due to their access to the library, and different fests will be conducted frequently.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with excellent placement records.
reviews.review_text: The facilities and infrastructure are good. Computer labs have Wi-Fi facilities. The classrooms have smart boards, etc. The hostel's quality was mediocre. The food is like all other hostel food. We can't expect food to be great in hostel. We have a separate canteen where we have to pay eat.

reviews.review_heading: Coimbatore institute of Technology.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is not good. There were some old buildings where the construction was going on. In labs, some of the equipments didn’t work. Our library is very big with all the academic books mase available along with a Wi-Fi and WLAN cable. I had some bad experiences with the hostel. There are no fans, I brought a fan for the room myself. They need to at least provide the basic facilities. Our mess food was moderate in quality. No medical facilities are given by the college.

reviews.review_heading: A place where you can sculpt yourself.
reviews.review_text: The lab is well-equipped with all necessary equipment. Smart classrooms provide an effective learning environment. The library is stocked with a variety of books, both core and non-core. Hostel infrastructure can be improved; however, the food is satisfactory. There are three dispensaries for medical support, and sports facilities are good.

reviews_list.review_title: A strong engineering programme with great campus life.

review_content.Placements: Many ECE students get placed in core or IT companies but average placement packages tend to be more modest. Around 5 LPA–6 LPA for those placed through regular placement drives (excluding high offers) in some years. CET offers excellent placement opportunities for ECE students, with a mix of high-paying core roles and strong IT placements. Students who build good technical skills and project experience often secure top offers.
review_content.Infrastructure: Well-equipped laboratories: For engineering branches including ECE, CET provides departmental labs and technical facilities for practical and research work. These include the Communication Engineering Lab, Digital Electronics / DSP Lab, Microprocessor & Microcontroller Lab, and VLSI & Embedded Systems Lab. These labs have modern equipment like CROs, function generators, FPGA kits, DSP kits, and relevant simulation software.

review_content.Placements: Approximately 80% of the students are placed by this college. The highest package is around 40 LPA, and the lowest package is around 3 LPA. Here, most students are placed in 6 to 10 LPA. The top recruiters are TCS and Texas Instruments. Last year, 14 students were placed in Air India for 10 LPA. Around 90-98% students got internships from Wipro, TCS, IBM, ABB and Accenture. The top roles offered by the course are Software Developer, Data Scientist and Data Analyst.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college offers comparatively good lab facilities and other infrastructure. The college has a very good library, which contains a large no of books that are helpful for academics and industries. The college Men's hostel is well-maintained by the officials and students and offers good food.
