review_summary.college_name: CET Trivandrum Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Good infrastructure, facilities, and faculty members. Good placements as of 2024 and 2025.

content.Placements: I am from the 2025 batch, Mechanical Engineering. I have completed my first semester here. I have communicated with a lot of seniors. As I have talked to them, from the Mechanical Engineering branch, more than 50 percent of students get placed from every batch. And for other branches like CSE and ECE, there are a good amount of placements too. The highest package is 40 LPA for the college.
content.Infrastructure: Good infrastructure, and all the lab facilities are available here. Course-related facilities are well provided. Most of the classrooms have Wi-Fi access. There is a central computation facility where there are a lot of computers, and it is accessible for all the students from 9 am–9:30 pm on all working days. Men’s hostel has good facilities including washing machines. Food is also provided for all the inmates.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical and Electronics Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Overall, CET is very much value for money with good placements and exposure.

content.Placements: Almost 60–70 percent of students get placed, with the lowest package of 1 LPA and the highest of almost 44 LPA. CET is considered to have good placements. The number of placements offered for CS is the highest, followed by EEE, and then ECE. The average package of CET is around 7-7.5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure can be considered good, though not the best. Newer buildings are coming up. Wi-Fi is good, and the college has a good library and an indoor stadium. Labs and workshops are a little old, but for the fees, the college is very much worth it. Overall, CET stands neutral in terms of infrastructure and hostel facilities.

content.Placements: Many ECE students get placed in core or IT companies but average placement packages tend to be more modest. Around 5 LPA–6 LPA for those placed through regular placement drives (excluding high offers) in some years. CET offers excellent placement opportunities for ECE students, with a mix of high-paying core roles and strong IT placements. Students who build good technical skills and project experience often secure top offers.
content.Infrastructure: Well-equipped laboratories: For engineering branches including ECE, CET provides departmental labs and technical facilities for practical and research work. These include the Communication Engineering Lab, Digital Electronics / DSP Lab, Microprocessor & Microcontroller Lab, and VLSI & Embedded Systems Lab. These labs have modern equipment like CROs, function generators, FPGA kits, DSP kits, and relevant simulation software.

individual_reviews.title: The best college for average students.

content.Placements: Approximately 80% of the students are placed by this college. The highest package is around 40 LPA, and the lowest package is around 3 LPA. Here, most students are placed in 6 to 10 LPA. The top recruiters are TCS and Texas Instruments. Last year, 14 students were placed in Air India for 10 LPA. Around 90-98% students got internships from Wipro, TCS, IBM, ABB and Accenture. The top roles offered by the course are Software Developer, Data Scientist and Data Analyst.

content.Placements: I am currently studying, and approximately 80% of students get placed from this college. The highest package is around 40 LPA, and the lowest package is around 3 LPA. A football ground, volleyball court, basketball court, and badminton court are also available. The ambience of the hostel is very nice.

paragraphs: Theadmissionisentrance-based. The college offers more than 50 courses at UG and PG levels. All the courses are in the streams of Engineering & Technology, Business & Management Studies and Architecture & Planning. The BTech and the MTech programmes offered at the institute are also available in evening batch and lateral entry mode. COE Trivandrum accepts various national and state-level entrance exams to shortlist the students. Interested students can read the following article to learn about the eligibility, courses, scholarship and admission process.

Theadmissionis based on course-specific eligibility criteria. The college provides several programmes at undergraduate and postgraduate levels. Students must satisfy both the eligibility and selection criteria of the programme to be eligible for admission. The college also offers lateral entry for its BTech programme. Students can look at the table below to know about the eligibility and selection criteria for popularcourses:

The total tuition fee includes multiple components such as tuition fee, hostel fee, medical insurance, security deposit and more. Some of the components need to be paid only once at the time of admission and the remaining components are charged either semester-wise/ yearly.CET Trivandrum feeranges betweenINR 26,500andINR 39.6 lakh. The fee varies depending on the programme and specialisation selected by the student. Interested students can look at the following table to know thefeesfor popular programmes:
Note: This information is taken from official sources and is subject to changes.

The college offers a limited number of seats for its programmes. The seat intake varies depending on the programme selected by the students. Interested students can check out the table below to knowseat intake:

The admission procedure includes several steps, such as application, selection, document verification and final seat confirmation. Students seeking to enrol in any of the provided courses must meet the specified admission criteria before registering. Theadmission processis conducted offline. Interested students can check the following steps to complete theadmission process:

Since admissions are entrance-based, students must appear and clear the accepted exam. CEE will issue an allotment letter to the shortlisted students. Students are required to download the admission form from the official website and submit the form along with the required documents.

The selection process is done on the basis of valid scores in the accepted entrance exams (GATE/ KMEA/ KMAT Kerala/ NATA, etc.). CEE releases the allotment memo to the shortlisted students. Participate in the state counselling for seat allotment.

Students are required to visit the college campus with the required documents on the day of admission to complete the procedure. It is advisable to complete the procedure on the same day to avoid any miss. Additionally, students must pay the required fee for seat confirmation at the time of admission.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure, facilities, and faculty members. Good placements as of 2024 and 2025.
reviews.review_text: Good infrastructure, and all the lab facilities are available here. Course-related facilities are well provided. Most of the classrooms have Wi-Fi access. There is a central computation facility where there are a lot of computers, and it is accessible for all the students from 9 am–9:30 pm on all working days. Men’s hostel has good facilities including washing machines. Food is also provided for all the inmates.

reviews.review_heading: Overall, CET is very much value for money with good placements and exposure.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure can be considered good, though not the best. Newer buildings are coming up. Wi-Fi is good, and the college has a good library and an indoor stadium. Labs and workshops are a little old, but for the fees, the college is very much worth it. Overall, CET stands neutral in terms of infrastructure and hostel facilities.

reviews.review_heading: A strong engineering programme with great campus life.
reviews.review_text: Well-equipped laboratories: For engineering branches including ECE, CET provides departmental labs and technical facilities for practical and research work. These include the Communication Engineering Lab, Digital Electronics / DSP Lab, Microprocessor & Microcontroller Lab, and VLSI & Embedded Systems Lab. These labs have modern equipment like CROs, function generators, FPGA kits, DSP kits, and relevant simulation software.

reviews.review_heading: The best college for average students.
reviews.review_text: The college offers comparatively good lab facilities and other infrastructure. The college has a very good library, which contains a large no of books that are helpful for academics and industries. The college Men's hostel is well-maintained by the officials and students and offers good food.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college in Kerala with good placements.
reviews.review_text: Facilities of the college are average. All kinds of labs are available, but they are not well maintained or furnished. The main hostel is excellent. The mess is controlled by students themselves, so the food is excellent. The rooms are well maintained, and the monthly rate is affordable for everyone. A football ground, volleyball court, basketball court, and badminton court are also available. The ambience of the hostel is very nice.

reviews.review_heading: The curriculum is old, but campus life is the best.
reviews.review_text: There is free Wi-Fi in every class. All computer labs are fully air-conditioned and work from 9 am to 9 pm. reviews_list.review_title: Great College, possibly have a lot of money, but it has a very strict attendant policy.

review_content.Placements: As per what I have listened, around 40 percent of students got placements. The highest package is around 11 LPA. Companies from all over the world. Only 30 percent of the people got internships; the other 60 percent are doing their own business. Senior event manager to handle the companies’ events.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the syllabus and the course is very interesting, and we get to go to the rural areas for some days and a national study trip. I can’t tell you much about the hostel as I am not in MIT hostel, but as per what I have listened, the rooms are really good. Hostel food and its quality is not very promising. They have lots and lots of sports activities.

reviews_list.batch_info: BBA(Hons.) in International Business - Batch of 2025
reviews_list.review_title: It's a good college for anyone genuinely interested.

review_content.Placements: In my batch, around 55-60 percent of students are placed. The highest package offered is around 12 LPA-15 LPA. Common roles offered are business executive, relationship manager, and operations executive. Overall, opportunities exist, but the outcome depends heavily on internships and how we carry ourselves.
review_content.Infrastructure: The campus is neat and clean. There are clear rules mentioned, and actions are also taken against violators. I can't say anything about the food as I haven't tried it, but the vibe of the campus is top class, especially when it rains. The crowd is amazing too, and we will feel like coming to college every day.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Good college with balanced academics and campus life.

review_content.Placements: In my course, around 75 percent of students got placed, and the rest opted for higher studies outside India. The highest package offered is around 30 LPA, and the average is around 7 LPA. Top recruiters include Infosys, Microsoft, HCL, and Tech Mahindra. Top 5 percent of students got internships with a stipend, and in very good companies, the rest had to struggle for it.
review_content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is modern. Our department has well-equipped labs with Macs and high-speed Wi-Fi. Hostel facilities are decent, the mess food is manageable, not amazing, but edible. One girls' hostel is on the campus itself, but the only boys' hostel is around 8-9km away from the campus; however, the college provides bus facilities. Sports grounds, indoor games, and medical facilities are available in the new sports complex.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Cyber Security and Forensics) - Batch of 2028
reviews_list.review_title: Strong cybersecurity programme with supportive faculty.

review_content.Placements: For the placement drive 2024, the CSE cybersecurity and forensics branch has around 120-130 students, out of which around 80 got placed, and the highest salary offered was 19 LPA, and the average package was around 7-8 LPA. Major companies included IBM, TCS, Accenture and HCL. Top roles mainly consisted of a Security analyst.
review_content.Infrastructure: The entire academic building and labs are covered with campus-wide Wi-Fi. In speak hours, it may slow a bit, but overall connectivity is reliable. Most CSE classes are conducted in newer academic blocks, so classrooms feel modern. The biggest library you'll find in Pune has various books from different streams available. Hostel rooms are not luxurious, but comfortable and functional. Mess Food is average to good, completely veg. MIT has 2 different canteens, one of the premium ones called Encave and the other, a budget-friendly one called Shreeraj.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
reviews_list.review_title: It is one of the best college.

review_content.Placements: This is my first year in college and I am not more aware of the placement. While taking admission in college my staff member told me the lowest is 3 LPA and the highest is 1.5Cr. I do not know exactly they told me this only. There are many cloud of internships in this college but they charge. Till now I have not done any internship but I saw many companies coming to college for internship programme like Tata etc.
review_content.Infrastructure: It has excellent infrastructure and it has availability of Wi-Fi labs classrooms and library. Library is to good for this college. I did not see any college that has this kind of library. Hostel canteen food is not that good. Sports and game facilities are good. It has a dark side also some students are addicted to drugs and do wrong things. 1 or 2 months ago there a child ordered something from Blinkit and some things happened that the Blinkit boy beat our campus student he was full of blood.

reviews_list.batch_info: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Applied Statistics and Data Analytics - Batch of 2027
reviews_list.review_title: Absolutely satisfied with the college and faculty.

review_content.Placements: This year would be the first passing out batch for this course, and most of them have started getting placement with great packages. Top companies do come for placement drives. Most of them get placed as a Data analyst and risk analyst. As far as I know, the highest package has been 15 LPA.
review_content.Infrastructure: The college has great on-campus hostels with Wi-Fi and all amenities. The library is just mesmerising, its ambience is on another level. Classrooms have a great ambience, as in our department. Mess food is average, but the sports facilities are just amazing. Overall, it's excellent.

faqs.question: Can I get direct admission to B.Tech at MIT-WPU Pune?
faqs.answer: For admission to the BTech course, MIT-WPU, Pune accepts scores of various state/ national-level entrance exams such as JEE Main/ MHT CET/ PERA CET/ MHT CET B/ NEET UG. Hence, candidates willing to get admission to the course must appear and qualify in any one of the accepted entrance exams. For some specialisations, students may have to write a Statement of Purpose (SOP).

faqs.question: How can I get direct admission in MIT-WPU?
faqs.answer: MIT-WPU Pune does not offer direct admission to its UG and PG courses. MIT-WPU course admissions for all courses are either done via MIT-WPU CET, which is conducted by the university itself. The university also accepts various state and national-level entrance exams such as PERA CET, JEE Main, CAT, MAT, NEET UG, etc. Those who want to get admission to any of the UG and PG courses at MIT-WPU, must fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria in the first place and then appear for the respective entrance exams. For some PG courses such as MBA and MCA, the university also accepts valid scores in personal interview rounds as part of their selection process. The final seat allotment is done based on the counselling rounds.

faqs.question: How can I get admission to BBA at MIT-WPU?
faqs.answer: For MIT-WPU BBA admissions, candidates need to fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria, i.e., to pass Class 12 with 60% aggregate with English subject in any stream (at least 55% marks, in case of Backward class category candidate belonging to Maharashtra State only). Else, those who have Diploma with 60% aggregate in any stream from Any UGC-approved Institution or equivalent with English as a subject can also apply. Admission to BBA at MIT-WPU is entrance-based. Candidates need to qualify for MIT-WPU CET exam which is conducted by the university itself. The final selection is based on the performance of candidates in the Personal Interview rounds.

faqs.question: Which entrance exam is accepted by MIT School of Management for MBA?
faqs.answer: MIT WPU Pune accepts multiple entrance exams for admission to the MBA course. Candidates can apply for any one of the entrance exams for admission. The final selection is based on the performance of candidates in Group Discussion (GD) and Personal Interview (PI) rounds, followed by other selection rounds. Few of the entrance exams are as follows:CAT Common Admission TestMAT Management Aptitude TestXAT  Xavier Aptitude TestMaharashtra Common Entrance Exam MAH CET

placement_data.title: MIT-WPU, Pune Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: MIT-WPU, Pune has released the placement details for the Class of 2025. More than 730 recruiters visited the campus for 2025 placements and selected 2455 students of the batch 2025. The overall highest package offered to the batch 2025 stood at INR 51.36 LPA , whereas the average salary offered was INR 6.23 LPA. The median salary offered to the batch 2025 was INR 5.50 LPA . The top recruiters of MIT-WPU, Pune in 2025 include Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Intel, Goldman Sachs, etc. Apart from securing the annual package, the students also received internship opportunities from the recuiters in 2025. The highest stipend offered was INR 80,000.

Earlier, the highest package offered during MIT-WPU, Pune placement 2024 stood at INR 51.36 LPA. A total 2,544 students registered, of which 1,903 were placed in leading companies. More than 600 companies visited the campus.
The students of the BDes batch 2023 secured the highest package of INR 20 LPA.

hostel.description:
MIT-WPU provides students with modern and comfortable hostel facilities, catering to diverse needs and interests. Equipped with amenities such as dance studios, gyms, basketball courts, and inviting common areas, the hostels offer a vibrant and engaging living environment. Students have the flexibility to choose between twin-sharing and triple-sharing rooms, each furnished with unlimited high-speed Wi-Fi and regular housekeeping services. 

The safety of students is a top priority, with full-time wardens, CCTV monitoring, and biometric-enabled entrances ensuring a secure living space. MIT-WPU's commitment to providing well-equipped and secure hostels reflects its dedication to creating a conducive and enriching residential experience for its students.

reviews.review_heading: Great College, possibly have a lot of money, but it has a very strict attendant policy.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the syllabus and the course is very interesting, and we get to go to the rural areas for some days and a national study trip. I can’t tell you much about the hostel as I am not in MIT hostel, but as per what I have listened, the rooms are really good. Hostel food and its quality is not very promising. They have lots and lots of sports activities.

reviews.review_heading: It's a good college for anyone genuinely interested.
reviews.review_text: The campus is neat and clean. There are clear rules mentioned, and actions are also taken against violators. I can't say anything about the food as I haven't tried it, but the vibe of the campus is top class, especially when it rains. The crowd is amazing too, and we will feel like coming to college every day.

reviews.review_heading: Good college with balanced academics and campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is modern. Our department has well-equipped labs with Macs and high-speed Wi-Fi. Hostel facilities are decent, the mess food is manageable, not amazing, but edible. One girls' hostel is on the campus itself, but the only boys' hostel is around 8-9km away from the campus; however, the college provides bus facilities. Sports grounds, indoor games, and medical facilities are available in the new sports complex.

reviews.review_heading: Strong cybersecurity programme with supportive faculty.
reviews.review_text: The entire academic building and labs are covered with campus-wide Wi-Fi. In speak hours, it may slow a bit, but overall connectivity is reliable. Most CSE classes are conducted in newer academic blocks, so classrooms feel modern. The biggest library you'll find in Pune has various books from different streams available. Hostel rooms are not luxurious, but comfortable and functional. Mess Food is average to good, completely veg. MIT has 2 different canteens, one of the premium ones called Encave...

reviews.review_heading: It is one of the best college.
reviews.review_text: It has excellent infrastructure and it has availability of Wi-Fi labs classrooms and library. Library is to good for this college. I did not see any college that has this kind of library.  Hostel canteen food is not that good. Sports and game facilities are good. It has a dark side also some students are addicted to drugs and do wrong things. 1 or 2 months ago there a child ordered something from Blinkit and some things happened that the Blinkit boy beat our campus student he was full of blood.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the college and faculty.
reviews.review_text: The college has great on-campus hostels with Wi-Fi and all amenities. The library is just mesmerising, its ambience is on another level. Classrooms have a great ambience, as in our department. Mess food is average, but the sports facilities are just amazing. Overall, it's excellent.

reviews.review_heading: My review of this college.
reviews.review_text: The course curriculum was different from the rest of the colleges. There was a brew of finance, operations, marketing, and HR for the elective options. They imparted both theoretical and practical knowledge. It was a very flexible system that favors students for their betterment. The hostel was completely air conditioned and was equipped with free Wi-Fi. There was ample space provided for the balcony and terrace. The rooms were dual sharing with separate washroom facilities for each room. The me...

reviews.review_heading: The college has good and friendly faculty with a fresh environment and campus.
reviews.review_text: Our campus has good facilities of Wi-Fi, smart Google classrooms, and well-stocked libraries. Hostel facilities are designed with hygienic food. Even with the good medical facilities and well-trained doctors. The college also supports sports and various national and international competitions.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied with the faculty.
reviews.review_text: We have a specially designed Vyasa building for CSE branch students. It's definitely amazing, the labs are brand new, and each system actually works. The only thing is that the network connectivity is terrible. The mess is good, but the En Encave Cafe is below average.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements with top-notch infrastructure, but the fees are a little bit on the higher side.
reviews.review_text: Cannot comment on hostel as I am a day scholar. Infrastructure available is of top-notch quality. Many canteens are available on the campus. Library has some limited books and is not up to date.

reviews.review_heading: MIT WPU  This is the reality.
reviews.review_text: There are well-developed and invested labs for different subjects. Campus has Wi-Fi. Library is also very useful and very accessible. Campus has a medical room for emergencies, and the hostels are decent. Hostels are okay, but they are extremely far away from the college. Although the college offers transport, it gets tiring to travel that much every single day.

reviews.review_heading: Review of MIT-WPU.
reviews.review_text: For CSE, we have a new building, and it has top-notch infrastructure. 4 labs on each floor, and each lab has 70 iMac setups. Canteens are really good, and the on-campus café too. We also have a sports complex where the ground floor has a huge swimming pool, which is very clean, and above that is the indoor games floor, like table tennis, and on top, we have a badminton hall.

reviews.review_heading: MIT WPU CSE  Industry oriented curriculum with lively campus culture.
reviews.review_text: College offers smart classrooms, MAC labs, library, and research space. Hostels are not that good but have clean rooms, study areas, and Wi-Fi. Mess food is the worst. Sports and recreation are average, with a decent basketball court, table tennis, and a gym. Overall, the infrastructure supports both academics and student life effectively.

reviews.review_text: Our college infrastructure is top-notch. The whole campus is Wi-Fi enabled, labs are properly equipped, and a central library is located with a variety of books. The hostel is great. Hostel rooms are properly cleaned, and all types of facilities are available here.

paragraphs: SRM Easwari Engineering College admission 2025 isopen. The institute is affiliated withAnna Universityand offers UG and PG-level courses in the field of Engineering and Management such as BTech, MTech, MBA, etc.Easwari Engineering Collegeoffers direct admission to BTech and seats are allocated to candidates through TNEA Counselling. For admission to MTech, a valid GATE/ CEETA score is required. However,for MBA and MCA courses, candidates must qualify for TANCET. The final seat allotment is done through counselling process conducted by the respective examination bodies. Read on the article to know more about SRM Easwari Engineering College admission in detail.

Candidates seeking for admission to UG & PG courses at the institute must fulfil the minimum eligibility criteria for the respective courses. Admissions are both entrance and merit-based. Check below the eligibility and selection criteria for the SRM Easwari Engineering College course admissions 2025:
Class 12 with Mathematics, Physics and Chemistry as main subjects from a recognised board

UG degree in any discipline either from Anna University or equivalent

SRM Easwari Engineering College admissions are both merit and entrance-based. The admission process includes filling the application form, appearing for the exam and registering for the counselling process. The detailed steps around theSRM Easwari Engineering College admission processare as follows:
STEP 1: Application Process

To apply for admission to UG & PG courses at SRM Easwari Engineering College, candidates must register on the official website of the respective entrance exam/ counselling bodies as per the course choice. For BTech, candidates must register for TNEA Counselling. For admission to MTech, students are required to register either for GATE or CEETA. However, MBA and MCA admissions begin with TANCET registrations.
STEP 2: Selection Rounds

As per the admission process, direct admission is offered to BTech aspirants based on their past academic records. They only have to register for TNEA Counselling process. However, admission to MTech, MBA and MCA courses is entirely entrance-based. Candidates must qualify for exams such asGATE, CEET & TANCETfor their respective courses.
STEP 3: Counselling Process

Candidates who qualify all the selection rounds must register for counselling process for their respective courses. The final seat allotment will be done based on the participation of the students in the counselling rounds.

reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our course is good and well maintained. The department has classrooms with projectors, well equipped computer laboratories, and campus wide Wi-Fi connectivity. The central library has a wide collection of textbook reference books.

reviews.review_heading: A useful and critical review of Easwari Engineering College by assessing all the major factors.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is pretty decent in our college. I am from the CSE department, so I can see that all the systems in the labs are clearly working, and I have not heard any complaints from other students regarding infrastructure. As a day scholar, I do not have personal experience with a hostel environment, but my friends from the hostel are satisfied with the hostel provisions and safety.

reviews.review_heading: Average infrastructure and facilities.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms with projector and sometimes fans, light, and windows will be broken labs-microcontroller, instrumentation. Quality of food and hostel is average. In sports, you will be given chances to participate in other college sports events if you are a sports person.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best college to study in the city.
reviews.review_text: The college offers many facilities. It includes Wi-Fi. Water is available on every floor of the campus. Classrooms are clean and well-maintained. The hostel is also well-maintained and cleaned daily for cleanliness. The quality of food in the hostel is good.

reviews.review_heading: The campus facilities meet the necessary academic needs.
reviews.review_text: The department is equipped with basic academic infrastructure. Laboratories are available and are gradually being upgraded as the department is relatively new. The quality of the food in the canteen is good and the hygiene is good. The institution encourages students to take part in extracurricular and curricular activities too.

reviews.review_heading: One of the good colleges in Chennai with decent placements.
reviews.review_text: Good facilities are available. We have multiple computer labs, one robotics lab, and many other lab facilities in Easwari Engineering College. Hostels are provided with both A/C and non-A/C options. The canteen has two floors, and we also have two grounds for outdoor games.

reviews.review_heading: Good infrastructure and growing opportunities. Supportive faculty and positive campus experience.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for the Biotechnology department is well-developed and constantly improving. The department has well-developed and well-equipped laboratories for microbiology, cell biology, etc. Classrooms are spacious and have well-facilitated Wi-Fi all over the campus. The hostel's facilities are quite good and comfortable. Rooms are clean and maintained regularly, and basics like Wi-Fi, laundry, and study areas are available. The mess food is decent, with both veg and non-vegetarian option...

reviews.review_heading: Excellent college with a good learning environment.
reviews.review_text: The canteen offers a better variety with reasonable prices, there is a fixed menu, and the quality is quite consistent. Sports and games are provided with excellent infrastructure, equipment availability is decent, and overall supportive. Medical facilities are satisfactory.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements for students.
reviews.review_text: There is free Wi-Fi throughout the campus, high-quality labs, a well-managed library, normal quality food with vending machines, and a good management system. Need to improve the food quality and nutritional value of the food. Infrastructure is good and needs to build lifts in some hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Beyond the books- my honest take on SRM Easwari's placement and vibe.
reviews.review_text: The campus infrastructure is fantastic. A major plus is that our department labs are a true highlight. They are equipped with modern tools and tech that support genuine hands-on learning. Classrooms are spacious. The campus is fully connected with Wi-Fi, which is essential for projects. For those in the hostel, the experience is highly comfortable. Rooms are clean and well-maintained. The mess is hygienic. They offer a decent food variety. We have good sports facilities. The whole campus is supp...

reviews.review_heading: SRM Easwari Engineering College.
reviews.review_text: The facilities are good in our college, and the infrastructure is good. Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a large, comfortable library are very good. The quality of the food in our canteen is normal, and for sports, there is a separate ground for training and practicing.

reviews.review_heading: Our college is really good overall. Overall, highly recommended.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is really good. All Building are provided with elevator. We have so many facilities here. Many labs and libraries to work with. We are provided with high-quality teachers, wifis, and resources. As far as food goes, our college canteen is in high demand. We have canteens all around campus for easy access. We have ambulances on standby and pharmacies inside our campus.

reviews.review_heading: Something creepy about my university.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the hostel is not too good for girls. But you get late-night access to the university library, and the mess food is average. There's a big playground and many sports available. The gym is also good. Classrooms are active learning based, and the university infrastructure is amazing.

reviews.review_heading: It has a good environment and security.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure and quality of food are quite good. Wi-Fi is available in every room of the hostel, and the medical staff is quite helpful. Various types of sports and games are available for hostel students, and anybody can play at any time. The library is quite big.

reviews.review_heading: The college is totally awesome.
reviews.review_text: As I study in this college right now. The infrastructure is totally awesome and can't be matched by many nearby colleges, hence no one can doubt that there are different blocks for each core branch, and several labs are there that are totally dedicated.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and best campus facilities. Skill-focused college with supportive teachers.
reviews.review_text: My course department has good infrastructure. We have Wi-Fi labs, classrooms, and a library, and everything works fine. The hostel facilities are overall okay. The mess food is not bad, but the taste of the food is decent. All the basic medical facilities are available. And we have proper grounds for both outdoor and indoor games.

reviews.review_heading: Galgotias University one of the best university.
reviews.review_text: Classroom, infrastructure, and the library are fully well developed. E-library contains all books, and the seating area is so impressive. Hostel rooms are fully furnished, and the food in the mess is cooked with hygiene. Students from other states and countries also get their local food to make them feel familiar and better.

reviews.review_heading: It has good infrastructure, supportive faculty, decent placements, and positive campus life.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure is good in the college. Classrooms are big and clean. Labs are well-maintained for practical work. The library has enough books for study and exams. Hostel rooms are clean, and basic facilities like water, electricity, and Wi-Fi are available most of the time. Overall, the campus infrastructure is okay, comfortable, and helpful for study and hostel life.

reviews.review_heading: One of the best colleges, go and take your admission there.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is free to use 24/7 hrs. There are multiple labs to do practicals. Classrooms are very neat and clean with air conditioning. Libraries are also there, which you can use whenever you want. The quality of food available in the mess and canteen is really good, with not much oil. Medical facilities are available anytime. Sports and Games are also available, such as basketball and table tennis.

reviews.review_heading: From all sides, this college is the best in the whole of Noida.
reviews.review_text: I would like to say just fantastic in every section. You will have 24/7 Wi-Fi. Health support. You will see every type of sport is available here. I will not show the pros of the college now, you will face a little pollution because the college is under construction, and you will face a little noise.

reviews.review_heading: I am quite satisfied with my college.
reviews.review_text: We have very advanced classrooms which have smart boards and a study system that includes active learning and group activities. In the hostel, we have good food and playgrounds for sports and a gym. In our canteen, the food is very hygienic and of good quality. There is also a medical room in our college.

reviews.review_heading: My college is good for education and training, but some teachers and timings should be changed.
reviews.review_text: The facilities in my college are quite good, but only about 40–50 percent, because some facilities are managed by people from the South, and there is an accent issue. The classrooms and library are fully equipped with modern technology. The hostel is located inside the college campus, but the facilities are not very comfortable, so students prefer staying in PGs outside the campus.

reviews.review_heading: The college is very good overall, the campus is beautiful, and companies come to the university.
reviews.review_text: The facilities in my university are more than expected. There is a Wi-Fi connection in all the blocks, smart classrooms, and a world-class library. Talking about the hostel, there are all the basic facilities including sports and indoor games.

reviews.review_heading: The infrastructure is good, and the teaching is also very nice.
reviews.review_text: The university infrastructure is very good. The classes have an active learning format with round tables and high-speed Wi-Fi. The university library is very good and equipped with PCs and computers. The university also has many benches for students to sit outside of classes. Also, cafeteria food is very good.

reviews.review_heading: It has scope for faculty growth, solid placements, and excellent infrastructure.
reviews.review_text: All facilities are available in Galgotias University. The best quality facilities are available in our hostel. The best quality of food is available in the mess and canteen. Medical facilities, sports, and games are available. Everything is available here.

reviews.review_heading: I am satisfied with coming to Galgotias University.
reviews.review_text: Facilities available for my course are very good. I am really satisfied with my decision. Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and the library are all easily accessible. Hostel facilities are also very good. The quality of food is very good. Medical facilities, sports, and games are also available for students.

reviews.review_heading: University is good with decent placement, but very crowded with a huge number of events.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the university is very good university provides India's first active learning building (AI&this). It has a smart classroom, a beautiful and huge library, and the university has a huge campus that has a 3D printing lab, a done lab, robotics lab, a huge cafeteria, and many more.

overview_faqs.question: What is the hostel fee at IPU?
overview_faqs.answer: Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University's annual hostel cost is INR 29,500. Mess and welfare fees are not included in the hostel fees. The fee for the mess is INR 36,000, while the cost of the welfare is INR 3,000. Candidates need to submit three demand drafts: one for hostel fees, one for mess charges, and one for welfare charges. Two hostels are maintained on campus for male students, and two are maintained for female students. There are more than 180 single-seat rooms in each hostel. Basic furnishings such as a cot, mattress, pillow, chair, table, cupboard, tube lamp, and fan are provided in each room. Mess facilities are available for residents in each hostel. Residents also have access to a common area, a gym, a reading room, and sports facilities. For the hostels, there is a provision for 24-hour water and electrical services.

overview_faqs.question: Is CAT compulsory for MBA at IPU?
overview_faqs.answer: No, CAT is not the only exam based on which admission is granted. GGSIPU accepts the CAT percentile for MBA admission basis on which a merit list of selected candidates is released for the counselling round. Moreover, for the MBA in IT course, the university conducted IPU CET exam is accepted. In case the seats are left vacant after CAT candidates, then the seat allotment is carried out based on the candidate's CMAT scores.

faqs.question: I've scored less than 50% in graduation. Am I eligible for MBA at GGSIPU?

faqs.answer: Admissions in GGSIPU are done on entrance-basis. The basic eligibility requires the candidates to pass Class 12 or its equivalent exam with a minimum aggregate of 50%. Hence, you can certainly apply for the BBA course even if you have scored less than 60% in your Class 12 boards. However, BBA admissions at GGSIPU are accepted on the basis of valid score obtained in the IPU CET or CUET followed by counselling. Only those who meet the cut-off and satisfy all the parameters will be allocated a seat at GSSIPU for the BBA programme. In case the students are unable to clear the BBA cut-off released by the university, they can pursue the BBA Online courses offered by various other colleges.

paragraphs: GGSIPU placement report for 2025 is yet to be released. However, as per the overall NIRF 2025 data, the median package offered UG-4 Year was INR 8.25 LPA . The median package offered to the UG 5-year was INR 8.39 LPA . While the median packages offered to the PG 1-Year and PG 2-Year students were INR 5.35 LPA and INR 6.95 LPA , respectively.

The University has released the placement report 2024 for GGSIPU’s University School of Information, Communication & Technology ( USICT ). The highest package offered at GGSIPU USICT was INR 41.2 LPA . The average package offered was INR 7.2 LPA . Further, 126 offers were made and 32 companies visited the campus during USICT placements 2024. Apart from this, according to USMS NIRF report 2024, the median package offered during IPU MBA placements 2023 stood at INR 6.18 LPA . In addition, a total of 160 students were placed out of 175 students during Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University MBA placements 2023.

Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science (HITS) has a multi-step admission process that students need to follow to get into the university. Starting with the application, students are required to go through the entrance exam followed by selection rounds and lastly confirmation of admission. After the selection rounds are over, course-wise merit lists are released on the official website of the university. Interested candidates can submit the fee and confirm their admission. Additionally, Admission to all the programmes is based on the entrance exam. Check below the complete HITS admission process:
1 - HITS Application 2025
The mode of application is online. Candidates must register online and then fill out the online application form.
2 - HITS Admission Selection rounds
Appear for the university-based entrance exam i.e., HITSEEE & HITSCAT. The selection will be based on entrance exam score and GDPI and then wait for the release of their merit list.
3 - HITS Document Verification
Once the selection rounds are done, the shortlisted candidates are called for document verification. Aspirants need to pay a course fee to confirm their seat in the university.

faqs.question: Can I join Hindustan University without entrance exam?

faqs.question: How can I join Hindustan Institute of Technology?
faqs.answer: Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science (HITS) has a multi-step admission process which students need to follow to get into the university. Starting with the application, students are required to go through the entrance exam followed by selection rounds and lastly confirmation of admission. After the selection rounds are over, course-wise merit lists are released on the official website of the university. Interested candidates can submit the fee and confirm their admission. Additionally, Admission to all the programmes is based on the entrance exam. Candidates must check the eligibility criteria on the official website of Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science, before filling out the admission form.

paragraphs: Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science offers both need-based and merit-based scholarships to the eligible students. Also, Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science has instituted Hindustan Teaching Research Fellowships (HTRF) for eligible candidates.
Below are the major highlights of Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science scholarships:

Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science provides a total of 7 scholarships to eligible students. Below mentioned are the detailed information regarding Hindustan Institute of Technology and Science scholarships:
DRDO Scholarship Scheme for Girls

This scholarship is for Girls / Women students studying in first year of Under Graduate (BE/B.TECH: full time four year degree) and Post Graduate (M.TECH/ME: two year full time degree course) under “DRDO Scholarship Scheme for Girls in Aerospace Engg / Aeronautical Engg / Space Engg & Rocketry / Avionics / Aircraft Engg”.
Covid Martyrs Scholarships

This scholarship is for wards of COVID Martyrs, who have lost their lives protecting our countrymen during the COVID Pandemic will be given complete Tuition Fee waiver in the discipline of their choice, having met the basic laid down norms, such as marks in qualifying exams etc. Also all the expenses of the student which include traveling, boarding and lodging will be taken care of by HITS. Also, a monthly stipend is provided during the period of the course.
Covid Frontline Warrior Scholarship

This scholarship is for the wards of Doctors, Healthcare professionals, Government and Service personnel those who have participated in protecting our countrymen during the COVID Pandemic. The scholarship is for a period of two years across all courses to those who meet the basic scholarship criteria.

paragraphs: Admissions to different levels of courses atIIIT Allahabadare entrance-based. The institute provides BTech, M.Tech, MBA and PhD courses across four departments. The names of these departments are Applied Sciences, Electronics and Communication Engineering, Information Technology and Management Sciences.

The selection of the student is decided on the scores, students have acheived in the national level entrance exam:JEE Main, CAT, MAT, GATE, XAT, CMAT, etc. For the undergraduate engineering course and postgraduate engineering course, i.e., BTech and MTech, the students should take part in the counselling process, which means seat allotment is based on JoSAA and CCMT counselling. For a PhD, students need to appear in an interview round.
Students seeking admission should meet the course-wise eligibility and selection conditions. The table below contains the relevant information about  IIIT Allahabad course admissions 2025

Further, students have to apply on the institute's official website for MBA admission. Moreover, the aspirant shall ensure that the application form is submitted within the prescribed due date.

After the application process, the counselling bodies release a course-wise cutoff list. The cutoff list indicates the minimum required score in the respective entrance exam for a candidate to become eligible for admission. Students with a score equal to or more than the cutoff marks can apply.

reviews.review_heading: Good college, with great atmosphere.
reviews.review_text: It's compulsory to opt for hostel. And according to every student, it's good to be part of hostel. The hostel rooms are well furnished with proper ventilation and lighting. Classrooms are world class, all facilities are available. Library is open 24 hours. Wi-Fi is available all over the campus. There are different grounds for different sports.

reviews.review_heading: Table of Indian Institute of Information Technology Allahabad.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college is good enough. The campus is big enough, and there are various beautiful places such as the rock garden, the pavilion, the cafeteria, etc. Also, the academic buildings are good enough. But there can be some improvements in hostels.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIIT Allahabad.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of our college, Indian Institute of Information and Technology Allahabad (Prayagraj), is very good, I think, because it has its own mess, which is very hygienic and well maintained, and it also has its own canteen that provides a variety of foods.

reviews.review_heading: Review of IIIT Allahabad College.
reviews.review_text: The hostel, along with the mess, runs in a sufficient manner. Classrooms have Wi-Fi, and the LAN can be accessed from the hostel rooms. Basically, you are able to get everything that you want on the university grounds. The classrooms are airy and equipped with projectors. There is a big stadium for cricket and football, apart from an indoor stadium for badminton.

reviews.review_heading: My experience at IIIT as an ECE student.
reviews.review_text: The campus is enough for the graduates as it is not very crowded. All sports are available indoors and outdoors. However, the maintenance of some sports facilities lags, like the basketball court, badminton, etc. Labs are good, fully centralized. A.C. Timings for labs are until 8 p.m., and libraries are open until 11 p.m. The library has a good collection of books relevant to your courses. Classrooms are decent, not much to say, but on the good side.

reviews.review_heading: Good seniors. Satisfactory faculty and good placements.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi is poor, but LAN and Ethernet services are good. Computer Labs are generally open 24/7. The library has timings from 8:00 AM to 12:00 AM. Classes are usually for all batches and start from 9:50 AM and end at 6:30 PM. There are also breaks of 2 hours and 1:30 hours. Hostels are fine, better than many other institutions. The quality of food is satisfactory. Medical staff are there for certain timings, but there are a few issues during nighttime. There is a SAC where students generally play s...

reviews.review_heading: Great faculty, facilities - IIIT Allahabad.
reviews.review_text: IIIT ALLAHABAD B.Tech - Electronics and Communication has lecture halls/classrooms and labs that have air conditioning. The hostel is also well managed, clean, and equipped with high-speed Wi-Fi. The mess food is also decent and good. The canteen food is very good and has a lot of variety.

reviews.review_heading: Just satisfied, good placements, decent infrastructure, and good faculty.
reviews.review_text: Well-equipped labs, smart classrooms with AC, and the central Library are decent, overall good. Sports infrastructure is good with a cricket ground, badminton courts, table tennis courts, gym, and swimming pool. Mess and canteen food are okay, and hostels are Wi-Fi enabled.

reviews.review_heading: Good placement and decent college life.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms, library, and labs are good and have Wi-Fi and air conditioning. Wi-Fi signals are not that good, and there is a network problem on campus. Hostels are decent, but water quality is bad and have internet problems; you have to connect LAN for a good internet connection.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and campus, but teaching needs improvement.
reviews.review_text: Department has Wi-Fi, labs and classrooms. But some labs do not have new equipment. Library is good with many books. Hostel rooms okay but are not always very clean. Mess food is normal, sometimes bad. Canteen is better. Medical facility is there, but not very fast. Sports ground is good.

reviews.review_heading: IIIT Allahabad - Where code meets culture.
reviews.review_text: Academic wing is fully air-conditioned with lab and classroom equipped with modern facilities with 24X7 access to Wi-Fi services. There is one central library where you could find large number of books by almost every writer and research papers by researchers.

reviews.review_heading: The truth and nothing else.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure is good, fests and events happen a lot, the hostel and college campus both have free Wi-Fi, there's a good library, and subscriptions to some paid journals. The course is also updated to the latest industry standards, and proper lab classes are organised for practical implications.

reviews.review_heading: It is the best B.Tech college in India.
reviews.review_text: Facilities in the hostel are very poor, and the quality of food is getting worse day by day. Facilities like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and the library are good but can be improved. Medical facilities are bad, but there are qualified doctors. There is only limited time for consultation, and no proper medicine is available.

reviews.review_heading: Amazing institute with more than 90% placements every year.
reviews.review_text: They provide an internet LAN, a table, a lamp, and a cupboard with enough space for 2 people. Mess is nice at first but then they diluted it and they are serving bad food now. Mess fee is hit or miss. Mess vendors are not good as mess food is sometimes pathetic and does not have very good quality food, it is still edible. On the other hand, the breakfast is very nice. I am very much satisfied.

reviews.review_heading: The college has good placements and wonderful infrastructure, but too hectic academics.
reviews.review_text: There are top-class facilities available for my course, such as a computer lab and library. paragraphs: The placement rate recorded during IIT Goa placement 2025 for BTech and MTech programs stood at 93.9% and 80%, respectively. 166 companies visited the campus in 2025. Further, 83% students secured 6-month internships this year. Some of the top recruiters were Intel, DE Shaw & Co, Google , TCS and Accenture. The average and median package offered to BTech students in 2025 was INR 19.15 LPA and INR 12.67 LPA. For the MTech course, the average and median package was INR 11.13 LPA and INR 10 LPA.

90.60% placement rate was recorded in 2024 . The average and median package offered during IIT Goa placements 2024 was INR 15.41 LPA and INR 11.5 LPA . 161 recruiters visited and selected 116 students of the BTech and MTech batch . Out of the total 116 students placed, 98 were from the BTech and 18 from the MTech batch 2024. The average package offered to BTech and MTech students in 2024 was INR 15.92 LPA and INR 11.72 LPA .

reviews.review_heading: A review of a student at IIT Goa.
reviews.review_text: There is Wi-Fi availability in the campus and hostel as well. Labs, Classrooms, Library are quite good. There are no issues with facilities provided in the hostel. The mess food is good which follows a menu. There is a canteen near the mess and there are also medical facilities, sports and games.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements and campus life.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure here would be described as average, but there are enough for a good time in the hostel; the classrooms and library are good for a medium number of people as the strength of the college is low; however, the campus and hostel are temporary considering there will be discussions for the building of a permanent campus soon; sports and games facilities are okay for average students. There are all major sports playgrounds in the hostel itself, except for cricket and football.

reviews.review_heading: Fully satisfied with My College.
reviews.review_text: Internet services are good. We have wifis as well as Lanes. We have one library where wide range of books are available. We have excess of classrooms. We have labs for different departments. Our Hostels have good water facility. Proper security. Food available in the mess is good for health as well as Tasty. Food available in canteen is not that expensive. It is affordable. Tasty. We have dispensery which has many of the facilities. Many of the sports ar played here like cricket, Foot ball, bask...

reviews.review_heading: Best government college. Less fees and great return. Reputed institute.
reviews.review_text: We don't have our own campus, but a GC campus. We reside on the GC campus. We have only five lecture halls and a small library made in a bungalow. About medical and Wi-Fi, it's very good, and the mess food is the same as others; it's not very bad or top-notch.

reviews.review_heading: The Journey of Learning at IIT GOA.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure for the mechanical engineering department includes various labs like the chemistry lab, the physics lab, etc. As per the hostel facilities, IIT Goa has well-equipped hostel facilities for students. There are separate hostel blocks for male and female students. All rooms in the block are double occupancy, with provisions for study tables, beds, etc.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Goa-Inside Talk by a student.
reviews.review_text: Since we do not have a permanent campus, we are based on the campus of GEC college. But apart from that, we do have our own hostel block which has all the facilities a student needs. Clean rooms with cleaning room service. Very fast Wi-Fi in hostels.

reviews.review_heading: IIT Goa Inside Out: Through a students view.
reviews.review_text: All the classrooms have state-of-art facilities. Each class has digital teaching equipments required for teaching technical subjects of course. Also the classes are comfortable with ACs installed in each class. Even though the college is still situated in its temporary campus the library has all the books required for all the subjects. The institute also provides access to few digital books too. The Hostels are also clean, well-facilitated. Other required facilities like Clinic, stores, food are...

reviews.review_heading: Review of Indian Institute of Technology, Goa.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is very good. All rooms are very good and one room is allotted for two boys and the same for girls. All classrooms and the library are good. Our campus is fully enabled with Wi-Fi. Mess is very good and it serves food 4 times a day.

reviews.review_heading: Our college has good placements and hostel.
reviews.review_text:
Sports equipment is great. The food is nice. No permanent campus yet. Hostel is small but awesome. Labs and classrooms are excellent. Library has a good collection of books and magazines. Medical facilities are excellent
Canteen is very far from hostel.

reviews.review_heading: I am not satisfied with the faculty and infrastructure but placements are improving year by year.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is too small but good as we don't have our own campus. The classrooms are good but there will be no air-conditioner but in labs, we have an air-conditioner. The library present is also small but its very useful. Wi-Fi is available on campus with a good speed but there occurs some issues during power cuts. Hostel rooms are good and the quality of food can be rated 3.5/5. There is also a canteen near which is of GECs. The medical facility is good. They are very ca...

reviews.review_heading: Poor infrastructure of the temporary campus, excellent faculty, internships, and placements.
reviews.review_text: The campus has poor Infrastructure as there is no permanent campus yet. Very less strength and a small hostel are available. There are frequent power cuts and Wi-Fi issues. The food quality is not bad and canteen is far from the hostel but excellent medical facilities. Sports and gaming facilities are quite good.

reviews.review_heading: Compared to all 3rd generation IITs, our college is really good.
reviews.review_text: High-speed Wi-Fi facility is available, and the library has many books. The mess food is good to eat, unlike what we hear from others that the hostel food is not so good. Sports facilities like badminton, table tennis, lawn tennis, basketball, cricket, and football are available.

college_info.intro:
Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University Kakinada have several departments, like the Department of Chemical Engineering, Mathematics, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering, etc. Through these departments, JNTUK offers various UG, PG, and PhD courses.
Popular programmes at JNTU Kakinada are, BTech and MTech. The institute offers a 4-year BTech programme and a 2-year MTech programme in various specialisations. The popularity of these programmes is due to their curriculum, which is constantly upgraded to suit various branches of engineering and technology.
The industry-institute relations established by JNTU Kakinada provide students with ample opportunities to undergo various training programmes organised by industry partners. content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure in our college are good enough, and the labs and classrooms are well-maintained. The hostel food facilities are okay for minimal prices, and they provide good medical facilities and encourage students for sports and games in our mechanical department. A madam named keerthi, she teaches us the C language and the mechanical subject. She is very supportive of students by guiding them.

paragraphs: JNTUK application process involves shortlisting of students, the release of merit list, counselling, and seat allotment. Find out more on JNTUK admission below:1 - Application ProcessJNTUH admissions require students to visit the official website of the respective national-level entrance exam conducting bodies. They need to fill out the application form in online mode.
For the remaining programme candidates are required to apply directly from the official website of JNTUK.
2 - Shortlisting of Students & Release of Merit List

JNTUK shortlists candidates based on entrance exam performance. These include TS EAMCET, GATE, GPAT, etc. The state-level exam conducting bodies, such as TS ICET, release course-wise merit lists for MBA and MCA courses. The university releases a merit list for courses based on merit or national-level exams.
3 - Counselling

Once the merit list is released, eligible students are invited for counselling rounds. For MBA and MCA courses, the counselling is conducted by the TS ICET Counseling. For BTech admission, the TS EAMCET Counseling is held. And for MTech PGECET counseling is required.
4 - Seat Allotment & Admission Confirmation
As per the round of counselling, seats are allotted to the eligible students. Further, the selected students can confirm their admission by paying the course fees.

JNTUK fee is broken down into multiple components, such as tuition fee, hostel fee, and one-time fee. The components in the total fee vary with the course selected by the students. However, the overall tuition fee for JNTUK ranges between INR 25 Kand INR 10 L. Find below JNTUK fees for top courses:

review_summary.college_name: Jaypee Institute of Information Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied about the curriculum, but placements are kind of okay.

content.Placements: Nearly 70 percent of students are placed. Top roles are business analyst and associate consultant. Top companies include startups and mass hirers like Infosys, Cognizant. Companies like Oracle and Amazon also do on-campus visits, and the overall hiring scene is okay.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms depend on buildings; for B. Tech, they are not up to the mark and are in bad shape. Labs are clean and have facilities, but the experiments are bookish and some are not worth it. Food quality is normal, not too bad, but it gets boring after some time.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: JIIT: The ultimate college for placements.

content.Placements: More than 90% of students from the CSE department are placed, and the highest package offered so far is 90 LPA, as reported by LinkedIn. Top recruiters are Google, Microsoft, and Atlassian. Many students got an internship, with some even getting one in the first semester of their first year. Top roles offered are in SWE and SDE.
content.Infrastructure: Hostels are excellent in terms of price, but availability is based on CGPA. Food quality is excellent, and the campus features 24/7 medical facilities, including an ambulance and fire brigade. Wi-Fi speeds are also good. You can get around 50-60 Mbps, and you can access the library and cafe till 10:30 at night.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: It is a good college, and I am satisfied with it.

content.Placements: It consists of a large number of students. The lowest package in our batch till date is 4.5 LPA. Companies that were offering recruitment were MakeMyTrip, Forvis, Mazars, and many other companies. Almost many students received internship opportunities, but many people also did not receive them.
content.Infrastructure: It consists of good infrastructure. The facilities are good and the faculty is understanding. They listen to our problems sometimes. Labs are good, and the food in the mess and canteen is of good quality, which can be eaten frequently at minimal cost.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: It has a supportive environment and experienced faculty members.

content.Placements: Placement season is still going on, and maximum students got internships from the college itself. Top roles offered are business development, executive, financial analyst, business analyst, executive for corporate sales, etc. Top recruiting companies that recruit students from this college are Swiggy, MakeMyTrip, and Naukri.com.
content.Infrastructure: The department has well-maintained classrooms with smart boards and audiovisual teaching aids. There is Wi-Fi connectivity across the department. The computer lab is equipped with an updated system. The library has a good collection of textbooks, reference books, and general books. Seminar halls are also available for presentations and guest lectures.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Very Satisfied, good studies, good environment, good location, and decent crowd.

content.Placements: Placements are excellent, and overall, the training and companies visited are good. The coding culture is, I guess, less active otherwise. If you join the clubs, then it'll be sorted out. Placement and internship opportunities depend more on your efforts if done properly. 12 LPA is very easy to get if you're from CSE in 62.
content.Infrastructure: The campus is not so big, like three buildings in which 1 is a hostel, but properly maintained with all facilities, with smart classrooms, and good food by Annapurna. The sports facilities are okay, and they have three entry gates and a parking area, 1 auditorium in JBS.

placement_data.title: Jaypee Institute of Information Technology Noida Placement Overview 2025
paragraphs: JIIT Noida has released the placement stats for its BTech batch that passed out in 2025 . The highest package offered during JIIT placements 2025 stood at INR 62 LPA , which was offered by Atlassian . The second-highest package offered by Microsoft, which stood at INR 55.38 LPA . Further, the average and median package offered to BTech students during JIIT placement 2025 stood at INR 11.13 LPA and INR 7.93 LPA , respectively.

A total of 666 offers were provided to 461 BTech CSE participating students , 142 offers to 121 ECE students, 71 offers to 50 IT students, and 25 offers to 26 students. The total percentage of offers during Jaypee Noida placements 2025 stood at 137% .

Jaypee Institute of Information Technology, Noida has a dedicated Placement and Training cell that organizes a campus recruitment training process to train the students through various in-house and out-of-the-house training sessions, including aptitude test, technical test, Group Discussions (GD), mock interviews, workshops, etc. It helps the students to prepare for placement interviews in technical and HR aspects by arranging meetings with professional trainers.

All hostel rooms are provided with LAN/Wi-Fi connectivity with 24 hours internet through the main server of the academic block. The hostel is also connected with outdoor sports centers for lawn tennis, basketball, volleyball, and badminton. Other facilities include are 24 hour’s electricity supply, water heaters, water freezer etc.

sports.description: Available Facilities: Badminton Court, Basketball Court, Cricket Ground, Football Ground, Swimming Pool, Tennis Court, Volleyball Court, Hockey Field

labs.description: Available Facilities: Computer Lab, Electronics Lab, Language Lab, Physics Lab, Biotechnology Lab, Psychology Lab

reviews.review_heading: Dissatisfied about the curriculum, but placements are kind of okay.
reviews.review_text: Classrooms depend on buildings; for B. Tech, they are not up to the mark and are in bad shape. Labs are clean and have facilities, but the experiments are bookish and some are not worth it. Food quality is normal, not too bad, but it gets boring after some time.

reviews.review_heading: JIIT: The ultimate college for placements.
reviews.review_text: Hostels are excellent in terms of price, but availability is based on CGPA. Food quality is excellent, and the campus features 24/7 medical facilities, including an ambulance and fire brigade. Wi-Fi speeds are also good. You can get around 50-60 Mbps, and you can access the library and cafe till 10:30 at night.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college, and I am satisfied with it.
reviews.review_text: It consists of good infrastructure. The facilities are good and the faculty is understanding. They listen to our problems sometimes. Labs are good, and the food in the mess and canteen is of good quality, which can be eaten frequently at minimal cost.

reviews.review_heading: It has a supportive environment and experienced faculty members.
reviews.review_text: The department has well-maintained classrooms with smart boards and audiovisual teaching aids. There is Wi-Fi connectivity across the department. The computer lab is equipped with an updated system. The library has a good collection of textbooks, reference books, and general books. Seminar halls are also available for presentations and guest lectures.

reviews.review_heading: Very Satisfied, good studies, good environment, good location, and decent crowd.
reviews.review_text: The campus is not so big, like three buildings in which 1 is a hostel, but properly maintained with all facilities, with smart classrooms, and good food by Annapurna. The sports facilities are okay, and they have three entry gates and a parking area, 1 auditorium in JBS.

reviews.review_heading: Good Infrastructure and Placements
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure and connectivity are pretty good. It is directly located at Noida Electronic City metro station; thus, it is very easy to travel to. Hostels are also very good. Every single hostel has 2 rooms and AC as well. Classrooms are good, Wi-Fi is good, and I love the library.

reviews.review_heading: Jaypee could be a better option than other private colleges.
reviews.review_text: There are clean classrooms, well-equipped labs, huge library, overall campus Wi-Fi and hostel Wi-Fi (with limit), medical facility, psychological counselling, cafe, and huge common mess. The college lacks in sports facilities, but as a technology college I will say that it is fine.

reviews.review_heading: Jaypee Noida review by CSE under graduate.
reviews.review_text: Infrastructure here is very good. All the classrooms, labs, washrooms, and canteen are available. Every place is very clean and hygienic. You will not face any difficulties with cleanliness and hygiene. The whole campus is Wi-Fi enabled. The labs have the latest technology.

reviews.review_heading: A very good college in terms of private colleges.
reviews.review_text: The mess food is average and hygienic but repetitive, and many students prefer outside food or canteen options. Overall, JIIT is a good option for serious CSE students but less ideal for other branches or those seeking a relaxed college experience. It's okay.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements but boring college life.
reviews.review_text: Medical facilities are good, and the mess is better compared to most colleges. The cafe is nice at first, but you get bored easily because it doesn't offer many good options. The classrooms and the library are also really nice. The Wi-Fi restricts apps like WhatsApp and Amazon. The network in hostels is very limited. First-year hostels are nice, but from the second year onwards, the quality starts to degrade little by little. Wi-Fi connectivity isn't very nice. It can be very frustrating, especi...

reviews.review_heading: Satisfied with the college, except for the campus area, which is hardly 16 acres.
reviews.review_text: Our course includes all the subjects required. But there are some subjects that lack practical knowledge, just like the other colleges. Hostels here have common washrooms. Rooms contain 2 beds and 2 almirahs. But the most important thing is the friends you make. Talking about sports, there aren't many facilities; no cricket or football ground, while you have a GYM along with a badminton court and a separate Squash Room. Table tennis is present inside the Hostel.

reviews.review_heading: I'm not satisfied with the mess food at all; it's horrible.
reviews.review_text: The college has well-equipped labs, air-conditioned classrooms, good Wi-Fi in academic areas, and a central library with a large collection of books and e-resources. The hostel rooms are clean and maintained regularly, with 24/7 water and electricity backup. The mess food is average, better than some other hostels, but repetitive sometimes. There are multiple canteens and food stalls inside the campus offering a decent variety.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with best experience.
reviews.review_text: The building is great with a very nice and comfortable infrastructure. Free Wi-Fi is there on whole campus, labs are equipped with all the necessary materials that too in a sufficient amount to meet all students' needs, and classrooms have centralized AC and also projectors which almost every teacher uses to teach. Library is the best with no noise and a great amount of books. The food in the cafeteria is so nice with 100% hygiene.

reviews.review_heading: Review of Jaypee 128 sector.
reviews.review_text: Wi-Fi and labs are satisfactory while classrooms are average. The library is good. Hostels are nice but the mess food is bland. Sports facilities exist but are poorly maintained. Medical assistance is available and efficient. Classrooms could use some renovation. The college infrastructure isn't exceptional; it's a single building college. The surrounding area needs improvement.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements but bad college life.
reviews.review_text: I am in the 128 sector branch where the infra is very below par. There was some construction going on, and also the size of the cafe was so small that it became congested during heavy hours. On top of that, MPH, the multipurpose hall is always occupied with some cultural activities, so there is no place to hang out in the college
